tt34792531.name: Avaraachan & Sons
tt34792531.description: Follows Avarachan, his children and the various family and social relationships that shape their lives.

tt48461761.name: Eyes
tt48461761.description: Tina Sebastian, a police officer investigates disturbing cases involving women. As the investigation progresses, mental health professionals join forces with the police to understand the psychology of stalkers, identify warning signs and prevent situations from escalating.

videos.title: The Threat Returns
videos.overview: When actor Ritika gets a renewed threat from her stalker, Milan, she reaches out to EYES, a team specifically devoted to protecting victims of stalkers. She is disappointed to know that the team that had made her feel protected was no longer operational.

videos.title: The Case That Broke Us
videos.overview: After helping the police to successfully nab Milan, EYES is persuaded to restart their mission. The team first has to confront the reality of the case that had caused them to falter the first time – the case of Varsha and Hemant.

videos.title: The Other Side
videos.overview: Having restarted their work in protecting victims and helping stalkers overcome their issues, the EYES team has to go back to their old cases and make up for any lapses in their understanding – for instance, Sajin Zachariah’s side of the story his wife has said about him.

videos.title: Nothing Is As It Seems
videos.overview: As a team of mental health professionals working side by side with the police, the EYES team has to be sure of the truth of a story before they can help the victim or the stalker. In some cases, like the one between Sajin and Shobhita, the truth is not what it seems at first glance.

videos.title: Why We Stay
videos.overview: Unexpected setbacks from within and outside the team lead EYES to once again question what they are doing and why. But they know there is only one way to go – forward.

videos.title: Trust No One
videos.overview: A team member’s actions puts the fate of EYES in jeopardy. Another’s doubt proves vital in setting a wrong right. Slowly but surely, the team moves closer to its goals.

videos.title: The Ones Being Hunted
videos.overview: When the protectors turn the hunted and long-hidden truths emerge, Team EYES proves beyond doubt that the mission is safe in their hands.

tt36931126.name: Immortal
tt36931126.description: An unsuspecting man finds himself at the center of a series of mysterious deaths, forcing him to confront a truth that could cost him everything.

tt29625288.name: Akka
tt29625288.description: In a kingdom ruled by women, matriarch Bhavani faces her biggest threat in Rudra, a ruthless rebel eyeing her land and legacy.

tt47421307.name: SI Yugandhar
tt47421307.description: An honest cop's discovery of a mysterious body launches a high-stakes investigation, forcing him to uncover a dark web of secrets hidden beneath the city's surface.

tt40856774.name: The Traitors (Telugu)
tt40856774.description: Twenty contestants play the ultimate game of trust and betrayal.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Twenty celebrity players enter a magnificent palace to begin the ultimate psychological game of trust and betrayal. But three among them are secretly chosen by Teja Sajja as Traitors. As the players form their first alliances and take on their opening mission, the Traitors prepare for their first murder in the Traitor Den.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: After the first murder, the players realise just how dangerous the game is. A new mission introduces game-changing Shields that could protect the Innocents from the Traitors. Can they earn one - and strike back in the Ring of Doubt?

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: The Traitors have the upper hand. A ruthless mission puts Shields up for grabs, with the power to protect the Innocents from the Traitors' wrath. Alliances crack, suspicions explode, and the Ring of Doubt becomes a battleground.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: The last mission has changed the course of the game, leaving the Traitors with a big decision to make. Then, under cover of darkness, the players face a terrifying night mission that will test their nerves and their trust.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: With no Shield in play, every Innocent is vulnerable. After some hard-hitting confrontations in the Ring of Doubt, the Traitors strike again! Murdering one of the game's most influential Innocents.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: The Traitors are getting bolder. A shocking Hitlist puts hidden alliances in the spotlight, as loyalties are tested and the fate of several players hangs in the balance. And this time, the danger comes face to face.

tt47657304.name: Panthadikkaam
tt47657304.description: The series traces Kerala's raw, emotional passion for football, looking at how the sport functions almost like a religion across local streets, villages, and generations during global tournaments like the FIFA World Cup.

videos.title: God's Own Football
videos.overview: Vysakh Perambara traces Kerala's football passion and its legacy across generations.

videos.title: The Latin American Brothers Of Munda
videos.overview: Two brothers fuel Kerala's Brazil and Argentina rivalry, uniting their village through football.

videos.title: The Last Dance
videos.overview: Kerala fans honour Messi, Ronaldo and Neymar while embracing football's new era.

videos.title: In The Name Of Football
videos.overview: Kerala's World Cup frenzy fuels fan rivalries, local businesses and community spirit.

videos.title: The Final Whistle
videos.overview: A month of football magic ends, but Kerala's dreams for India endure.

tt39239754.name: Sigma
tt39239754.description: A daring treasure hunter throws caution to the wind, outwitting deadly traps and treacherous allies with sheer nerve and cunning.

tt32089596.name: Comrade Kalyan
tt32089596.description: In a naxal-dominated village on the Andhra-Odisha border, a theatre owner uses communist sentiment to keep his old cinema running. He joins the naxals and kidnaps a leader, setting off a chain of events.

tt45370533.name: The Dark Heaven
tt45370533.description: In the Hill Village of Mekkarai, Where It is Customary for Men to Die Every Seven Years During the Month of June, a Newly Appointed Police Inspector Arrives to Investigate a Series of Mysterious Murders. As He Digs Deeper Into the Village's Dark Secrets and Long-standing Beliefs, He Finds Himself Trapped in a Web of Crime, Fear, and Hidden Truths.

tt38674953.name: #Love
tt38674953.description: The pragmatic creator of a dating app and her adventurous competitor test their theories about love in a 60-day challenge to find their ideal partner.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Desperate to secure funding for her dating app, Tara hangs her company's future on a bold wager with Matthew, a rival firm's adventurous investor.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: As financial strain builds at Found, Tara and Matthew commit to their challenge, going on dates through each other's dating apps.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: With Tara struggling to keep her company afloat, Matthew helps her unwind at a music festival, where their growing chemistry takes an unexpected turn.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Tara confides in Arun and Sylvia about her complicated love life. Matthew reaches a breaking point as tensions rise during his birthday celebrations.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Matthew grows closer to Mridhula as she supports him after his birthday blow-up. Tara makes a daring move against Chakri and Arun opens up to his parents.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: As their 60-day challenge ends, Tara and Matthew gain clarity. But as feelings finally surface, can they find a way back to each other?

tt31841170.name: Don't Trouble the Trouble
tt31841170.description: Suri, a magician, accidentally makes a young girl vanish with a spell. The girl, revealed to be a genie who grants wishes, explores the city and unleashes her powers when angered.

tt40857865.name: Jagamae Sangeetham
tt40857865.description: Set in Vaikuntapuram, a sacred temple town nestled between the banks of the Godavari and the neon lights of pop stardom, a disciplined heir to a musical throne and a fame-weary singer strike a forbidden chord. To protect a century of heritage, they must navigate a landscape of family secrets, masked identities, and the heavy price of finding their own voices.

tt33509307.name: Oru Anweshanathinte Thudakkam
tt33509307.description: In Kerala, an investigating journalist disappears without notice. Media and public stunned. Investigation uncovers shocking, unexpected mysteries. Suspenseful plot follows the case's twists and revelations.

tt36205747.name: Pavithram
tt36205747.description: Forced marriage, a clash of tradition and faith, leads to a complex journey of transformation for a woman named Vedha. The series explores themes of resilience, redemption, and the power of love amidst societal pressures

videos.title: Pavithram
videos.overview: Forced marriage, a clash of tradition and faith, leads to a complex journey of transformation for a woman named Vedha. The series explores themes of resilience, redemption, and the power of love amidst societal pressures.

tt44090278.name: Baththa
tt44090278.description: In 1986 Madras, a timid eight-year-old boy accidentally locks a feared criminal inside a school restroom. As the man faces hunger and isolation, an unexpected friendship forms between them, transforming both their lives.

tt39014003.name: Adinaasam Vellapokkam
tt39014003.description: Four students at strict Liberty Engineering College encounter a gangster who sneaks in as a motivational speaker. The stern principal watches everyone closely as events unfold.

tt43592288.name: Muthassi
tt43592288.description: In a remote village haunted by ancient secrets, a mother's love is put to the ultimate test when her son becomes entangled in a terrifying supernatural curse.

videos.title: The House of Secrets
videos.overview: A mother, torn between love and destruction, faces her son's demonic change from a cursed lineage.

videos.title: Shattered Joy
videos.overview: A mother, torn between love and destruction, faces her son's demonic change from a cursed lineage.

videos.title: Birth of a Curse
videos.overview: A mother, torn between love and destruction, faces her son's demonic change from a cursed lineage.

videos.title: The Village in Fear
videos.overview: A mother, torn between love and destruction, faces her son's demonic change from a cursed lineage.

videos.title: Truth Unleashed
videos.overview: A mother, torn between love and destruction, faces her son's demonic change from a cursed lineage.

videos.title: A Mother’s Choice
videos.overview: The mother's fierce love for her child leads her toward a chilling, deadly destiny.

tt38915678.name: Dorothy
tt38915678.description: Set in a world shaped by caste, violence, and toxic masculinity, two friends grow up inseparable in rural Tamil Nadu. Their lives are transformed by the arrival of Dorothy, a woman whose compassion challenges the world around them.

tt44914967.name: The Court
tt44914967.description: A young lawyer, brilliant with case details, struggles to find her place within the legal fraternity. Her two opponents: her celebrated father and her stammer.

videos.title: Black Coats
videos.overview: Yazhini faces rejection due to her stutter, Deva loses his chamber and Veni enters the Bar Association election. However, an ATM robbery gives them a new ray of hope.

videos.title: Same Case, Different Reasons
videos.overview: Yazhini secretly investigates the ATM robbery while working for Mahesh, and Deva charms the bank manager to secure the same case. Will this case change their fortunes?

videos.title: Crossed
videos.overview: While Veni fights for an evicted tea-stall vendor, Yazhini uncovers a crucial clue in the ATM robbery. How will Mahesh and Deva handle this new discovery?

videos.title: The Wrong Interview
videos.overview: Veni spots Pandiyaraj's campaign posters and gets infuriated. Deva finally manages to get a chamber, although shared, and hijacks Yazhini's interview, which forces a choice on her.

videos.title: The Choice
videos.overview: Torn between Veni's experience and Deva's ambition, Yazhini chooses the chamber where she wants to build her future. But on her first day in court, she draws Muthu's ire.

videos.title: Undone
videos.overview: Yazhini races to secure anticipatory bail for Joe. However, things go wrong when the tampered petition is rejected and Yazhini faces the blame.

videos.title: Redemption
videos.overview: Determined to free Joe, Yazhini strikes a bargain with the registrar. But later, she confronts Veni with proof of Muthu's sabotage.

videos.title: Legacy
videos.overview: Deva challenges Veni to represent her client's son, turning their rivalry into a contest. While Yazhini feels conflicted about her boss' actions, Raja Sekar arrives and greets her.

videos.title: Old Wounds
videos.overview: When Yazhini's identity as Raj Sekar's daughter becomes public, Deva questions her choices. Meanwhile, the top lawyer's courtroom appearance uncovers old wounds.

videos.title: Vantage Point
videos.overview: Shailaja asks her dad why Yazhini can't join their firm. Yazhini finds out from Veni the conflict between Raj Sekar and Sathyan and gets a breakthrough in the drunk-driving case.

videos.title: Groundwork
videos.overview: It's the day Maari decides who will fight for his son's drunk-driving case. Veni's team feels the case is airtight. But Yazhini secures the evidence needed to challenge them.

videos.title: Alone
videos.overview: Before the drunk-driving case hearing begins, Deva is forced to leave, compelling Yazhini to take over. She begins confidently until an unexpected witness is brought in.

videos.title: Do I Belong?
videos.overview: Maari brings his goons to threaten Deva. Just as Yazhini begins questioning her choice of profession, she comes across a desperate woman with a case that nobody wants.

videos.title: Courage
videos.overview: Yazhini moves into a new home, and who her roommate is shocks her. Despite Deva and Veni's refusal and her father's disapproval, she commits to fight Anitha's case.

videos.title: Hustle
videos.overview: Yazhini and Deva discover that the ATM robbery may not be done by everyday thieves. Determined to help Anitha, she follows a disturbing trail leading to a surrogacy clinic.

videos.title: Counterattack
videos.overview: Armed with a new strategy, Yazhini enters court to fight for the abandoned special-needs child. When the defence tries to bury the truth, Yazhini turns their evidence against them.

videos.title: Hangover
videos.overview: After her first victory, Yazhini struggles with her father's absence. When an ailing Deva collapses before Kumaran's hearing, she is forced to take his place in court.

videos.title: The Grind
videos.overview: While Deva recuperates, Yazhini struggles to find a paying client. Meanwhile, Shailaja takes on a high-stakes corporate espionage case.

videos.title: No Money, No Honey
videos.overview: Veni prepares to take on Pandiyaraj in the Bar Association election. As Yazhini discovers the true cost of fighting Arun's case, a shocking demand leaves her trapped.

videos.title: Reckoning
videos.overview: At the court, Pandiyaraj plays dirty and threatens Sathyan. When Yazhini returns home for her mother's death anniversary, although the day goes well, the dinner goes downhill.

videos.title: Renewed Hope
videos.overview: Determined to prove herself, Yazhini embraces Deva's methods and begins searching for a high-value client. Veni finds out why Sathyan didn't tell her about Pandiyaraj's party.

videos.title: First Catch
videos.overview: While Veni finds a new way to revive her campaign, Viswa takes an early lead in the client challenge. Just as Yazhini begins to lose hope, an unexpected call changes everything.

videos.title: Hidden
videos.overview: Shailaja confides a long-kept secret with Yazhini. Deva's past returns with a case. Meanwhile, an overlooked clause threatens to turn Yazhini's first major client against her.

videos.title: Hunger
videos.overview: Muthu gets violent when a creditor harasses Keerthana for money. At court, Viswa and Keerthana fight for a humiliated delivery worker, and outside, Yazhini rescues Sheeba's case.

videos.title: The Stranger
videos.overview: Deva and Yazhini begin a confidential audit after the bank uncovers an insider's role in the ATM robbery. Meanwhile, a stranger's arrival leaves Deva shaken and Amreen humiliated.

videos.title: Collateral
videos.overview: As Yazhini uncovers suspicious collateral-free loans during the audit, Deva makes a painful sacrifice to meet the stranger's demand. On the other side, Muthu faces a crisis.

videos.title: Rejections
videos.overview: Along with the bank audit that uncovers a dubious ex-employee, Deva and Yazhini pursue a high-stakes corporate case. Will they succeed, or will it be another rejection?

videos.title: Head On
videos.overview: The bank's audit uncovers a network of shell companies and more secrets. When Thivi's Annual Day function begins, Deva receives a call, and he races to settle a dangerous debt.

tt43407940.name: Thella Kaagitham
tt43407940.description: Two teenagers discover first love amid the innocence, mischief, and uncertainties of adolescence. As they fall deeper for each other, the choices they make begin to carry consequences neither is prepared for.

tt47657999.name: Reporting Live
tt47657999.description: A young reporter and her reluctant cameraman chase a story, only to get entangled in an illegal sand-mining racket run by a ruthless syndicate.

tt44941753.name: The One About Matthew Perry
tt44941753.description: Through personal accounts from family and friends, this documentary unveils the real Matthew Perry, generous, funny, vulnerable, larger than life, and his struggles to become the man behind the icon.

videos.name: Part I
videos.overview: Matthew goes from class clown to aspiring actor hoping to make it big. When he’s cast on a new sitcom called “Friends,” his life changes forever.
videos.description: Matthew goes from class clown to aspiring actor hoping to make it big. When he’s cast on a new sitcom called “Friends,” his life changes forever.

videos.name: Part II
videos.overview: As his battle with addiction becomes more public, Matthew struggles to balance his career with a worsening cycle of rehab and relapse.
videos.description: As his battle with addiction becomes more public, Matthew struggles to balance his career with a worsening cycle of rehab and relapse.

videos.name: Part III
videos.overview: After surviving a harrowing medical scare, Matthew hopes a promising new drug treatment will aid his recovery, but it spirals instead to a fatal tragedy.
videos.description: After surviving a harrowing medical scare, Matthew hopes a promising new drug treatment will aid his recovery, but it spirals instead to a fatal tragedy.

tt37894980.name: Aasha
tt37894980.description: A stubborn, short-tempered woman named Aasha gets into an altercation with Jeemon over a road accident. She is resolved to pursue a case against him, while he threatens her with serious consequences.

tt43639419.name: Land of Football
tt43639419.description: From the mud-slicked night tournaments to the World Cup flex-board wars, this is a deep dive into the obsessive and deep-rooted football culture of Kerala.

videos.title: The First Believers
videos.overview: Long before television, there were the writers. A pioneering generation of Malayalam journalists built an extraordinary football culture using nothing but ink and imagination.

videos.title: The Keepers of the Game
videos.overview: A nonagenarian coach nurturing young talent, legendary players and the electrifying Sevens football: follow the story of those who shape Kerala's love for the beautiful game.

videos.title: The Home Ground
videos.overview: Football in Kerala is deeply personal. From homes divided by club rivalries to families united behind a child's dream, the game is inseparable from Kerala's cultural identity.

tt31969655.name: The Paradise
tt31969655.description: In 1980s Secunderabad, a marginalized tribe battles discrimination and fights for citizenship under an unexpected leader's guidance, challenging systemic oppression.

tt31989291.name: Super Subbu
tt31989291.description: An unlucky teacher is assigned to teach sex ed in a hostile village. Can he balance this secret while chasing his dreams and saving his relationship?

videos.title: Subbu S/o Kukku
videos.overview: Subbu struggles to free himself from his strict father's watch and commit to a future with his girlfriend. But an unexpected opportunity soon arises.

videos.title: Welcome to Makhipur
videos.overview: After a month of training, Subbu arrives in Makhipur and meets Kantha Rao. A session on consent for the village women draws the anger of their husbands.

videos.title: Virginee!
videos.overview: Subbu faces mockery after a classroom demonstration goes wrong. Desperate to educate himself, he seeks help but his own guilt gets in the way.

videos.title: The Man, The Mission
videos.overview: A lie leads to Subbu becoming an overnight hero. Swathi and Kantha Rao help him connect with the women of Makhipur. A hazy night leaves Subbu anxious.

videos.title: Family Planning
videos.overview: Subbu's family surprises him as he scrambles to meet his targets and hide his profession. An unexpected development leaves him stunned.

videos.title: The Mystery Girl
videos.overview: Subbu's teaching efforts finally start to pay off. A heartbroken Swathi turns to him for comfort. At a celebration, Ramesh Babu makes a major claim.

videos.title: Subbu vs Kukku
videos.overview: A secret turns Makhipur against Subbu. As his relationships with his father and Swathi evolve, will luck finally side with him?

tt36300841.name: Awarapan 2
tt36300841.description: Shivam returns to the crime world, where his path forward demands redemption, love, and sacrifice. As relationships deepen and conflicts intensify, every choice tests his resolve and shapes his destiny.

tt35963439.name: It's a Medical Miracle
tt35963439.description: A young man declared brain-dead suddenly awakens with the ability to hear everything. Seeking the nurse whose voice saved him, he's drawn into a dark game of masks, memories, and revenge where every sound may be a clue or a trap.

tt42071698.name: Cousins and Kalyanams
tt42071698.description: A 26-year tale of six cousins in Kerala whose lives and relationships revolve around seven weddings.

videos.title: The Grand Plan
videos.overview: On the eve of Manu's wedding with Veena, he and Diya decide to elope with the help of their four close confidante cousins.

videos.title: The Kiss
videos.overview: At Manu’s wedding, the cousins search for a missing Diya. She arrives and kisses Manu on stage, shocking the families and creating chaos at the wedding, revealing hidden history.

videos.title: Back Together
videos.overview: The cousins reunite at another wedding after ten years. Though Manu feels out of place, the others pull him back into the group and slowly try to rebuild their frayed bond.

videos.title: The Beach Story
videos.overview: Manu insists Diya show him the beach. A casual beach outing turns dangerous when Manu nearly drowns, and Diya is forced to rescue him.

videos.title: Ashwathy's CD
videos.overview: Ashwathy gets a mysterious CD that sparks Diya's curiosity. What begins as a secret plan to watch it alone creates chaos when the cousins find out, turning into a comic showdown.

videos.title: The Hard Goodbye
videos.overview: As the wedding celebrations end, the cousins face an emotional goodbye. Manu's attempt to confess his feelings to Diya goes awry, leaving them to part ways on uncertain terms.

videos.title: Four Years Later
videos.overview: At another wedding, adulthood reshapes identities. Old feelings resurface when Manu meets Diya again. New rival Prajith enters, determined to impress her and disrupt emotions.

videos.title: Disco Diya
videos.overview: A playful mishap sparks old childhood memories. As Prajith boldly pursues Diya, Manu finds himself torn between confidence and self-doubt over his feelings.

videos.title: The Family Video
videos.overview: The cousins collaborate on a wedding video project. Prajith manipulates the elders to present himself as Diya’s ideal match, intensifying rivalry as Manu silently grows uneasy.

videos.title: Onam Games
videos.overview: Festive games revive childhood chemistry. Prajith tries to impress Diya but fails when he cheats. Manu’s calm composure earns Diya’s admiration, melting the emotional distance.

videos.title: Marriage Talks
videos.overview: The elders subtly push Prajith as Diya’s groom. Family interviews unexpectedly expose old property disputes, revealing unresolved generational tensions beneath celebrations.

videos.title: Old Photos
videos.overview: Family conflicts escalate but resolve through emotional conversations. Manu and Diya share an honest discussion about life, marking a turning point in emotional openness.

videos.title: The Secret
videos.overview: While Sanskriti seeks answers about Manu, Prajith tries to open up to Diya about his feelings. Will their search for the truth bring them closer or strain their relationships?

videos.title: The Roast Disaster
videos.overview: After Prajith hacks Chandu's computer, a roast video plays during the wedding, sparking a major family feud. As tensions rise, Megha boldly confronts the elders.

videos.title: Silent Rift
videos.overview: Chandu and Ashwathy clash over personal matters, driving a wedge between them. On the other hand, Manu is disheartened when he notices Prajith and Diya together.

videos.title: Confession Plan
videos.overview: Manu's plans to confess his love take a dramatic turn when Diya uncovers the truth about the two-timing. Elsewhere, Nima is left shaken after learning the truth about Chandu.

videos.title: Cousins Who Meet at Weddings
videos.overview: Diya tells Manu they should stay like cousins who meet at weddings. The fractured group drifts apart, but Chandu comforts Manu, promising things will mend by the next wedding

videos.title: The Problem Wedding
videos.overview: The cousins return for the next wedding, older now and carrying the weight of things life has taught them. But, this gathering feels different, a threat looms over the celebration.

videos.title: Old Wounds, New Love
videos.overview: Manu's old wounds with his mother reopen as she arrives for the wedding. Meanwhile, Diya stays glued to her phone with Jay, her new lover, as Manu watches in silence.

videos.title: Love Coach Chandu
videos.overview: Manu can't bear losing Diya. Chandu steps in as his love coach, training him Chandu-style to win her back. Meanwhile Prajith returns and is back to his old antics.

videos.title: Two Slaps and a Brawl
videos.overview: Chandu's coaching backfires. At the mall, Megha slaps Joshy for harassing the girls. When Manu defends Megha, his mother slaps him to avoid another family rift, and he storms out.

videos.title: The Walk Back
videos.overview: Diya finds Manu alone at a shop. When he opens up about his loneliness and beliefs in marriage, she silences a call from Jay. They share a tender evening under the stars.

videos.title: Unsettled
videos.overview: While Manu and Diya find a new rhythm, Megha drifts away from the cousins, as she gets blamed for Manu's walkout. Meanwhile, the antagonists quietly regroup to stop the wedding.

videos.title: In Her Defence
videos.overview: Diya defends Ashwathy when a relative's wedding proposal sparks a sharp remark from her. Meanwhile, Chandu falls for Roshini, and Megha quietly makes peace.

videos.title: Highs and Loss
videos.overview: A surprise terrace party leads to emotional confessions while Manu and Chandu dodge chores. Things take an unexpected turn when an intoxicated Diya pulls Manu towards her.

videos.title: A Ride to Remember
videos.overview: Diya persuades Manu to take her to Nakshathra Thadakam. Amidst an exchange of heartfelt conversations, Manu is suddenly jolted by an unexpected call from Sanoop.

videos.title: Police Chaos
videos.overview: Diya and Manu engage in a deep conversation about Manu's family. Tensions rise as Chandu's group and the groom set to marry the next morning are arrested for drunk driving.

videos.title: D-Day Duels
videos.overview: Fun chaos breaks at the registrar office on the wedding day while Manu teases Diya that she said she likes him. Chandu then learns a shocking revelation about the girl he likes.

videos.title: Wedding Night
videos.overview: The roadblock turns into a celebratory convoy of relatives. Sanoop's first-night preparations descend into hilarious chaos as his cousins relentlessly tease him.

videos.title: The Full Stop
videos.overview: As Sanoop's wedding celebrations wind down, everyone begins to leave. At the bus stand, Manu finally confesses his feelings to Diya, but she rejects him in favour of Jay.

videos.title: End of Days and Rays of Hope
videos.overview: Prajith is preparing to get married but faces a significant challenge, Covid. Despite the restrictions, guests arrive to celebrate him while following safety precautions.

videos.title: Social Distancing
videos.overview: Prajith's lockdown wedding spirals into socially distanced chaos and masked photos. Just as Manu plans an early escape, an unexpected twist gives him a reason to stay.

videos.title: Quarantine 'Tharavadu'
videos.overview: Locked in the ancestral house, the cousins turn quarantine into a reality show under Prabhakaran's command. A late-night confession round brings long-buried heartbreaks to light.

videos.title: Ceasefires
videos.overview: As Manu and Diya call an uneasy truce, Megha's secret relationship raises alarm among the cousins. Meanwhile, a prank on Aswathy's online class pushes her to a breaking point.

videos.title: The Escape
videos.overview: Ashwathy finds her fire again. Restless in quarantine, Chandu, Manu and Diya sneak out for a night in town. But the adventure spirals into a police chase through empty streets.

videos.title: The Ambulance Ride
videos.overview: Stranded after a curfew, Manu and Diya find an unlikely ride home in an ambulance. As they laugh through the fear, the old walls between them finally begin to crumble.

videos.title: The Balcony Confession
videos.overview: A football injury leaves Diya hurt and humiliated. On a quiet balcony at night, Manu finally opens his heart to her and a single moment changes their relationship forever.

videos.title: A New Day
videos.overview: Free of her past, Diya embraces a new beginning and helps Megha break away from Shaan. But as quarantine nears its end, she realises that she isn't ready to let this world go.

videos.title: The Full Stop
videos.overview: On their last night together, the cousins celebrate. Manu and Diya share a dance to remember. But one conversation the next morning threatens to end their story before it begins.

videos.title: The Return
videos.overview: Three years on, life has moved forward for everyone except Diya, who seems withdrawn since her mother's death. Coaxed to attend a wedding, she comes face-to-face with Manu again.

videos.title: Old Wounds
videos.overview: Manu and Diya navigate an awkward reunion while old family tensions resurface. As Haldi preparations begin, secrets simmer beneath the cousins' laughter and chaos.

videos.title: Stealing the Show
videos.overview: Veena's Haldi ceremony turns into a battle of egos as the cousins scramble to save face. Diya's unexpected performance stirs up feelings no one saw coming.

videos.title: Juice and Judgment
videos.overview: A prank meant to embarrass Veena spirals into public humiliation. Manu finds himself torn between duty and feelings he can't quite bury.

videos.title: The Ultimatum
videos.overview: Fallout from the prank threatens to unravel the wedding, forcing Manu into a confrontation that tests just how far he'll go to keep the peace.

videos.title: Cracks Before the Sangeet
videos.overview: As the sangeet nears, tensions rise over Megha's troubled relationship and old rivalries. A devastating message pushes Manu closer to a dangerous breaking point.

videos.title: Breaking Point
videos.overview: As celebrations continue, family conflicts boil over and Manu spirals further into heartbreak, leaving the cousins scrambling to hold things together.

videos.title: The Long Way Home
videos.overview: A raw, unfiltered night on the road forces Manu and Diya to finally confront everything left unsaid between them… and everything they still can't say.

videos.title: Second Thoughts
videos.overview: In the dead of night, Diya makes a decision that could change everything; one that puts her, Manu, and the family's fragile peace on the line.

videos.title: The Elopement
videos.overview: A daring plan sets the cousins into motion as Diya and Manu chase one last chance at the life they never got to have.

videos.title: Back to the Kiss
videos.overview: Diya's world comes crashing down as the day takes a turn no one could have predicted and the cousins are left to pick up the pieces.

videos.title: Three Years Later
videos.overview: With the past behind her, Diya has built a quiet life away from everyone. But a familiar face and a cousin gathering bring old memories rushing back.

videos.title: Old Photographs, New Beginnings
videos.overview: An old photograph reopens wounds Diya thought she had buried. Amid a lively shopping spree for Megha's wedding, the cousins reunite, with Diya eventually joining them for dinner.

videos.title: One Night, Not Yet Ready
videos.overview: As Megha's big day draws closer, a tearful reunion and a tense family meet test just how ready Diya really is to let this family back into her life

videos.title: Athirappilly
videos.overview: The cousins gather for another wedding. Old wounds and new beginnings collide against the stunning backdrop of Athirappilly.

videos.title: Family Ties
videos.overview: Family loyalties are tested as old grudges resurface and a shocking threat forces the cousins to close ranks around one of their own.

videos.title: Confronting the Truth
videos.overview: The cousins confront a painful truth head-on, in a night that tests just how far they'll go to protect their family.

videos.title: Truths Revealed
videos.overview: Long-buried secrets finally come to light as the celebrations reach a fever pitch, and a surprising revelation changes everything for Manu.

videos.title: A Prickly Conscience
videos.overview: On the day of the wedding, a hidden truth from the past surfaces, sending Diya on a search that could change the course of her life.

videos.title: Above the Falls
videos.overview: At the waterfalls, Manu and Diya finally say the things they have carried in their hearts for years… and make a choice that will define them.

videos.title: Full Circle
videos.overview: As one journey ends, the cousins send off one of their own in true chaotic fashion. Just then, an old story finds its way back to where it began.

tt33095205.name: Enna Vilai
tt33095205.description: A humble fisherman from Rameswaram lives a quiet life with his family until he finds a gold pendant washed ashore. What initially seems like a blessing soon turns into a nightmare when false accusations threaten his peace and dignity, forcing him to stand up against a powerful system.

tt42602688.name: Naa Wife Missing
tt42602688.description: A newly married couple's happy life takes a mysterious turn when the wife suddenly disappears. As the husband seeks help, doubts about her past and hidden secrets begin to surface.

tt40857820.name: Isakapatnam
tt40857820.description: Set in the 1990s, in the ruthless port town of Isakapatnam, three forces collide—a woman driven by justice, a henchman torn by loyalty, and a common man hungry for revenge—each closing in on the empire built by the port’s most powerful man, Naidu.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: In 1985, Naidu arrives in Isakapatnam and finds the town divided by a conflict between Chinnarao and Pothana. He uses the tension to establish himself. By 1995, Naidu holds significant power but faces new challenges from police action, political rivals, and shifting alliances.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: A childhood lesson from her mother, shapes Bharathi's outlook. CI Varma's attempt to take charge at Kobbarithota puts him at odds with Peddanna. A gas explosion at Kobbari Thota causes widespread chaos, and Peddanna rushes to help, but the stakes quickly become deeply personal

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Blame for the Kobbari Thota blast falls on Naidu, but Bharathi continues to aid the victims despite the backlash. Peddanna leads a protest demanding accountability, resulting in arrests later resolved by bharathi. Naidu tactically advances his plans and secures a significant alliance, leaves Bharathi in shock.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Bharathi prepares for wedding with Pratap Varma that threatens her freedom. As Naidu carefully turns the alliance to his advantage, rivals begin to fall. Heartbreak, humiliation, and rebellion grow around her, Bharathi takes a drastic measure which reshapes the course of events in Isakapatnam.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Bharathi's actions lead to Soori's arrest. Naidu moves ahead with plans to send shipments. Aware of the relationship between Bharathi and Soori, Naidu targets Soori, putting his loyalties to the test. Bharathi takes over the NGO and a violent clash between Peddanna and Raju leaves Raju gravely injured.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Naidu moves consignments through the port as tensions rise around him. Bharathi steps in to stop CI Varma from questioning Raju. Naidu offers corporater seat to pedanna. A failed attempt on Raju produces an unexpected outcome that benefits Soori, while Shekhar's actions quietly shift the balance within Naidu's inner circle.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: A sudden death at Naidu's house leaves him stunned. Soori uncovers details about the trucks carrying consignment, raising new conflicts. Tragedy strikes Peddanna's family, setting off a chain of events and Bharathi becomes a key player, orchestrating a plan that brings Naidu's rule to an end.

tt31924038.name: Lingam
tt31924038.description: Framed for a crime he didn't commit, a kabaddi hero gets pushed into a world he never wanted and ultimately becomes a feared name.

videos.title: First Wave of the Ocean
videos.overview: Lingam's long-awaited police appointment is delayed, pushing him into a high-stakes tournament. But when a fierce match turns violent, a shocking murder changes everything.

videos.title: Shadow of the Cry
videos.overview: The police finally track down Lingam. Inside the prison, he endures brutal torture, humiliation and violence that slowly harden him into a ruthless and emotionally scarred man.

videos.title: The Fury of Fate
videos.overview: The cops harass Lingam by making him the go-to suspect for any crime. Chelladurai also underhandedly uses him as a henchman. Pushed to his limits, Lingam's anger boils over.

videos.title: The Sea Rises
videos.overview: Lingam joins Chellapandian's illicit liquor network and plays a major role in expanding his business. After saving his boss from a deadly attack, Lingam earns his trust.

videos.title: The Season of Betrayal
videos.overview: Lingam marries Ponmalar, hoping to finally build a peaceful life. But a conspiracy unfolds involving poisoned liquor. Enraged, Lingam begins hunting down those responsible.

videos.title: The Chill of a Mild Tremor
videos.overview: Driven by revenge for Chellapandian's death, Lingam hunts down Samiyappan. While helping a young couple, he finds himself in a crisis and is compelled to go into hiding.

videos.title: The Breaking Palm Tree
videos.overview: Lingam rises as the undisputed kingpin of Kanyakumari. As his friendship with Thiru deteriorates, Lingam discovers the puppeteer pulling Chellapandian and Samiyappan's strings.

videos.title: The Burning Sea
videos.overview: Devastated by Bhaskar's death, Lingam swears revenge against Chelladurai, adding to his mother's misery. Lingam gives Chelladurai 30 days to prepare for the consequences.

tt27050858.name: Drishyam: The Conclusion
tt27050858.description: Follows the Salgaonkar family as they try to cover up a murder.

tt38265603.name: Pradhama Drishtiya Kuttakkar
tt38265603.description: Follows a woman constable who joins the police force through appointment after the death of her husband.

tt43490036.name: Second Marriage
tt43490036.description: Second Marriage is an emotional romantic comedy about two beautifully imperfect people who give marriage another chance. Packed with quirky humor, heartfelt emotions, and relatable moments, the series feels like a warm hug.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: On their wedding night, Aakash and Chandini navigate the awkwardness of being strangers turned partners, opening up through honest, unfiltered conversations.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Despite agreeing to give Chandini the time and space she needs to heal from her past, Aakash gradually falls in love with her and tries harder to bridge the emotional gap between them.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: After overhearing Chandini describe their marriage as suffocating, a hurt Aakash withdraws emotionally and discovers a hidden, artistic side of her that deepens his understanding of who she truly is.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: After leaving for her parents’ village following a painful misunderstanding, Chandini opens up about her struggles and gains a new perspective on Aakash through her mother’s heartfelt insights.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Aakash’s Employee of the Year celebration brings joy and pride to the couple as they openly share their happiness with his colleagues.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Haunted by the hurtful words she spoke in anger, Chandini desperately tries to mend her relationship with Aakash, only to find him emotionally withdrawn and distant.

tt21378820.name: Pooja Meri Jaan
tt21378820.description: When free-spirited Pooja rejects her long-time friend Aniket's sudden proposal, he dies by suicide and leaves an email blaming her. Facing public outrage and an abetment charge, a guilt-ridden Pooja turns to lawyer-friend Sana.

tt36596965.name: Mandaadi
tt36596965.description: A fishing captain applies his maritime knowledge in a traditional boat race along Tamil Nadu's coast during a festival, leading a six-person team against other crews.

tt41962673.name: Brothers and Sisters
tt41962673.description: Bound by love and unspoken truths, Shanmuga Sundaram and his devoted family's lives revolve around shared rituals... till hidden cracks begin to surface.

videos.title: The House of SS
videos.overview: Meet the family of SS and his devoted wife, along with their beautiful children. In Bengaluru, their first daughter Jayshree's live-in boyfriend goes missing.

videos.title: Jayshree's Second Chance
videos.overview: Priyan saves Jayshree after her drastic decision. SS and his family are unable to contact her. Meanwhile, Siddharth opens up to his mother about his feelings for Harini.

videos.title: Priyan Guides Jayshree
videos.overview: As Jayshree struggles to cope, Priyan makes her face reality and persuades her to return to the warmth of her family. Back at home, Meera gives SS a makeover.

videos.title: Harini vs Jayshree's Secret
videos.overview: Jayshree returns home and manages to hide her secret. However, Harini begins to sense that something is wrong and suspects that she is hiding a problem.

videos.title: Harini Stands by Jayshree
videos.overview: SS rejects Ponmalar's brother Azhagar's marriage proposal for Jayshree. Meanwhile, Harini takes Jayshree for counseling to help her feel better.

videos.title: Harini Meets Siddharth's Mother
videos.overview: SS gets the jewels from Ponmalar to secure funds for Girija's investment in a new house. Meanwhile, Siddharth's mother pays a visit to his office to meet his love interest, Harini.

videos.title: New Opportunity for Jayshree
videos.overview: When Harini looks for a lawyer's job for Jayshree, Siddharth uses his connections and helps her get a job. His father is surprised and questions him about his unusual behaviour.

videos.title: Jaggu and Madhu Grow Closer
videos.overview: Jaggu and Madhu find themselves growing closer as new feelings spark between them. Meanwhile, Girija celebrates a fresh start by hosting a grand house-warming function.

videos.title: Siddharth Faces Roshini's Love
videos.overview: Despite Girija's objections, Madhu visits jail to meet someone. Following his mother's advice, Siddharth asks Roshini to move out of his cabin. But Roshini has different plans.

videos.title: Harini Opens Up
videos.overview: Ashwin gives Meera a hard time about her siblings' attitude towards him. Meanwhile, Harini shares her budding love interest with Jayshree.

videos.title: Jayshree's Dilemma
videos.overview: Jayshree unexpectedly meets Priyan and learns of his situation. On the marriage front, things move too fast for Jayshree, but Harini convinces her to agree for now.

videos.title: Jaggu's Shocking Discovery
videos.overview: Girija asks SS to accompany her to a friend's wedding. At Jaggu's DJ gig, he sees something that shakes his world.

videos.title: SS's Secret Shocks the Family
videos.overview: Jaggu discovers a startling truth about SS and confides in his sisters. Together, they decide to keep their mother unaware of the situation.

videos.title: Jaggu Presents the Proof
videos.overview: As his sisters struggle to accept it, Jaggu presents proof of SS's affair. Unaware of the growing tension, SS remains busy preparing for the groom's visit to see Jayshree.

videos.title: Humiliation Strikes Jayshree
videos.overview: When the groom publicly reveals the truth about Jayshree, Ponmalar collapses from the shock. While Jaggu watches helplessly, Priyan steps in to comfort a devastated Jayshree.

videos.title: SS Realises His Love for Ponmalar
videos.overview: After regaining consciousness, Ponmalar asks for Jayshree. Watching SS care for Ponmalar, Jaggu and his sisters begin to realise the depth of his feelings for her.

videos.title: Jaggu's Outburst
videos.overview: Jaggu comes home drunk and has a heated argument with his sisters. He accuses Jayshree of being responsible for their mother's condition, leaving her feeling hurt.

videos.title: A Home Filled with Care
videos.overview: As Ponmalar gets discharged from the hospital, the girls take charge of the cooking and other chores. Ponmalar talks to SS about getting Jayshree married to her brother, Keerthi.

videos.title: Ponmalar Fixes Jayshree's Alliance
videos.overview: Madhu feels Jaggu is distancing himself from her. Meanwhile, Jayshree is unable to voice her feelings after Ponmalar convinces her brother and finalises her alliance with Keerthi.

videos.title: SS Under Scrutiny
videos.overview: Girija takes SS to an Ayurvedic clinic for Ponmalar’s medicines. While Ponmalar is happy with his care and concern, Jaggu questions him about his mysterious hospital visit.

videos.title: Harini Says No
videos.overview: SS agrees to a marriage between Jayshree and Ponmalar's brother, Keerthi. During a car ride, Siddharth insists on taking Harini out for a lunch date, much to Harini's displeasure.

videos.title: Jaggu Learns About Madhu's Family
videos.overview: Jayshree meets Priyan and tells him about her marriage alliance with her relative and her decision to reveal her secrets. Meanwhile, Jaggu meets Madhu and digs into her family.

videos.title: The Children Plot Against SS
videos.overview: SS asks Ponmalar to accompany him to secure a loan for the shop. However, Jaggu and his sisters decide to stop them.

videos.title: Jayshree Tells the Truth
videos.overview: SS vents his frustration to Girija about the business loan issue. When Ponmalar's relatives arrive to finalise the wedding, Jayshree decides to reveal the truth to Keerthi.

videos.title: SS Chooses Girija
videos.overview: After Keerthy rejects the marriage, SS and Jayshree hide it from Ponmalar. SS plans a trip to Ahmedabad to procure stock for Ponmalar Textiles and asks Girija to accompany him.

videos.title: Madhu Convinces Girija!
videos.overview: Madhu encourages Girija not to accompany SS on the Ahmedabad trip, accusing the latter of being selfish. Meanwhile, Jaggu strikes up a new friendship with Meena.

videos.title: SS's Silent Hurt
videos.overview: Jayshree and her sisters plan to reunite their parents by making Ponmalar sleep in their father's room. SS is deeply hurt when they question his business decisions.

videos.title: A Twist on Madhu's Birthday
videos.overview: After Girija leaves for Ahmedabad with SS, Madhu is left alone on her birthday. She invites Jaggu to her house and feeling sorry for her, he visits her. But a surprise awaits him.

videos.title: Meera's Smart Move
videos.overview: As SS leaves for Ahmedabad with Girija, Jaggu and the sisters try to disrupt their trip. Meera’s smart move of joining Ponmalar Textiles surprises everyone.

videos.title: Harini's Unexpected Demand
videos.overview: Harini agrees to accept Siddharth's love with a shocking condition, leaving him torn. Meanwhile, Ponmalar discovers why Keerthi rejected the wedding proposal.

videos.title: SS Under Meera's Watch
videos.overview: After the family's pleas, SS lets Meera intern at Ponmalar textiles. However, rather than concentrating on her training, Meera remains highly observant of SS's every action.

videos.title: Girija Seeks SS's Support
videos.overview: Girija opposes Madhu's love interest, leading to a rift between them. She hopes for support from SS. A heated argument between Priyan and Jayshree unexpectedly brings them closer.

videos.title: SS Lies to Ponmalar
videos.overview: Madhu's hospitalisation forces SS to rush to her and her mother, but Ponmalar has questions. Meanwhile, Siddharth goes to Girija's apartment building in search of a new house.

videos.title: Siddharth Alarms Harini with Truth
videos.overview: Siddharth agrees to Harini's request to live near Girija's house and reveals that he knows the truth. Girija catches Madhu on a call with Jaggu and questions her.

videos.title: Jayshree, Priyan's Special Moment
videos.overview: SS rages at Girija for visiting his shop when his daughter is present. Jayshree helps Priyan admit his pregnant sister to the hospital and they share a heartfelt moment together.

videos.title: Siddharth Takes Harini Home
videos.overview: Priyan is deeply touched as Jayshree gets nutritious postnatal meal for his sister at the hospital. Siddharth introduces Harini to his mother. Velpandi spots them and gets upset.

videos.title: Madhu's Love Confession
videos.overview: Madhu bares her heart to Jaggu, but his unexpected response leaves her shattered. Meanwhile, Siddharth performs his house-warming ceremony and meets Girija.

videos.title: Jayshree's Fumble
videos.overview: Siddharth plays the good neighbour to Girija when she is away from home. Ponmalar again coaxes Jayshree to consider marrying. To pacify her, Jayshree blurts out a lie.

videos.title: Ponmalar Meets Priyan
videos.overview: SS resists the auditor's pressure to sell his textile business as Jaggu seeks a solution. At the hospital, Ponmalar runs into Priyan and mistakes his and Jayshree's bond for love.

videos.title: SS Draws the Line
videos.overview: As Thangam and her sons take charge of SS's security, SS asks Jaggu to end the arrangement. When SS confides in Girija, she advises him to sell Ponmalar Textiles.

videos.title: Madhu's Heartfelt Confession
videos.overview: As SS struggles with a crisis at Ponmalar Textiles, Jayshree offers legal help. Elsewhere, Madhu makes an emotional confession to Jaggu and questions why he cannot love her back.

videos.title: Ponmalar Meets Priyan's Family
videos.overview: Ponmalar decides to visit Priyan and his family to check on them, leaving Jayshree in shock. Meanwhile, Girija changes Madhu's mind and begins searching for a groom for her.

videos.title: SS Goes Missing
videos.overview: SS mysteriously goes missing, throwing Girija's household into chaos when the groom's family arrives. Ponmalar and her daughters desperately search for SS, fearing for his safety.

videos.title: Jaggu Seeks Thangam's Help
videos.overview: Jaggu approaches Meenu and asks for Thangam's help in finding his missing father. Meanwhile, Harini asks Siddharth to seek his father's assistance in moving the case forward.

videos.title: Girija Avoids SS
videos.overview: SS returns home after going missing for a night. Girija is angry with SS and refuses to answer his calls. As the stress builds, she faints, and Siddharth helps her.

videos.title: SS Faces Girija's Wrath
videos.overview: SS worries about Girija avoiding his calls and goes to her house. Once there, she vents her frustration and disappointment.

videos.title: Ponmalar Talks About Priyan
videos.overview: Madhu and Girija plan to rent out their house without SS's involvement. Ponmalar has a conversation with Jayshree about Priyan.

videos.title: Priyan Plays Reluctant Cupid
videos.overview: Baskar approaches Jayshree using Priyan's phone, creating friction between Jayshree and Priyan. Girija realises SS was indeed kidnapped.

videos.title: Jaggu Doubts Jayshree-Priyan's Bond
videos.overview: Jaggu spots Jayshree having tea with Priyan and suspects they are more than friends. He shares his doubts with Ponmalar, while Meera struggles to convince SS about online sales.

videos.title: Jayshree's Feelings Surface
videos.overview: Priyan's gift stirs new feelings in Jayshree. While the Ponmalar Textiles staff voice their concerns about online sales to SS, Girija reconciles with him and awaits his visit.

videos.title: A Critical Turn for Jaggu
videos.overview: Jaggu has been hospitalised following an accident, which has left SS feeling distressed. Meanwhile, Girija is anxiously waiting for SS at home, oblivious to the situation.

videos.title: Jaggu's Truth Reaches His Sisters
videos.overview: Madhu visits Jaggu in the hospital and lashes out at him for cheating on her. Meera, Harini and Jayshree witness the confrontation and discover the truth about their relationship.

videos.title: Jayshree’s Mission to Free Mohan
videos.overview: Jayshree meets Mohan in jail and promises to get him out. Since she needs Girija’s signature to appeal in court, she asks Siddharth to help reach out to Mohan’s daughter, Madhu.

videos.title: Siddharth Caught in SS’s Suspicion
videos.overview: Photographer Vivek makes Meera the model for Ponmalar Textiles’ photoshoot. The security guard mistakenly assumes Siddharth is meeting Girija and Madhu and informs SS about it.

videos.title: Madhu's Modelling Break
videos.overview: SS is upset with Vivek after seeing Meera as the model, while Vivek approaches Madhu for the next campaign. Elsewhere, Kala's visit to the doctor brings an unexpected twist.

videos.title: When Ponmalar Meets Madhu
videos.overview: Vivek's request for help with Madhu's saree brings Madhu and Ponmalar together for the first time. Elsewhere, Madhu and Girija seek a loan to kick-start their business.

videos.title: Jayshree’s Unexpected Shock
videos.overview: SS advises Girija against starting a business, while Mohan seeks financial aid from outside source. Jayshree visits Priyan to confess her feelings, but she is in for a big shock.

videos.title: Priyan Proposes to Jayshree!
videos.overview: Girija and Madhu are surprised when their loan gets approved by the bank. Meanwhile, Priyan proposes to Jayshree not knowing what she is going through.

videos.title: Velpandi’s Startling Decision
videos.overview: Jayshree confesses to Harini why she rejected Priyan’s love, while Priyan struggles with heartbreak. Siddhu is elated as Velpandi finally accepts Harini as his daughter-in-law.

videos.title: Velpandi Corners Harini
videos.overview: SS meets Punniyakodi for a groom for Jayshree, but Ponmalar understands her daughter’s plight. Harini visits Velpandi, whose strategic move could change the course of her wedding.

videos.title: Jayshree Draws the Line
videos.overview: Jaggu and his sisters learn about Girija’s new boutique. Jayshree meets Priyan and expresses her concerns about taking their relationship to the next level.

videos.title: Meera Caught in the Middle
videos.overview: Vivek gives Meera a ride home, but Ashwin notices them, and his insecurity leads to a major drama. Meanwhile, Jayshree finds a lead that could help her get Mohan released.

videos.title: Priyan Fights for Jayshree
videos.overview: Priyan is caught between his love for Jayshree and his sister’s opposition. Meanwhile, Madhu and Vivek grow closer while returning from a shoot.

videos.title: Brother and Sisters’ Masterplan
videos.overview: SS secretly plans to attend the Pooja at Girija’s boutique. Sensing his move, Meera alerts her siblings, and they hatch a masterplan to stop their father from reaching the shop

videos.title: SS' Disappointment Turns to Anger
videos.overview: As SS couldn't attend Girija's shop-opening ceremony, the emotional equation between him and Girija gets shaken, frustrating SS. Jaggu finds out who tried to run him down.

videos.title: SS and Girija's Growing Distance
videos.overview: Girija avoids SS after being disappointed with him. Meanwhile, SS is puzzled about who invited Punniyakodi to Girija's shop-opening ceremony.

videos.title: Kala's Wedding Pressure
videos.overview: Kala starts pressuring Siddharth and Velpandi to approach Harini's family about her son's wedding. Meanwhile, Ashwin becomes possessive about Meera and Vivek's friendship.

videos.title: SS Tries to Pacify Girija
videos.overview: Jayshree meets Priyan to seek his help in approaching a minister for Mohan's release. Meanwhile, SS tries to pacify Girija's anger by referring his customers to her shop.

videos.title: SS Begins to Suspect
videos.overview: Meena is angry with Jaggu for leaking the auditor’s video. SS gets wary that someone is trying to create a rift between him and Girija on learning about Madhu’s search for Chandra.

videos.title: Siddharth’s Clever Plan
videos.overview: Madhu gets furious with Girija for forgiving SS. Siddharth suggests that his parents, Kala and Velpandi visit bride Harini’s family, but without him.

videos.title: Jayshree Avoids the Awkwardness
videos.overview: Harini gets SS’s permission to arrange the groom’s visit at her house. Meanwhile, Jayshree leaves to visit Chandra on the same day to avoid the awkwardness at home.

videos.title: Jayshree Finally Finds Chandra
videos.overview: Siddharth’s parents visit SS’s house. While Jaggu insists that Jayshree’s marriage should happen first, Jayshree, Priyan, and Madhu finally find Chandra. Did she recognize them?

videos.title: Siddharth’s Lie Raises Doubts
videos.overview: SS learns that Madhu visited Chandra to seek her help in getting Mohan released. Ponmalar gets doubtful seeing Siddharth on the street as his parents had said that he was abroad.

videos.title: Jayshree Opens her Heart
videos.overview: Jayshree speaks her mind when Priyan’s brother-in-law convinces her to marry Priyan. Meanwhile, SS looks for a potential match for Jayshree through a matrimonial website.

videos.title: Priyan and Jayshree’s Plan
videos.overview: Priyan and Jayshree plan to convince his sister. Ponmalar contacts Kala for Siddharth’s horoscope. Later, Kala comes up with a master plan to make the wedding happen

videos.title: SS Tests Priyan
videos.overview: SS meets Priyan personally to determine whether he is the right match for Jayshree. Chandra comes to Ponmalar Textiles to visit SS.

videos.title: Jayshree’s Tough Task for Madhu
videos.overview: After Madhu gives Jayshree the NOC signed by Chandra, she gives her a tough task to complete. Meanwhile, Priyan finds it difficult to convince his sister to accept Jayshree.

videos.title: Jayshree Gives Priyan the Good News
videos.overview: Jayshree tells Priyan that her father wants to meet his sister and family to discuss the wedding. Meanwhile, Madhu shoots the coconut oil advertisement with Keerthi.

videos.title: SS Humiliates Siddharth
videos.overview: Jayshree confirms Mohan’s release, making Madhu happy. Meanwhile, Siddharth confronts Harini after he visits Ponmalar Textiles and SS humiliates him in front of everyone.

videos.title: Madhu Learns the Truth
videos.overview: Siddharth and Harini feel heartbroken after their fight. Meanwhile, Madhu learns the harsh truth about Jaggu and his decision to avoid her.

videos.title: Ponmalar Discovers Kala’s Secret
videos.overview: Jayshree tries to resolve the conflict between Harini and Siddharth. Meanwhile, Ponmalar meets Kala at the hospital and learns her truth and the urgency behind the wedding.

videos.title: Girija Seeks Divorce
videos.overview: Determined to move on from her bitter past with Mohan, Girija meets lawyer Leelavathy to proceed with the divorce. Jayshree is shocked by the turn of events.

videos.title: SS Discovers Madhu’s Ad Shoot
videos.overview: Ponmalar’s family visits Priyan’s house to formalise the wedding and proceed with the arrangements. Meanwhile, SS learns about Madhu doing an advertisement with Keerthi.

videos.title: SS Confronts Siddharth
videos.overview: Siddharth and Harini reconcile and decide to go ahead with the wedding. Harini takes SS to meet Siddharth. Seeing Siddharth, SS gets furious, but his questions leave him in shock.

videos.title: Siddharth’s Unexpected Move
videos.overview: Harini returns home in tears, fearing that her father has rejected Siddharth. Meanwhile, Siddharth tries to convince SS but makes a shocking move to win his approval.

videos.title: SS’s Family Visits Velpandi
videos.overview: SS and Ponmalar decide to sell their property to arrange finances for their daughters’ wedding. Later, the family visits Velpandi’s house to discuss the wedding arrangements.

videos.title: Double Date
videos.overview: Meena confesses her love to Jaggu but maintains a distance. Meanwhile, Jayshree and Priyan, along with Harini and Siddharth, go on a double date.

videos.title: Madhu Makes a Difficult Request
videos.overview: The police arrive to investigate and question Girija and Madhu regarding Mohan’s early release from jail, creating tension. Later, Madhu meets SS and makes a strange request.

tt6900448.name: Mirai
tt6900448.description: A young boy encounters a magical garden which enables him to travel through time and meet his relatives from different eras, with guidance by his younger sister from the future.
tt6900448.awards: Nominated for 1 Oscar. 5 wins & 36 nominations total

tt42656754.name: Memu Copulam
tt42656754.description: When a village’s star rooster vanishes, clueless cops Ravi and Mohan take the lead to solve the case. What starts as a hilarious search leads them to a conspiracy that threatens the entire community.

videos.title: The Missing Champion
videos.overview: ​A grand festival turns chaotic when a prized fighting rooster, Salaar Raju, goes missing before a championship. Two mismatched cops are brought in to investigate a hilarious web of village rivalries.

videos.title: Cooped Up Secrets
videos.overview: ​A midnight village meeting points to a deep conspiracy. While trailing clues, Mohan gets trapped inside a locked room and discovers that the prized champion was never actually missing.

videos.title: The Great Rooster Heist
videos.overview: ​A frantic hunt leads Ravi to a locked godown where he rescues the rooster. Just as they escape, Ravi intentionally releases the champion, leaving his partner shocked as a new hand captures it.

videos.title: The Silent Puppeteer
videos.overview: ​Media pressure grows as a fake rooster infuriates the owner. Meanwhile, an injured witness leaves cryptic clues at the hospital, suggesting an unknown force is controlling the investigation.

videos.title: The Disgraced Deputy
videos.overview: ​A drug raid backfires when the contraband turns out to be harmless, leaving Ravi publicly disgraced. As a damaging video of Ravi spreads, a furious Gajapathi Raju orders his immediate capture.

videos.title: An Unfinished Sentence
videos.overview: The truth unravels as the cops discover the champion rooster died from drug contamination. A tense village chase exposes the network, but the ultimate shift in power proves the game is far from over.

tt37535100.name: Bethlehem Kudumba Unit
tt37535100.description: Follows a couple with a significant age difference as they navigate their romantic relationship.

tt35448218.name: Epic - First Semester
tt35448218.description: Far from home, Aditya wrestles with family expectations, cultural differences and loneliness while studying in London – until he meets the lively Kadali.

tt32023291.name: Main Ladega
tt32023291.description: A young boy escapes his troubled home, finding solace I in boxing at an army hostel, where he channels his pain into strength to protect his family.

videos.name: Ghar Ki Kahaani, Help Ki Zubaani!
Romance with Twist- Fall in love
India Ki Demand aur Jodiyon Ka Reality Check
Dare, Drama and The Great Laddoo Rescue
Laughter Chef Meets Pati Patni Aur Panga!
From Panga to Poison... Naagin Takes Over
Who'll be the Sarvaguna Sampanna Jodi?
Grand Premiere: Let the Panga Begin!
Navratri Special: Festival with a Panga

tt37183128.name: Pati Patni Aur Panga
tt37183128.description: Famous couples face wild challenges testing their bonds and patience in a show full of laughs.

tt33029123.name: Hi :)
tt33029123.description: Two individuals initially exchange a simple "Hi," but through a series of chance encounters, shared experiences, and deep conversations, they gradually develop a strong connection and eventually fall in love.

tt39528902.name: Don't Be Shy!
tt39528902.description: Quintessential Mean Girl, Shyamili ‘Shy’ Das, finds herself suddenly relegated to Loser-ville when Mayank, her boyfriend of three years, suddenly dumps her. But Shy, all set to get her revenge, finds herself falling into friendship and compassion with someone unexpected… Mayank’s new girlfriend - Tara.

tt47743267.name: Ishqa Ishqa
tt47743267.description: Kabir is a successful writer dating Suhani, who brings calm to his life. As he prepares for the sequel to his hit novel Ishqa Ishqa, inspired by Arohi, his childhood love, she is set to return to his life. Arohi brings the inspiration he needs for his writing, but her return threatens to disrupt the life Kabir has built with Suhani.

videos.title: Dare Wala Pyaar
videos.overview: Kabir Bharadwaj, a celebrated writer, knows his childhood friend and ex-girlfriend Arohi can go to any length to reclaim what is hers. Their love was built on a game of dares. A year later, as their dare to stay away comes to an end, Kabir has moved on with Suhani while Arohi hasn't. She is coming back, ready to reclaim the love she never let go of.

videos.title: Purane Paap
videos.overview: Arohi tightens security after someone poisons her. Cracks emerge in Suhani's seemingly perfect family, raising questions about how normal they really are. Abir falls ill, bringing Arohi back into Kabir's life. Yadav is released on bail, looming as a threat to Arohi. Meanwhile, a ghost from Suhani's past returns to haunt her.

videos.title: Do Parivaar
videos.overview: Suhani and her parents visit the Bharadwaj house for wedding discussions, but their slip-ups about Suhani's past catch Arohi's attention. She begins digging into Suhani's identity and follows her, only to see her meet a mysterious man. Meanwhile, Abir makes a new friend at the park, unaware he has been sent by Yadav as part of his revenge plan.

videos.title: Pehli Mulaqaat
videos.overview: Arohi warns Kabir that Suhani's past holds secrets, but he refuses to believe her. Binoy meets Suhani and Kabir, posing as her colleague. Meanwhile, Vicky introduces Abir to a gun as part of Yadav's revenge plan. Unaware of Yadav's plan, Arohi arranges money to reclaim her mother's jewellery. With only three days left, she vows to uncover Suhani's truth.

videos.title: Purani Tasveer
videos.overview: Suhani's facade cracks when Binoy confronts her as Sumati, threatening to expose her past. Malini lets Abir go out with Vicky without Bhawani's permission, only for him to return with a secret gun. Meanwhile, Arohi tricks Suhani into revealing a mysterious photograph and dares Kabir to uncover the man's identity, leading him to Mohandas Purohit from Banaras.

videos.title: Sumati
videos.overview: Following Arohi's dare, Kabir travels to Banaras with her to uncover Mohandas Purohit's truth. With Binoy's help, Suhani tries to mislead them, but Arohi leads Kabir to Suhani's mother, Nirmala, who reveals her past and the shame that led to her father's death. Kabir is shaken by the truth.

videos.title: Uss Raat Ka Sach
videos.overview: In the past, Sumati and Binoy run a honey-trapping scam, but one case goes wrong and they are arrested. Arohi takes Kabir to the Banaras police station to expose Suhani's truth, but he refuses to believe she is a criminal. Through a text message, Suhani confesses her past to Kabir. Before Kabir can react, he learns Abir is in jail, unknowingly caught in Yadav's plan.

videos.title: Masoom
videos.overview: Kabir and Arohi rush to save Abir from jail and realize Yadav used Vicky to trap him. Meanwhile, Suhani sends Kavita and Bansal away, but Binoy questions her true motive. Arohi goes to confront Yadav, while Binoy attacks Dayaal and steals the money, leaving Arohi to find him critically wounded.

videos.title: Karz
videos.overview: Arohi risks her life to save Yadav's Rooplata and secures Abir's release. Kabir thanks her and takes responsibility for the childhood lake incident everyone blamed on her. Later, Dayaal reveals Binoy stole the money, making Arohi suspect Suhani. Kabir is conflicted, while Suhani meets Binoy and asks about the money.

videos.title: Dasvaan Din
videos.overview: Suhani warns Kabir that Binoy will attack Dayaal and returns with the stolen money, clearing Kabir's doubts. When Kabir chooses Suhani at the end of the ten-day dare, Arohi vows to make her pay. She kidnaps Suhani and traps her in a room swarming with wasps, as their mysterious past connection is revealed.

videos.title: Bisaat
videos.overview: Arohi reveals she saved Suhani from suicide and brought her into Kabir's life, setting the entire game in motion. Suhani survives the wasp trap and warns Arohi that she will expose her truth to Kabir if she interferes. Kabir gets a book deal in Mumbai and uses it to take Suhani and his family away from Arohi, leaving her heartbroken.

tt41101621.name: Habeebi
tt41101621.description: Follows a boy and girl in a Muslim neighbourhood in southern Tamil Nadu whose romance divides their community.

tt41971399.name: Romanchakam
tt41971399.description: An entrepreneur hoping to make money off romance ends up falling in love. But when she blocks him on social media, he tries to reignite their spark.

tt39073377.name: Ram and Leela
tt39073377.description: A repeatedly unlucky man finally finds the woman of his dreams, only for an unexpected twist to challenge his understanding of love and commitment.

tt38856253.name: EXAM
tt38856253.description: A determined young woman with a mysterious past enters the dangerous world of the Regional Public Service Exam (RPSE) scam to expose a powerful paper-leak network. But as she digs deeper, she uncovers a corruption chain embedded deep within the education system-and must bring it down before it destroys the dreams of an entire generation.

videos.title: Two-Headed Serpent
videos.overview: Based on his excellent academic record, a poor fisherwoman dreams of her son becoming a government officer one day. DSP Maramalli is transferred to Thykara police station a week ahead of the highly competitive RPSE exams. Jhansi pulls off a high-risk stunt, leaving Maramalli helpless. A nervous Jhansi takes over as DSP. Can Jhansi's deception hold against the truth?

videos.title: The Path to the Unknown Destiny
videos.overview: Reeling from the loss of his mother, the fisherwoman's son becomes disillusioned after a wealthy woman reveals how her son became a coveted government officer. In Thykara, Jhansi, guided by her mentor Jayachandran, starts investigating RPSE training institutions. Maramalli continues to fight a silent battle. Jhansi's mask is at risk when uninvited guests show up at the police station.

videos.title: The Faceless Shadow
videos.overview: With his hopes crushed, yet his mind sharp as ever, the fisherwoman's son seeks Shanti Amma's help to land a new job. Jhansi convinces Maramalli's mother that Maramalli is on a covert undercover operation and must not be disturbed. Jhansi resorts to aggression to further unearth the scam. Maramalli gets crafty and makes a smart attempt to escape. Is it the endgame for Jhansi's deception?

videos.title: The Strangled Voice
videos.overview: The fisherwoman's son's life pivots as he takes up his new job near an RPSE Coaching Institute. Young Jhansi and Young Maramalli take up their RPSE exams, oblivious to what the future holds. Young Jhansi's life is thrown into a downward spiral. Jailer Jayachandran takes Jhansi under his wings.

videos.title: Come Forth, O Sword-Bearer
videos.overview: The fisherwoman's son's ambition puts him at odds with a powerful man, and he begins to forge his own path. Jayachandran actively pursues a lead in investigating the suspicious suicide at an RPSE training institute. Jhansi uses yet another trick to close in on the scammers, and is stunned by the involvement of an unanticipated person. A phone call leaves Jhansi shattered.

videos.title: The Fury of the Red Tea
videos.overview: Kumaresan's hidden past comes to light, revealing powerful connections. Believing they have finally figured out the scam, Jhansi's team sets an elaborate trap for the masterminds. But as they focus on their target, the real threat emerges from an unexpected corner. Jhansi and Maramalli are forced into a reluctant alliance to fight their way out.

videos.title: The Fish That Hunted for the Duck
videos.overview: On the day of the RPSE exam, Jhansi discovers that she has been outplayed by Kumaresan's cunning plan. The walls close in on her from all sides, and she is left to fight for survival. Kumaresan's past deeds catch up with him, revealing a darker shade of the scam. Is justice finally served to Jhansi, or is she doomed forever?

tt43134711.name: Ramba Oorvasi Menaka
tt43134711.description: A man spends 15 years attempting to use a magical book to summon the celestial angels Ramba, Urvasi, and Menaka to earth, but Lord Indra blocks their descent until they finally arrive.

tt39216452.name: Batchmates
tt39216452.description: When four wide-eyed first-year students enter the world of engineering, they undergo a rude shock as they face the harsh realities of college life.

videos.title: What the Engineering!
videos.overview: Sid, Milky and Sammy begin engineering college, excited for a new chapter. Their joy soon turns into fear as seniors turn their experience into a nightmare.

videos.title: First Bunk, First Blunder
videos.overview: The addition of a new member in Sid's gang leads to their first bunk. It backfires when they ask for a lift from the wrong person.

videos.title: Domino Effect
videos.overview: Sid's impulsive decision sends everything into disarray. His gang is in danger far greater than anything they have encountered before.

videos.title: Operation Freedom
videos.overview: To gain their freedom from the seniors, Sid and his gang must undertake a risky task. But will they manage to do it without being caught?

videos.title: When Right Goes Wrong
videos.overview: Sid and his gang pull off the task, only to discover they have committed something terribly wrong. Sid’s conscience forces him to rectify the mistake, only to make things worse.

videos.title: Consequence
videos.overview: Sid’s gang face the consequences of rustication in their homes. Suhas tries to get a person out of trouble. But who is it?

videos.title: The Offer
videos.overview: Suhas's father pressures the principal to establish a committee while ensuring his son's name remains untainted. Meanwhile, Suhas attempts to persuade Goldie to betray Sid.

videos.title: Sweet Warning
videos.overview: Goldie speaks honestly at the committee, yet the principal attempts to protect Suhas. Enraged, Sid decides to take matters into his hands and directly confronts Suhas's father.

videos.title: Hurdles!
videos.overview: The college doors reopen for the four, but Sid barely has time to breathe before something far closer to home threatens to unravel everything.

videos.title: Healing Notes
videos.overview: Sid's song mends strained bonds. The group opens up in class, but, beneath the laughter and growing tensions, secrets quietly begin to surface.

videos.title: One Too Many
videos.overview: Sid finds himself caught between a police shakedown at home and college life. Soon, carrying the weight of it all breaks at the worst moment, costing him Sammy's feelings.

videos.title: Misfire!
videos.overview: Sid and Milky's plan to silence the CI backfires. While Sid rescues Goldie from Suhas' unwanted attention, he unknowingly breaks Sammy's heart

videos.title: Favour
videos.overview: Cornered by a corrupt cop and a double ransom, Sid reluctantly approaches Suhas, but help will come with a condition.

videos.title: The Complaint
videos.overview: A dance partner switch spirals into a public confrontation and when Deepika steps in, she hands Goldie and Sid the one weapon they haven't used yet, a formal complaint.

videos.title: Cornered
videos.overview: Pressure mounts from every direction on Goldie to stay silent, on Sid to betray Goldie, and on Sammy to stay indifferent to feelings she can no longer ignore.

videos.title: Expected Bonds
videos.overview: When Sammy learns of Sid's family crisis, she informs Goldie out of concern. One honest conversation changes everything, bringing unexpected closeness between Sammy and Suhas.

videos.title: Same Spot
videos.overview: Suhas gives a lift to a drunken man, unaware that he is the father of Sammy. Meanwhile, the new principal is establishing his own regulations.

videos.title: Not Entirely His
videos.overview: Sid is quietly planning a surprise for Sammy's birthday. But a shared gift and an unexpected name cut deeper than any celebration.

videos.title: Too Much Too Soon
videos.overview: Caught off guard by rescheduled internals, the gang rushes to prepare. Sid, under pressure, takes a gamble mid-exam and pays a price he didn't see coming.

videos.title: Growing Apart
videos.overview: After a clash over a cheating allegation, Sid and Sammy drift apart. As their friends try to mend the rift, Sammy finds unexpected comfort in Suhas.

videos.title: Unfair Punishment
videos.overview: Sid and Sammy put aside their differences before a crucial lab exam, but Milky’s desperate attempt to pass lands Sushanth’s scholarship in jeopardy.

videos.title: Who Is to Blame?
videos.overview: As the gang fights to save Sushanth’s scholarship, Deepika steps in to help. But the principal’s actions leave everyone stunned.

videos.title: Uneasy Victory
