videos.overview: Arjun struggles with his feelings for Madhu, while Amala learns the truth about Kanniyappan. Reena's health sparks new questions as buried secrets from her past resurface.

videos.title: Unspoken Questions
videos.overview: Reena faces health concerns as Vijay grows increasingly worried. At the same time, Anu questions Vijay's decisions, forcing him to confront the choices he made.

videos.title: A Familiar Shadow
videos.overview: Radhi grows uneasy when an unexpected encounter raises questions. Aradhana gets a visitor from her past, leaving her to face emotions she has long kept buried.

videos.title: Old Ties
videos.overview: While Aradhana struggles to deal with her father's unexpected presence, Reena begins questioning the truth behind the organ that changed her life.

videos.title: Crossing Lines
videos.overview: Aradhana's father's threat forces her into a corner. Just as Madhu and Arjun find themselves drawing closer, Reena sends him a text.

videos.title: Hidden Identity
videos.overview: Arjun finds himself caught between his growing bond with Madhu and the emotions stirred by Reena. Anu faces an unsettling encounter that threatens to expose her past.

videos.title: A Risky Choice
videos.overview: A difficult heart transplant case puts the RK Hospital doctors under pressure as they weigh the risks against a patient's urgent need. Aradhana faces questions about her secret.

videos.title: Unwanted Truths
videos.overview: Aradhana is a dilemma as Kanniyappan reveals he knows her secret. At the hospital, the heart transplant case takes an unexpected turn, leaving Raghav questioning his decision.

videos.title: A Difficult Decision
videos.overview: Raghav and Amala face resistance after taking a stand on a critical case. While Arjun and Madhu grow closer, an unexpected encounter with Reena threatens their equation.

videos.title: Unexpected Reunion
videos.overview: Reena reaches Chennai and finds herself being drawn back to memories. While Arjun makes a promise to Madhu, Divi is elated to meet Reena.

videos.title: Back Again
videos.overview: Reena's return brings an emotional reunion with Divi and stirs memories of the life she left behind. Vijay and Reena visit the hospital where she was operated on, with questions.

videos.title: Old Questions
videos.overview: Reena quizzes Rocky about Radhi and Divi after their unexpected visit. As she recalls the past, old emotions resurface and leave Rocky thinking what she may be trying to uncover.

videos.title: Hidden Evidence
videos.overview: A routine check of the hospital ambulance leaves Kanniyappan scared while Aradhana's actions raise doubts about what she may be trying to hide. Reena finally meets Arjun in a café.

videos.title: Growing Doubts
videos.overview: Reena insists she is unaffected at the sight of Arjun moving on. At RK Hospital, Raghav notices inconsistencies in a patient's records and begins questioning Aradhana's actions.

videos.title: Unanswered Questions
videos.overview: Vijay's involvement in a critical case trouble Raghav. Growing increasingly suspicious about Aradhana's actions, Raghav confronts her.

videos.title: A Dangerous Secret
videos.overview: Rocky requests Arjun for help with a sensitive case. Vijay is adamant in his stand. An anxious Aradhana discharges her father from the hospital, only to fall into a bigger trap.

videos.title: A Face from the Past
videos.overview: Vijay and Reena’s return to RK Hospital brings back painful memories. A critical medical case gets old connections into focus and sets the stage for an unexpected encounter.

videos.title: Old Connections
videos.overview: Vijay and Aradhana reconnect after years apart. Meanwhile, Arjun's exam scores drop, and Vijay pressures him to reveal the truth to Reena.

videos.title: A Painful Truth
videos.overview: Reena finally knows who her donor is, which devastates her. At the hospital, she meets Rocky to show him Radhi's medical reports that raise questions she cannot easily ignore.

videos.title: A Growing Concern
videos.overview: Aradhana becomes wary of Raghav reporting her father's false hospitalisation. As Reena and Vijay get ready to leave for Bengaluru, she presents Radhi's medical report to him.

videos.title: A Sudden Crisis
videos.overview: Reena worries about Radhi's health and plans to get a second blood test out of her mother. When that fails, she confronts Radhi about her health that escalates into an emergency.

videos.title: Two Months!
videos.overview: Radhi agrees to consider a medical test but places an unexpected condition on Reena. While Reena struggles with the decision, Manasa encounters a new problem.

videos.title: The Return
videos.overview: Pressure builds as Vijay is urged to return to Bangalore hospital. Meanwhile, Reena tries to protect Radhi and deal with the growing tension around her health.

videos.title: Critical Hours
videos.overview: A routine hospital visit takes a turn when Sharmi’s condition demands immediate attention. While her husband tries to accept the situation, Rocky makes a crucial medical decision.

videos.title: Old Memories
videos.overview: Aradhana and Vijay revisit memories from their medical college days, recalling the difficult path that shaped their lives. And an old connection begins to take on new meaning.

videos.title: Hidden Presence
videos.overview: Manasa resigns from the CEO’s post. Reena moves in with Radhi and her family. However, the pressure of hiding the truth of her whereabouts from Vijay becomes difficult.

videos.title: Complicated Feelings
videos.overview: Radhi, Reena and Divi share unexpected moments of happiness as their bond grows stronger. Meanwhile, Vijay informs Anu about Ammu and struggles to handle the complicated situation.

videos.title: The Missing Link
videos.overview: Raghav and his team uncover a possible connection between Kanniyappan and a past hospital tragedy. Radhi faces an unexpected health concern that forces Reena to confront her fears.

videos.title: Growing Suspicion
videos.overview: Rocky grows increasingly doubtful of Kanniyappan as the team is set to protect Radhi and her family. Later, Kanniyappan’s shocking step stuns Radhi, Reena and the hospital staff.

videos.title: Under Pressure
videos.overview: A powerful judge turns his anger towards RK Hospital. As Radhi and Reena face a difficult medical situation, Arjun moves closer to reclaiming RK Hospital.

videos.title: A Price to Pay
videos.overview: The judge holds RK Hospital accountable for his traumatic experience, putting Ashok under pressure. Meanwhile, Aradhana’s hopes regarding Vijay take an unexpected turn.

videos.title: A Family in Fear
videos.overview: Radhi’s diagnosis leaves her family shattered, while Reena searches for ways to support her mother. Elsewhere, Arjun finds himself caught in an unexpected situation.

videos.title: A Costly Offer
videos.overview: Ashok makes Arjun an unexpected offer concerning RK Hospital. As Vijay considers a new chapter in Chennai, Reena faces the challenge of keeping her relationships from colliding.

videos.title: An Unexpected Arrival
videos.overview: Vijay’s sudden return to Chennai catches Reena off guard, forcing her to reconsider her secrets about Radhi. Meanwhile, Arjun’s personal life grows complicated.

videos.title: A Dangerous Guest
videos.overview: Ayyappan’s intimidating arrival at Raghav’s home raises unsettling questions. While tensions continue within RK Hospital, Aradhana confesses to Radhi about her feelings for Vijay.

videos.title: Behind Closed Doors
videos.overview: Vijay examines RK Hospital’s records and prepares for his new responsibilities. Reena tries to adjust to the changes around her while Shyamala’s case adds to the uncertainty.

videos.title: Unanswered Questions
videos.overview: Vijay turns to Anu to clarify a memory from the past, unaware of the complications. At RK Hospital, Arjun and Vijay navigate their evolving professional relationship.

tt39221022.name: Mad For Each Other
tt39221022.description: Ten couples face relationship trials in a villa through challenges and truth sessions. Weekly tests reveal their authentic bonds. The most genuine, resilient pair wins this ultimate love challenge.

videos.title: The Ultimate Test Of Love Begins
videos.overview: The ten couples enters the villa. It's a grand launch.

videos.title: Half Hearts And A Shocking Re-Entry

tt10515398.name: Pallichattambi
tt10515398.description: Set in the politically turbulent late 1950s, Krishnan Pillai, a playful ruffian chosen by the Church to lead a defensive force, the Christopher Sena. His mission to resist the Communist government takes a detour when he experiences an ideological awakening and falls in love with a comrade, sparking an epic tale of rebellion against feudal power and oppression.

tt39385419.name: Parimala and Co
tt39385419.description: A dark comedy centered around a chaotic family whose tangled relationships and unpredictable situations lead to emotionally charged and absurd moments, blending humor with underlying tension and drama.

tt33525859.name: Malli
tt33525859.description: Things take a momentous shift when a bold and loving village girl, Malli, crosses paths with a doting father and his 6-year-old daughter who yearns for a mother's love. Join the family's journey through the nuances of love, affect...

tt39216418.name: Vikram On Duty
tt39216418.description: Battling his past and personal demons, a disgraced but brilliant supercop will stop at nothing to solve crimes and earn back the uniform that defined him.

videos.title: The Empty Bus
videos.overview: A young woman is found brutally raped at a bus stand, with no clues around. As the case collapses, Vikram, a suspended cop, is forced back into duty.

videos.title: Back Door
videos.overview: Amidst mounting pressure, Vikram unofficially returns to the case and begins reconstructing the crime. A missing link leads Hunt to their first suspect.

videos.title: The Shadow
videos.overview: As the search begins for the first suspect, he is found dead. Vikram plans a trap for the criminal, but an unexpected person falls into it.

videos.title: Silence of the Grave
videos.overview: An attempt to silence the victim inside the hospital exposes a dangerous new player in the case. As Vikram connects the dots, the crime reveals its true motive.

videos.title: Blind Spot
videos.overview: The final confession of Santhosh reveals disturbing truths about Sirisha's assault. After Vikram resolves this case, another one is poised for him to tackle.

videos.title: Live Target
videos.overview: Vikram discovers a terrifying digital pattern while looking into a brutal murder. Will the HUNT team be able to save him when they find out who the murderers' next target is?

videos.title: Saving the Loved Ones?
videos.overview: After two influencers die days apart, Vikram uncovers a hidden link to an old case. As the killers outpace the investigation, a familiar face suddenly becomes the next target.

videos.title: The End Game
videos.overview: Vikram draws nearer to uncovering the hidden mastermind behind the murders. As the targets shift and the deadly game evolves, Vikram takes a bold risk. Will Vikram succeed?

videos.title: The Master Plan
videos.overview: Vikram uncovers the truth behind the murders and confronts the main culprit. Will he succeed in apprehending the killers, or will he become a victim himself?

videos.title: Stolen at Birth
videos.overview: A young mother's world shatters when her newborn disappears, and the hospital offers no answers. As rumours of child trafficking emerge, Vikram must find the baby within 48 hours.

videos.title: Network Unlimited
videos.overview: Vikram finds a network of moving children across states under legal cover. He later realises it isn't just trafficking but a protected supply chain hidden by trust and paperwork.

videos.title: Across-Words
videos.overview: Vikram nears the trafficking ring, but a shocking revelation makes him question the case. Will he reunite the stolen child or expose the largest network yet?

videos.title: On the Run
videos.overview: As Vikram uncovers the traffic chain, the person behind it is on a run with the newborn. An expected turn takes place. Will Vikram catch the culprit before they flee from the city?

videos.title: Not Adding Up
videos.overview: Commissioner Manoj Kumar is shocked to learn that his mentor, Eshwari committed suicide. But Vikram notices troubling details on the scene and a disturbing truth begins to unravel.

videos.title: A Cut Above
videos.overview: A suspicious object in the parking and a watchman’s testimony reveal new clues that challenge the suicide theory. Vikram starts to dig deeper to expose a hidden trail of secrets.

videos.title: Dig Deep
videos.overview: A mysterious past starts connecting to the case. What started as a suspicious death now begins to reveal a dangerous truth. Is the baffling past the reason behind Eshwari's death?

videos.title: Beast Behind Beauty
videos.overview: Vikram’s investigation behind Eshwari’s strange death leads him to an unexpected suspect. What appeared to be a carefully planned cover-up begins to fall apart under his scrutiny.

videos.title: Vikram's Custody
videos.overview: Ashok secures approval to arrest Vikram without informing the Commissioner. Will the Commissioner be able to help, or will it be too late for him to become aware of the situation?

videos.title: The Panel
videos.overview: At the closed hearing, Savitri stands firm with her confession, and the panel turns against Vikram. Already traumatised, Vikram collapses under the pressure.

videos.title: What Happened on that Day?
videos.overview: Vikram finally reveals what happened that day, but was he following the Commissioner's shoot-at-sight orders? Who is truly responsible for the innocent victim's death?

videos.title: Final Hearing
videos.overview: The panel is ready with a verdict on Vikram's fate, yet an unexpected confession from the DGP takes them by surprise. Will this alter Vikram's future within the police department?

videos.title: The Blast
videos.overview: A bomb blast at a courier godown has triggered an investigation. Vikram, accompanied by Veda, covertly involves himself in it. Will the team allow him to take the lead?

videos.title: Vengence Served
videos.overview: As the investigation progresses, a personal motive behind the blast emerges. Was the target Malavika or Sharat, and what is their connection to the explosion?

videos.title: Motive
videos.overview: The bomb scare leads HUNT on a wild chase, uncovering a name in the course of the investigation. Are Sharat and Malavika concealing something from the team?

videos.title: Unexpected Turn
videos.overview: Malavika hides a truth more dangerous than the bomb scare, her past. Even though the culprit is caught, the threat lingers. Can Vikram stop another blast in time?

videos.title: Spike in the Crime
videos.overview: The Commissioner updates Vikram and Ashok about a rise in missing persons. But before they zero-in on the investigation, a new missing case is reported.

videos.title: Who Is Behind it?
videos.overview: Vikram senses the hand of a larger mafia. Soon, unsettling connections start to emerge, a butcher, a medical camp, and construction workers, all hint at a multi-layered operation.

videos.title: Whom can you Trust?
videos.overview: Vikram digs deeper into the missing person’s racket, and a medical camp is the first lead to a breakthrough. As the investigation continues, one more missing person’s case emerges.

videos.title: Close Save
videos.overview: Vikram and his team uncover that the real crime behind the missing people is the organ mafia run by a person called KK. They finally save Priya from becoming prey to this mafia.

videos.title: Ruthless Gang
videos.overview: A ruthless gang targets and kills cab drivers in the city. HUNT intervenes as crimes rise, but another driver falls victim. The team must act quickly to stop the gang.

videos.title: Diversion
videos.overview: HUNT zeroes in on a lead and reaches the person connected to the crime, but he gets killed. Vikram must solve the case before the crime expands to a massive network.

videos.title: The Bait
videos.overview: Vikram realises that the gang is clever and needs a smart plan. He risks using Ranga Rao as bait to catch the car thieves. But will the plan succeed, and will Ranga Rao stay safe?

videos.title: Battle for Life
videos.overview: When Ranga Rao is taken hostage by the car thieves, an unexpected person puts his life in further danger. Vikram devises a different game plan. Will it work?

videos.title: A Cop is Dead
videos.overview: Chandra, a decorated cop, dies of a heart attack, and the department closes the case as a natural death. However, Ranga Rao finds his death suspicious and insists it's a murder.

videos.title: The Suspicion
videos.overview: Vikram reopens Chandra's case. When the HUNT team checks the CCTV footage around the time of Chandra's death, they spot a mysterious tattooed man speaking to him.

videos.title: Who is Robert?
videos.overview: Vikram's pursuit of Mullan ends with a shocking revelation. Meanwhile, Ashok finds an opportunity to tell the Commissioner that Vikram manipulated him to reopen Chandra's case.

videos.title: The Betrayal
videos.overview: Vikram's hot pursuit leads to the arrest of drug kingpin Robert for whom Chandra was collecting information. An unexpected reveal of a name shakes the foundation of the case.

videos.title: Campus Chaos
videos.overview: A student’s suicide on the college campus leads to chaos. The HUNT team finds something strange behind Shankar’s death. Is it suicide or a cold-blooded murder?

videos.title: Personal Angle
videos.overview: The college feels the pressure of Shankar’s suicide. An unexpected turn leads to the HUNT finding another dead body. What is the connection between the two deaths?

videos.title: Time of Death
videos.overview: The time of Vijaya and Shankar’s death match. Vikram’s idea of going through Shankar’s suicide letter turns the entire case, finally revealing the name of the culprit!

videos.title: Stalker's Story
videos.overview: Vikram's investigation uncovers chilling truths surrounding the campus murders. Soon, Ramesh reveals his cold-blooded plan for the murders of both Shankar and Vijaya.

videos.title: Casting Call
videos.overview: Meghana, an aspiring model, lies to her family to attend a late-night casting and goes missing. Her neighbour Vikram notices suspicious events and investigates her disappearance.

videos.title: Boy Friend?
videos.overview: Vikram uncovers new leads in Meghana's disappearance, drawing attention to unexpected connections and individuals linked to her last known whereabouts.

videos.title: A Lurer
videos.overview: With suspicion shifting from Arjun to Prakash, the casting director who exploits models, questions remain; was he behind Meghana's disappearance, or is someone else involved?

videos.title: Predator
videos.overview: A breakthrough in Meghana's case leads Vikram's team to a grim location, where hope of finding her alive fades. Can they catch the predator and save Meghana?

videos.title: Ponzi Scam
videos.overview: Veda receives an achiever award from Vikas Chakra, a company dedicated to promoting financial freedom for women. Trusting her, Lakshmi invests too, unaware of the coming scam.

videos.title: Anonymous
videos.overview: Vikram grows suspicious of Vikas Chakra and uncovers crucial information about the company. He sends anonymous warnings to Veda, but will she believe him?

videos.title: Wrong Turn?
videos.overview: As Veda's suspicions about Vikas Chakra grow, she teams up with Vikram to expose the truth. Will Veda and Vikram outsmart the culprits and protect the investors?

videos.title: Victory
videos.overview: Omkar, a special officer and friend of Vikram, discovers Dev's scheme. Together, he and Vikram thwart Dev's plans, return the funds to the investors, and expose him.

videos.title: Thuggees
videos.overview: A dangerous gang is instilling fear in the city by targeting isolated homes. Their planning and execution are meticulous, presenting a significant challenge for Vikram to tackle.

videos.title: Previous Records
videos.overview: Vikram and his team review past records of the gang's robberies, searching for clues linking them to recent crimes. Meanwhile, the Chori Gang plan to target another family.

videos.title: Crucial Clue
videos.overview: Vikram discovers a key clue connecting the robberies. He puts one of its workers under surveillance, unaware that the gang is now following him.

videos.title: Crack Down
videos.overview: Vikram's game plan works as he diverts the Chori Gang towards a trap. He finally puts them behind bars after recovering all the gold and money they looted from innocent families.

videos.title: Entrance Examination
videos.overview: A new case reckons Vikram and his HUNT team. The self-immolation of the father of deceased Saraswathi, a merit student, creates an uproar, and seeking answers for the harsh step.

videos.title: Vikram's Fate?
videos.overview: While probing the exam fraud case, Vikram meets Maithili and uncovers crucial clues. He is stunned when Jhansi, the new Commissioner, suspends him from the HUNT team.

videos.title: Directionless
videos.overview: With Vikram out, Jhansi appoints Suresh for the fraud case. IG Manoj Kumar lashes out at her for taking the investigation lightly as justice for hundreds of students lies at stake.

videos.title: On Duty
videos.overview: Vikram's removal from HUNT throws the investigation into chaos, prompting Jhansi to bring him back. As he resumes, Vikram is surprised to see Jwala replacing Akhila on the team.

videos.title: Tutorials
videos.overview: Vikram's search takes him to Shriyan Coaching Centre, while Suresh competes against time to crack the case first. Amid the rivalry, a crucial twist complicates matters further.

videos.title: Accident Prone
videos.overview: On their way home, Vikram and Ashok meet with a serious accident. Amid the tension, Vikram hides his injuries ahead of his wedding ceremony.

videos.title: The Proxies
videos.overview: Vikram finds key leads in the MEET case and sets a trap to catch the culprits. Meanwhile, a shocking revelation creates turmoil, putting his relationship with Veda in jeopardy.

videos.title: Cops in Chaos
videos.overview: After a cop's murder, the killer calls IG Manoj Kumar and challenges him that Vikram should answer his next call to avoid more deaths. Will a dejected Vikram take up the case?

videos.title: Target Acquired
videos.overview: Vikram tries to engage with the killer, who has already chosen his next target. As the clock ticks, he races to crack a cryptic puzzle. Will he decode it before it's too late?

videos.title: Damage Control
videos.overview: Determined to stop the killer, Vikram follows the next set of clues. But can he decode the killer's riddle and save a critically injured SI before it's too late?

videos.title: Crime Spree
videos.overview: The killer, angered by Vikram saving the SI, plans bigger. He targets a Circle Inspector, sets a trap and challenges Vikram with a puzzle to save him. Can Vikram succeed?

videos.title: One After Another
videos.overview: As the killer psychopath continues to hunt down the police officers one after another, this time he targets Jwala. Vikram arrives just in time, but the killer manages to escape.

videos.title: Police in Mess
videos.overview: Having narrowly escaped and failed to kill Jwala, the killer strikes again poisoning a DSP at a police mess. As Vikram races to crack the case, he remains one step behind.

videos.title: Next Target?
videos.overview: As the killer selects his next target, he leaves Vikram a cryptic code to solve. This time, Vikram acts quickly and cracks the code just in time to save the ACP.

videos.title: It's Personal
videos.overview: After failing three times, the killer refuses to accept defeat. Enraged by his repeated failures, the killer turns the battle personal by kidnapping Vikram's father.

videos.title: At Stake
videos.overview: The killer abducts Vikram's father, compelling Vikram to engage in a frantic race against time. But can he outsmart the killer and save his father in time?

videos.title: Who is he?
videos.overview: After Vikram saves his father in the nick of time, he is taken to the hospital. Recalling the killer's face, Vikram's father sketches him. But is it the same man they're hunting?

videos.title: The Recruiters
videos.overview: Vikram uncovers Arjun's identity and the truth behind the psychopath's deadly obsession. But will his exposure be enough to stop Arjun, or will he succeed in achieving his goal?

videos.title: Vikram vs Arjun
videos.overview: The truth behind Arjun's dark past comes to light, revealing the reason for his relentless killings. With Arjun ready to take his revenge on the recruiters, can Vikram stop him?

videos.title: The Professor
videos.overview: During a bank visit, Vikram meets his college professor, Srinivas Rao. However, little does he know that it will be the last time the cop meets his teacher.

videos.title: Set Aside
videos.overview: Vikram is forced to assist Suresh in the professor's case. However, the lead investigator quickly finds his first suspect: the professor's son.

videos.title: Goose Chase
videos.overview: Suresh's investigation directs the case towards Viraj, but Vikram's parallel investigation leads him to a different person. Whose leads will find the professor's real killer?

videos.title: Befriended
videos.overview: Vikram's investigation leads to an unexpected curve, which draws out the real culprit, who is an acquaintance of Srinivas Rao. Why did Professor Rao end up trusting his killer?

videos.title: A Kidnap
videos.overview: Commissioner Jhansi's nephew is kidnapped and Vikram takes up the case. A call from the kidnappers reveals their demand for a hard disk linked to a land scam, not just ransom.

videos.title: Ransom
videos.overview: Jhansi covertly searches for the hard disk, while Vikram begins to harbour suspicions about her. Can he uncover the truth and save both Aditya and the evidence?

videos.title: Rival Gang
videos.overview: Vikram and his team prepare for the exchange as a rival gang closes in on Aditya to settle a personal score with Jhansi. Meanwhile, Ramulu seeks Vikram's help in saving his land.

videos.title: The Exchange
videos.overview: While Jhansi hands over the hard drive and ransom, a rival gang ambushes the exchange. Is Jhansi connected to the attack, and what will happen when the truth comes to light?

videos.title: Phishing
videos.overview: Padma falls victim to fraudsters who blackmail her with fake obscene photos, pushing her to attempt suicide. After Sridhar saves her, Vikram steps in to track down the culprits.

videos.title: Decoys in Place
videos.overview: Vikram's investigation reveals a mobile repair shop owner behind the blackmail racket. Meanwhile, his neighbour unknowingly becomes the fraudsters' next target.

videos.title: Conditions Apply
videos.overview: Meghana installs the fraudulent app, giving the scammer access to her personal data. As the blackmail begins, Vikram almost closes in on the finance company behind the racket.

videos.title: The Fraudster
videos.overview: With Meghana's help, Vikram traps a finance-company owner for extorting women. He also arrests the mobile repair shop owner for morphing women’s photographs and exploiting them.

videos.title: Home Coming?
videos.overview: After secretly marrying Shekhar, Pallavi returns home seeking her family's acceptance. When Shekhar is attacked and Pallavi goes missing, Vikram takes up the case to find her.

videos.title: Prove it
videos.overview: Vikram investigates Pallavi's suspicious death as her family insists it was a heart attack. With no body and an uncooperative village, can he uncover the truth behind the murder?

videos.title: Push Back
videos.overview: As the village shields Pallavi's family, Vikram targets her guilt-ridden brother. A pendant soon leads him to the doctor who certified her death.

videos.title: The Honourless
videos.overview: As Pallavi's brother confesses, Vikram uncovers the murder and exposes those who covered it up. But with the village rallying behind the killers, can HUNT bring Shekhar justice?

videos.title: The Fugitive
videos.overview: After waking up beside Jhanvi's dead body, Roshan flees and becomes the prime suspect. Vikram and Ranga Rao race to reach him before the police do.

videos.title: Room of Lies
videos.overview: As the evidence closes in on Roshan, his fate appears sealed. But, Vikram and Ranga Rao discover cracks in the story that hint at a carefully staged setup.

videos.title: Dark Secrets
videos.overview: Vikram's investigation reveals a web of rehearsed stories from the staff and Jhanvi's friends. But with Roshan trapped in a cell with two dangerous men, time begins to run out.

videos.title: Unmasked
videos.overview: Vikram uncovers the conspiracy behind Jhanvi's murder, revealing how Roshan was expertly framed. But will the truth be enough to heal the rift between Roshan and Ranga Rao?

videos.title: Old Enemies
videos.overview: Three criminals imprisoned by Vikram unite to kill him. Meanwhile, feared don Nanda awakens from a year-long coma, while Savitri's grandson Arjun is suddenly kidnapped.

videos.title: The Demand
videos.overview: Vikram takes charge of Arjun's kidnapping case, despite Savitri's hatred. When the kidnappers call, they demand a mysterious pen drive connected to Gautham.

videos.title: Hidden Life
videos.overview: Jwala's mother quietly moves ahead with plans for her alliance with Suresh. As Vikram and Omkar hunt for Arjun, an escaped enemy and a hidden threat complicate their search.

videos.title: The Trojan
videos.overview: As Suresh enters the HUNT team and Santosh begins stalking Vikram, a chilling truth emerges. Someone Vikram trusts closely has already accepted a gun and money to kill him.

videos.title: An Attack from the Shadows
videos.overview: Santosh tries to kill Vikram but gets injured in the process. Omkar and Vikram revisit the crime scene where Gautham died and uncover a buried truth.

videos.title: The Mysterious Pen Drive
videos.overview: As Omkar re-examines Gautham's death, he discovers Vikram may have been framed. Arjun's kidnappers call again, demanding the pen drive, and give them a 24-hour deadline.

videos.title: An Exchange of Lies
videos.overview: With the pen drive finally in their hands, Vikram prepares for an exchange to rescue Arjun from Nanda. But a traitor within Vikram's team makes this mission more dangerous.

videos.title: The Final Betrayal
videos.overview: The exchange explodes into an all-out gun battle when Vikram fights to save Arjun. Just when victory seems within reach, Vikram is struck by an unexpected betrayal.

tt33144230.name: Murshid
tt33144230.description: Ex-don Murshid is forced out of exile when his former accomplice turned rival, Farid, traps his son in a gang war. Can Murshid reclaim his rule over the city as he saves his son?

videos.title: Murshid Pathan
videos.overview: Druglord Farid’s men send Salim and Junaid to collect a smuggling delivery from Talibanis. When the deal goes wrong, Farid meets Junaid and realizes he is the son of the dreaded gangster Murshid Pathan.

videos.title: The Promise
videos.overview: Murshid meets Junaid, who tells him that he got framed. Murshid promises Farid that he will bear the price for the deal that went wrong. He meets his adopted son, Kumar Pratap and asks for help.

videos.title: The Clock is in Motion
videos.overview: Kumar confronts Murshid about his father's death. Murshid contacts his old accomplices and enquires about finding dirt on Farid’s gang members. Can the two help Junaid before it’s too late?

videos.title: Back in the Game
videos.overview: Farid goes back on his words and puts Junaid’s life in danger. Jayendra Rao makes a deal with Farid to win the elections. Salim’s death marks the beginning of a war between Murshid and Farid.

videos.title: Farid's Vendetta
videos.overview: Jayendra loses his cool as the media is focused on the war between Murshid and Farid instead of the elections. Meanwhile, Murshid joins hands with Namdev Kulkarni, the leader of the Naya Daur party.

videos.title: The Heart of a Lion
videos.overview: Murshid’s next target is Ajay Verma, the Intelligence Officer helping Farid. On the other hand, Farid's plan to get Murshid assassinated fails. Jayendra Rao meets Murshid to make a deal with him.

videos.title: The Endgame
videos.overview: With the election dates drawing close, the stakes are higher than ever. The assassination of Jayendra Rao’s father, Baburao, changes the game. Farid and Murshid face each other, one last time.

tt30835984.name: Chithini
tt30835984.description: In a village called Noolpuzha, Chithini, a vengeful spirit, was cast here at a place called Pamukkadu.

tt42932774.name: Transfer Trimurthulu
tt42932774.description: Fearless cop Trimurthulu's chance find drags him into a web of conspiracy. Standing alone against influential enemies who will stop at nothing, he risks everything to expose the truth and deliver justice.

tt38628863.name: D/O Prasad Rao: Kanabadutaledu
tt38628863.description: A father desperately searches for his missing daughter, uncovering hidden secrets and betrayals along the way. The investigation tests family bonds while revealing dark truths beneath seemingly normal lives.

videos.title: A Father's Worst Nightmare
videos.overview: Prasad Rao reluctantly allows his daughter, Swati, to shift to Hyderabad for work. He returns home after helping her with shifting. Later, he is forced to travel to Hyderabad when Swati goes missing.

videos.title: The Truth That Broke Me
videos.overview: Swati's disappearance reaches the media, forcing the police to get involved. Officer Revika Joseph and Prasad Rao discover Swati’s body, but Prasad Rao’s knowledge of her location raises questions.

videos.title: The Silence After Her Last Breath
videos.overview: The news about Swati’s death and Prasad’s health reaches their hometown and also makes national headlines. Meanwhile, Officer Revika finds a lead about Swati’s whereabouts on the day of her death.

videos.title: A Room Full Of Secrets
videos.overview: Revika interrogates Swati’s roommates and searches her phone. While the clues lead her to a potential suspect and a shocking discovery, she decides to keep the details of the case away from the media.

videos.title: The Case With No Crime
videos.overview: Prasad Rao regains consciousness but cannot remember Swati’s death, shocking the family. Revika tracks down the suspect and interrogates him, while Swati’s postmortem reports flip the investigation.

videos.title: A Father's Justice
videos.overview: Prasad Rao collapses in the mortuary. The postmortem reports lead Revika to close the case. Later, investigating a couple of deaths in Swathi’s hometown brings Revika in front of Prasad Rao again.

tt40769151.name: The Great Grand Superhero: Aliens Ka Aagman
tt40769151.description: Follows a grandfather and grandson whose relationship transforms through the child's imagination when they encounter aliens.

tt33254124.name: Cadets
tt33254124.description: Set in 1998 before the historic Kargil war, four boys set foot in the prestigious Armed Forces Academy. Cadets is a coming-of-age story about a world where boys become men of honour.

videos.title: A Cadet must always be loyal
videos.overview: In AFA, Manoj, Albert, Randhir, and Neeraj are assigned an overstudy Gagan, who makes life difficult for them. They avenge the humiliation with a plan. However, happiness doesn't last long as the menacing 6th-term BCL Kawaljeet takes over.

videos.title: The great Kadambari escape
videos.overview: Cadets take on their first cross-country race. Ustaad Natarajan spots them taking shortcuts and punishes them with a hike. The boys cheat on the hike that brings them closer. They evade Ustaad Natarajan, but in the end get caught by Jeet.

videos.title: Operation Sunday pass
videos.overview: Commandant Sabharwal implements the 'Buddy System'. Albert and Randhir get their first 'Sunday Pass', but they get into a heated scuffle after a face-off with Fateh Company. Albert in his secret hideout, a war tank, makes a confession.

videos.title: First steps to leadership
videos.overview: In the second term, the boys gear up for the prestigious Commandant's Tea. Albert's antics land him in trouble, but Manoj saves the day. Cadets begin prep for the first camp, but the announcement of the commanding cadet surprises everyone.

videos.title: A Cadet's betrayal
videos.overview: Manoj gets selected to lead at the camp, and cold wars begin with Randhir. As camp progresses, Manoj's leadership is under scrutiny. Randhir's recklessness costs Manoj the leadership position, thereby causing the friends to drift apart.

videos.title: Last dance before the storm
videos.overview: Amidst the ongoing tiff between Randhir and Manoj, they are both made Corporals in the fourth term. At the AFA ball, the cadets try their luck at romance. However, the ball is abruptly cut with the announcement of India at war in Kargil.

videos.title: For a fallen soldier
videos.overview: The sixth term begins as cadets start training for their final camp. However, a news from the war comes in that devastates Randhir. Cadets learn the true meaning of being a soldier and gear up to restore their Company's lost glory.

videos.title: The final run to glory
videos.overview: Camp Everest is the last and most challenging feat in their cadet life. However, midway Manoj makes a sacrifice which shows everyone the true meaning of being a Cadet. The season reaches a climactic high as the boys complete the glory run!

tt34942608.name: Balti
tt34942608.description: A star kabaddi player's life takes a dangerous turn when he's pulled into the criminal underworld.

tt23865918.name: Peddi
tt23865918.description: In 1980s rural Andhra Pradesh, A spirited villager unites his community through sports to defend their pride against a powerful rival.

tt39632118.name: Family Kirana Store
tt39632118.description: A middle-class small-town family's father obsesses over his struggling grocery store attached to their home. He fights to attract customers while facing robberies, counterfeit money, and other threats.

videos.title: Jaali Note
videos.overview: Family Kirana Store ki ho gayi hai atrangi si shuruwat, pehle kisse mein hi lagg gayi hai jaali note iss family ke haath!

videos.title: Grahak Ki Gaddari
videos.overview: Family Kirana Store mein dedi suvidhaaye saari, phir kyu ki Gajanand ji ke saath grahak ne gaddari?

videos.title: Double Munafa
videos.overview: Pyaaz ke badhte daam kya karwayegi Family Kirana Store ka munafa double, ya phir ek baar lagegi iss anokhi family ke haath koi badi trouble?

videos.title: Dukaan Mein Chori
videos.overview: Kabhi koi de jaaye nakli note toh kabhi mil jaati hai pyaaz ki bori, Magar iss baar kya Family Kirana Store mein hone wali hai khule-aam chori?

videos.title: Grahak Hi Bhagwan Hai?
videos.overview: Customers want cheaper goods from the family grocery store, now Gajju Bhaiya will know whether the customer is really God!

videos.title: Aamdani Athani
videos.overview: The family grocery store has opened its doors for us all once again, but will Gajju Bhaiya and his family be able to withstand the blow of rising prices this time?

videos.title: Expiry Date
videos.overview: Gajju Bhaiya sold expired soap, will this lead to family grocery store sealing?

videos.title: Digital Scam
videos.overview:
Will he teach everyone a lesson, or quietly accept defeat?

What will happen, after all, when Gajju Bhaiya falls victim to a digital scheme?

videos.title: Chabi Ka Chakkar
videos.overview: The key has been stolen, and Gajju Bhaiya is on the hunt; How did a single key become a burden for the entire neighborhood?

tt29959401.name: Mollywood Times
tt29959401.description: Vineeth Madhavan tries hard to become Malayalam cinema's greatest horror filmmaker, but will the toxic industry affect his dream?

tt31455863.name: Kenatha Kanom
tt31455863.description: Desperate to find water, residents of a parched village start digging a new well, but what they find is not water but a dinosaur fossil.

tt39028469.name: Dhoolpet Police Station
tt39028469.description: Set in the volatile area of Dhoolpet, this crime thriller follows a deadly trail of decapitation murders during a vibrant festival, pushing cops into a high-stakes chase where every clue is soaked in danger

videos.title: The Destruction of the Demon
videos.overview: Dhoolpet celebrates Ayudha Pooja, and the police station gets alerted after news of a new ACP’s arrival. And a mysterious stranger with a gun checks into a lodge, while Constable Maasani gets intuitions on murders about to happen on the same night, the very next morning in the town, two young boys are found near a temple holding a head, which creates tension around Dhoolpet.

videos.title: Triple Heads, Triple Murders
videos.overview: Chandra proudly surrenders her sons at the Dhoolpet Police Station for avenging their father’s death, creating tension when two politicians intervene. Soon after, a burnt head was found in the dump yard and that led the police dog straight to the lodge of the mysterious stranger. During interrogation, the officers discover that he is actually their newly appointed ACP Vetrimaaran. As he takes charge, a woman’s severed head unexpectedly falls from a fish laden tricycle after an accident, adding horror around the town. Vetrimaaran heads to the forensic lab and examines all three recovered heads.

videos.title: It Belongs to the Past
videos.overview: A haunting past resurfaces as Vettrimaran confronts old scars, while a single piece of jewellery drags Sukumar into a mystery that reveals a missing girl’s terrifying truth.

videos.title: Truth and Evidence
videos.overview: ACP Maran interrogates Sukumar. Evidence is found both at Sukumar’s workplace and at his house. Maasani’s intuition says Sukumar is innocent, yet the forensic intelligence begins to suspect him.

videos.title: Two Poles
videos.overview: Maadhangi, the lawyer who takes up Sukumar’s case, challenges Maran, saying she will confront him in court. ACP Arjun joins ACP Maran in handling the three murder cases.

videos.title: Towards the Target
videos.overview: Arjun and Maran split up their tasks. Maran begins his pursuit of two murder cases, while Arjun sets out to investigate one murder case.

videos.title: Love and Conflict
videos.overview: Maran moves into the first floor of Maadhangi’s house. Arjun begins his investigation with Ratnam’s family. During the course of Arjun’s inquiry, Priya secretly follows him.

videos.title: What the Eyes See Can Be Deceptive
videos.overview: Displeased with Arjun’s way of investigation, Maasani decides to quit the job. However, when Arjun explains the truths he has uncovered in his investigation, Maasani develops respect and admiration for him.

videos.title: Sudden Twist
videos.overview: Maran cleverly handles the harassment caused by Mathangi to make him vacate the house. Meanwhile, as Arjun conducts an investigation at Ratnam’s second wife, Kanchana’s house, an unexpected twist occurs.

videos.title: Truths Revealed by the Shadow
videos.overview: Maran discovers that Mathangi is his childhood friend. Priya informs Arjun about the impending danger. Maasani begins to see mysterious illusions connected to the case.

videos.title: Deadline
videos.overview: On the way to the court, three mysterious men attempt to kill Inba Sekar, and Maran encounters and neutralizes them. Sukumar escapes from Arjun’s custody and goes missing. The Commissioner gives Maran and Arjun a three-day deadline.

videos.title: A New Knot
videos.overview: Arjun strongly condemns Periyathambi’s attempts to tamper with the evidence. Maran shows intense determination to save the absconding Sukumar. The entire focus of the police turns towards Kanchana.

videos.title: The Other Side of the Truth
videos.overview: During the investigation, Kanchana reveals certain truths to Arjun. Sukumar decides to kill his friend Suruli. Maasani tells Arjun that she is a woman from the hills.

videos.title: The Expected and the Unexpected
videos.overview: Suruli attacks Sukumar, who came to kill him, and manages to escape. Maran and Mathangi admit an unconscious Sukumar to the hospital. While interrogating Kulfi Ramesh, Arjun discovers who the real killer is.

videos.title: Trap
videos.overview: Sukumaran regains his memory. Johnny sacrifices his life while planning to kill him. Umapathi gets caught in the trap set by Maran.

videos.title: Honor Killing
videos.overview: Umapathi confesses to killing his daughter Sandhya in the name of honor. Chandra finally breaks her silence.

videos.title: The Third Knot
videos.overview: Sukumaran falls into Sandhiya’s funeral pyre and takes his own life. Maran and Arjun team up to try and solve the third murder.

videos.title: I am not him
videos.overview: The story of Anand becoming Anandi. When the family says they will accept Anandi, Anandi refuses

videos.title: The Shadow’s Color Is Red
videos.overview: Anandi’s husband seeks refuge with the police and gives a statement that Kailasam killed Anandi.

videos.title: Murder
videos.overview: The mystery unravels and the truth about who killed Anandi comes to light.

videos.title: One place, many motives
videos.overview: Maran, Madhangi, Maasani, Arjun, Priya, and everyone from the Thoolpettai police station gather together at a farmhouse for the Commissioner’s daughter’s wedding.

videos.title: After the party!
videos.overview: As the celebrations peak at the Commissioner’s daughter’s engagement party, an argument erupts between Arjun and Priya at the end of the drinking session. Storming out in anger, Priya ends up in danger when she gets caught by a psycho!

videos.title: Silent closeness!
videos.overview: Arjun safely rescues Priya, who was trapped by the psycho, and brings her back to the engagement ceremony. During the mehndi function, romantic feelings begin to blossom between Maran and Maasani.

videos.title: The Engagement Night!
videos.overview: On the night after the engagement ceremony, the Commissioner’s daughter Diya is found dead under mysterious circumstances. Forensic findings and Maasani’s intuition point to one thing,this is not suicide, but murder. Who is the killer?

videos.title: Hidden Truths!
videos.overview: Maran’s investigation reveals that Diya had expressed her unwillingness to go ahead with the marriage to the groom, deepening the suspicion. Arjun and Maasani travel to the village in search of her missing lover Darshan, where a new mystery unfolds.

videos.title: Madness and Mystery!
videos.overview: During Darshan’s interrogation, a mask and disturbing clues found in his house create shocking revelations. In a sudden twist, the mentally unstable psycho who abducted Priya is caught, pushing the case in an unexpected direction.

videos.title: Broken Authority!
videos.overview: When the Commissioner suddenly goes missing, everyone panics and begins searching for him. Eventually, at a farmhouse, Maaran finds the Commissioner—shattered by the grief of losing his daughter. Meanwhile, during the Arjun–Masani investigation, a crucial piece of evidence emerges that points to the identity of the killer.

videos.title: The Mask Tears Apart!
videos.overview: Vasanth’s one-sided love and Meera’s jealousy-driven mind come to light.A shocking revelation confirms that Diya’s death was not an accident, but a carefully planned murder.

videos.title: Will the Bomb Explode?
videos.overview: Under the guise of plumbing work, Kumaresan and Murugan secretly plant a bomb inside the Dhoolpet Police Station. At the same time, a domestic dispute case turns into a clash of Maran vs. Arjun’s styles, plunging the station into chaos.

videos.title: The Last Minute
videos.overview: Maran smartly reunites a couple who arrived at the station fighting. At the same time, Arjun captures the plumber who planted the bomb, and the explosion is prevented at the last moment.

videos.title: Justice at Gunpoint?
videos.overview: It is revealed that a professor was behind the bomb planting. As ADCP Natarajan orders an encounter, what decision will Maran take?

videos.title: Who is that Police Officer?
videos.overview: Vetrimaaran discovers that the professor planted the bomb because his daughter was brutally assaulted and murdered. When it is revealed that the culprit is a police officer, will Vetrimaaran uncover the real criminal?

videos.title: Truth Forced out
videos.overview: Maasani, Arjun, with Vetrimaaran, questions Ebin. When Maasani trusts him, Arjun warns her to focus on the truth. Ebin denies everything, but when Vetrimaaran interrogates him severely, Ebin reveals the truth.

videos.title: The Sound of nearing Suspicion
videos.overview: With the information given by Jasmine, the police questioned ADCP Natarajan driver Pandian. Meanwhile Maasani get disturbing intuitions.

videos.title: Abuse of Power
videos.overview: When ADCP Natarajan arrives at the site of the encounter, Arjun and Vetrimaaran reveal the identity of the culprit, which shocks them. Later, they explained to Maasani and Madhangi how they tracked him.

videos.title: Hidden Traces
videos.overview: At Dhoolpet Police Station, a man named Vetrimaaran files a complaint stating that his family was murdered twenty years ago. At the same time, Periya Thambi approaches Arjun with a complaint that jewellery has been stolen from his house.

videos.title: Hidden Remnants
videos.overview: A man claiming to be Vetrimaaran goes to his old house and creates a disturbance; he tries to rekindle an old friendship with Maathangi. At the same time, Arjun visits Priya’s house to investigate the jewellery theft, while Maasani experiences fleeting visions of a looming danger around him.

videos.title: Forbidden Investigation
videos.overview: The Commissioner calls Vetrimaaran and tells him not to investigate the murder case that happened twenty years ago. At the same time, Arjun brings in the key makers who helped the thieves and questions them about the theft that took place at Priya’s house.

videos.title: Emotion and Truth
videos.overview: ACP Vetrimaaran is caught off guard by an unexpected emotional encounter. Meanwhile, ACP Arjun goes undercover as a thief, recreating the robbery at Periya Thambi’s house to uncover how it really happened.

videos.title: Closing Shadows, Rising Truth
videos.overview: A mysterious gang launches a deadly attack on the man claiming to be Vetrimaaran. Meanwhile, Arjun uncovers who is behind the unusual signature left at Periya Thambi’s house. Just as the mystery deepens, Vetrimaaran receives a chilling phone call from an unknown caller.

videos.title: A Mysterious Call and Shifting Identities
videos.overview: ACP Vetrimaaran tracks the source of a mysterious call to the imposter, uncovering a hidden truth about his younger siblings. Meanwhile, the man posing as Vetrimaaran becomes the target of a sudden shooting.

videos.title: The Hidden Identity
videos.overview: At Vetrimaaran’s house, Arjun angrily questions him about the shooting that took place at the police station. During the confrontation, Vetrimaaran reveals to Arjun and Maasani the truth about his real identity.

videos.title: What Happened That Night?
videos.overview: Vetrimaaran tracks down the woman who spoke to him and goes to her house.There, he questions her to find out what happened to his younger brother and sister on the night of the murder.Meanwhile, Maasani receives information that the theft is going to take place at the temple that day and informs Arjun.

videos.title: The Truth Revealed in a Dream
videos.overview: To prevent the theft, Maasani and Arjun go to the temple pretending to be a married couple.There, Maasani suddenly feels dizzy and faints.At that moment, a woman who appears like a divine figure appears in her dream and tells her a few things.This leaves Maasani confused.

videos.title: The Search Continues
videos.overview: Vetrimaaran teams up with Maasani to question his sister’s kidnapper, while the Commissioner puts Arjun under pressure with a strict deadline to catch the thief.

videos.title: Two Trails
videos.overview: Arjun sets a trap to catch the thief behind Periya Thambi’s robbery. Meanwhile, Vetrimaaran reopens the case of his sister’s 20-year-old disappearance and sends Arjun to a location he believes will reveal the truth.

videos.title: The Beginning of a Shock
videos.overview: Arjun rescues Narmada from fake Q Branch rowdies. But while chasing the thief, a shocking truth about him comes to light. Can Arjun face it?

videos.title: A Heart Broken by Truth
videos.overview: Vetrimaaran learns the truth about who Narmada is, while she is admitted in the hospital, and breaks down emotionally in front of Maathangi. He then goes to Maasani’s house and agrees to go to the temple with her.

videos.title: The Turning point
videos.overview: Maasani is shocked to learn who Vetrimaaran’s real sister is. Vetrimaaran sets out to rescue Narmada from Mahendran. Maathangi takes Arjun to the place where Vetrimaaran and Narmada are.

videos.title: A Shadow That Haunts Beyond the End
videos.overview: Vetrimaaran learns from Mahendran about the atrocities that happened to his family. At the same time, he is shocked to discover who his real sister is. Mahendran warns that even if he dies, the danger to Vetrimaaran and his sister will continue.

tt3011960.name: Hangman
tt3011960.description: A homicide detective brings his partner out of retirement to help catch a serial killer whose crimes are based on the children's game Hangman.

tt35064672.name: Cocktail 2
tt35064672.description: After a decade together, Diya and Kunal's relationship is shaken when Ally, old friend re-enters their lives. What begins as a plan between two women spirals into chaos, triggering hilarious, emotional rollercoaster none of them s...

tt37561290.name: Karakkam
tt37561290.description: A drunken New Year's prank goes horribly wrong when two young men remove sacred crosses from graves. Five restless ghosts emerge to haunt their every move, driving them to seek redemption and release.

tt40494646.name: Local Times
tt40494646.description: What happens when four friends try to save a dying newspaper with nothing but blind ambition, street smarts, and each other? Local times is a heartfelt comedy of misadventures, where the real headline is the friendship that keeps them going-even when nothing else does.

videos.title: Avargal
videos.overview: A proof-of-life photo from a local kidnapping features their newspaper, pulling the gang into the case. Covertly helping the police to crack it- in the process, they accidentally land their first big headline.

videos.title: Indru Poi Naalai Vaa
videos.overview: A payment blunder bruises the ego of a local boxer, prompting a one-on-one challenge. Just as the gang scrambles for a champion amongst themselves, the kidnapper from previous episode returns, setting the stage for a chaotic showdown as multiple gangs converge on their office, all focused to destroy them.

videos.title: Aan Paavam
videos.overview: A 40-year-old woman shocks the gang by requesting an ad in their newspaper putting herself up for adoption after being abandoned by her children. A new interested party pressures them to sell their newspaper, sparking a rift between Veera and Azhagu.

videos.title: Iruvar
videos.overview: After an intense fight, Azhagu quits Namma Seidhi, leaving the gang in shock. While dealing with the fallout, a vlogger drags the newspaper into an expose, accusing it of promoting low-quality restaurants and calling it a scam. Will Veera and Azhagu bury the hatchet to save the paper, or is this the end of Namma Seidhi?

videos.title: Nizhal Nijamaagiradhu
videos.overview: An anonymous source approaches the gang with news before it happens. Initially wary, they decide to publish his stories, and after missing the first-which proves true-the second one boosts their PR. As trust in the source grows, could this partnership save their sinking newspaper, or his good deeds too good to be true?

videos.title: Naalaya Seidhi
videos.overview: After a major story from the new source backfires, nearly driving away all their advertisers, the gang discovers the identity of the puppet master behind the chaos. He has a clear agenda: to buy Namma Seidhi as cheaply as possible by playing as dirty as possible.

videos.title: Makkal Aatchi
videos.overview: The gang makes the biggest blunder in the history of Newsprint -printing empty pages that reach the community. But a stroke of luck turns the mistake into a symbol of protest. Will they survive the fallout, or is this truly the end of Namma Seidhi?

tt42316559.name: Ramani Kalyanam
tt42316559.description: Follows a visually impaired girl and a boy who cannot walk as their lives intersect through a matchmaking arrangement.

tt33334267.name: Bharat Bhhagya Viddhaata
tt33334267.description: Inside Cama Hospital, one of the sites targeted during the 2008 Mumbai terror attacks, nurses, ward boys, cleaners, lift operators, security personnel, and administrative workers keep 400 people alive while armed assailants struck the city around them.

tt38195069.name: Tumm Se Tumm Tak
tt38195069.description: Anu, a kind 20-year-old, and Aryavardhan, a resolute 45-year-old businessman, defy societal norms and family resistance, overcoming struggles to demonstrate that love transcends age or boundaries.

videos.title: Aryavardhan and Anu's First Meet
videos.overview: Raised in a middle-class family, Anu lives with her parents, Gopal and Pushpa. Aryavardhan, a noted businessman known for being extremely punctual, meets Anu for the first time on his way to an event.

videos.title: Aryavardhan Boosts Anu’S Confidence In College
videos.overview: College students mock Anu, who comes on stage to give a speech, but Aryavardhan encourages her. At the suggestion of some students, Aryavardhan gives Anu a blank cheque, showing his trust in her.

videos.title: The Blank Cheque Fuels Pushpa’S Greed
videos.overview: Anu tells Gopal and Pushpa about the blank cheque, sparking greed in Pushpa. The next morning, Anu visits Aryavardhan’s office to return it, only to be shocked by an empty envelope.

videos.title: Can Anu Stop Pushpa From Depositing The Cheque?
videos.overview: Meera ousts Anu from the office. Aryavardhan learns of it and makes Meera apologise. Anu, worried about the lost cheque, rushes to the bank with Gopal after learning that Pushpa went to deposit it.

videos.title: Anu Returns The Cheque To Aryavardhan
videos.overview: Meera gives Anu a written apology. Anu returns Aryavardhan’s cheque, prompting him to set a condition in exchange. She calms an infuriated Pushpa, but the neighbourhood women mock Pushpa.

videos.title: Anu’S Family Arrives At Aryavardhan’S Party
videos.overview: Anu, Pushpa and Gopal face humiliation at Aryavardhan’s party entrance until he arrives and takes them in. During the event, Aryavardhan asks Anu to launch the new product herself.

videos.title: Meera Insults Gopal At The Party
videos.overview: At the party, Meera gets Gopal drunk and has him humiliated. Aryavardhan scolds Meera for her behaviour and apologises to Gopal. Later, he makes a promise to Anu.

videos.title: A Special Party For Aryavardhan
videos.overview: Anu collects money to host a party for Aryavardhan. Meanwhile, he cancels a meeting to spend time with her, upsetting Meera. Jhende keeps an eye on them but soon loses track.

videos.title: Aryavardhan Experiences A Simple Life With Anu
videos.overview: Aryavardhan experiences a simple life with Anu. Later, he saves her from an accident, but Raghu, the father of a suitor coming to see Anu, sees them on the street.

videos.title: Aryavardhan Gives Anu A Job
videos.overview: Raghu visits Anu’s house and refuses to get his son Vipin married to her. Aryavardhan arrives, scolds Raghu, and offers Anu a job. The next day, Raghu returns to her house with a secret motive.

videos.title: Anu’S First Day At Work
videos.overview: Raghu explains to Rajni the motive behind marrying Vipin to Anu. Meanwhile, Aryavardhan promotes Meera and makes Anu her assistant. However, Anu makes a mistake on her first day.

videos.title: Aryavardhan Changes The Office Rule For Anu
videos.overview: Aryavardhan surprises Meera and others by changing an office rule for Anu. She tries to put Anu down during introductions, but Aryavardhan defends her by revealing her strengths.

videos.title: Aryavardhan Lashes Out At Anu
videos.overview: Anu pays off Gopal's debt and protects him from humiliation. While Meera plots to get Anu fired, Aryavardhan lashes out at Anu for bringing champa flowers in the office.

videos.title: Meera Fails To Get Anu Fired
videos.overview: Meera believes that her plan to get Anu fired will succeed. However, Anu exposes worker exploitation at Aryavardhan’s factory, prompting him to assign her a new responsibility, leaving Meera stunned.

videos.title: Has Aryavardhan Fallen In Love With Anu?
videos.overview: Aryavardhan is shocked to learn that Anu is engaged to Vipin. Jhende makes him realise that he’s fallen for Anu, but also discourages him from pursuing the relationship.

videos.title: Meera Grows Jealous Of Anu's Relationship With Aryavardhan
videos.overview: Gopal opposes Anu’s marriage to Vipin and returns Raghupati’s gifted fridge. Meanwhile, Jhende shares news with Aryavardhan. Meera grows jealous seeing Aryavardhan dine with Anu.

videos.title: Harshvardhan Fires Anu From Her Job
videos.overview: Aryavardhan's brother Harshvardhan comes to the office, but Anu stops him from meeting Aryavardhan. In anger, Harshvardhan orders Anu to be fired and informs Aryavardhan about it.

videos.title: Anu Keeps Her Job Loss A Secret At Home
videos.overview: Relying on Anu’s job, Pushpa buys an expensive saree for her on installments. Anu hides the fact that she has lost her job. The next day, she calls Aryavardhan, but Meera disconnects the call.

videos.title: Anu Realises She Is Falling For Aryavardhan
videos.overview: Anu realises she is falling for Aryavardhan and prays to the Goddess for clarity. Soon, Aryavardhan arrives at the temple, finds Anu, and asks her to come to the office the next day.

videos.title: Anu Is Reinstated At Work
videos.overview: Bholi’s husband gifts her a scooter, but Pushpa accidentally damages it. Meanwhile, Aryavardhan convinces Harshvardhan to rehire Anu, who invites him to a religious gathering.

videos.title: Aryavardhan Visits Anu For 'Mata Ki Chowki'
videos.overview: Anu decorates a doll resembling Aryavardhan for 'Mata ki Chowki'. When he visits her home, he invites his foreign delegates to join him. Seeing the doll, Aryavardhan questions Anu’s feelings for him.

videos.title: Meera Fumes At Aryavardhan's Praise For Anu
videos.overview: Aryavardhan praises Anu for her saree, sparking Meera’s jealousy. Determined to win his attention, Meera sets a plan in motion. Meanwhile, Raghupati schemes to marry Anu off to Vipin.

videos.title: Anu Shares Her Feelings With Simran
videos.overview: Gopal refuses to take help from Raghupati. Anu tells Simran that she has fallen in love with Aryavardhan. Meanwhile, Pushpa plans Anu’s marriage with Bipin and then visits Aryavardhan’s office.

videos.title: Pushpa Invites Aryavadhan For Dinner
videos.overview: At Pushpa's invitation, Aryavardhan visits Anu's house for dinner. Pushpa sends Anu and Gopal out of the house on some pretext and talks to Aryavardhan about Anu's marriage.

videos.title: Siddhi Mata Predicts Anu's Marriage
videos.overview: Pushpa requests Aryavardhan to persuade Anu to marry Bipin. The fortune-teller Siddhi Mata predicts Anu's marriage, and later, Anu decides to find out Aryavardhan's marital status.

videos.title: Aryavardhan Asks Anu Her View On Marriage
videos.overview: Meera scolds Anu for trying to find out about Aryavardhan’s personal life. Aryavardhan asks Anu for her opinion about marriage. Later, FM, a peon, tells Anu something, which shatters her.

videos.title: Aryavardhan Comes Home For A Puja
videos.overview: Anu prays for a way to resolve her dilemma, and Siddhi Mata comes to her doorstep. Aryavardhan's mother organises a puja, and he arrives at home to attend it. Simran asks Anu to look into Mrs Vardhan.

videos.title: Aryavardhan Finds Out About Anu
videos.overview: Aryavardhan gives a gift to his mother. Pushpa calls Aryavardhan to talk about Anu's marriage, and Aryavardhan's mother misunderstands the situation. Later, she asks Jhende about Anu.

videos.title: Anu Is Shocked To Hear Aryavardhan's Words
videos.overview: Aryavardhan calls Anu to meet him, but when Gopal learns that it’s part of Pushpa’s plan, he gets angry. In her dreams, Anu confesses love to Aryavardhan, but in reality, she is shocked by his words.

videos.title: Gopal Makes A Promise To Anu
videos.overview: Pushpa adds to Anu's pain by flaunting the wedding preparations. Meanwhile, Aryavardhan's mother urges him to understand what's in Anu's heart. Gopal makes a promise to Anu upon learning her decision.

videos.title: Raghupati Gives Pushpa Some Time
videos.overview: Raghupati gives Pushpa eight days to convince Gopal for Anu and Bipin's marriage. When the gas cylinder runs out at home, Anu goes to the office hungry. Meanwhile, Gopal is fired from his job.

videos.title: Pushpa Keeps A Secret From Anu
videos.overview: Aryavardhan sends food for Anu, but she declines, asking him not to worry about her. Gopal conceals his loss of job from the family, while Pushpa hides a secret from Anu, who eventually uncovers it.

videos.title: Gopal In Search Of A Job
videos.overview: Aryavardhan convinces Anu to let go of her feelings and marry Bipin. Meanwhile, Gopal wanders in search of a job. Anu leaves important office work and sets out with Pushpa to find Gopal.

videos.title: Aryavardhan Is Pained By Anu’S Decision
videos.overview: Anu agrees to marry Bipin in front of Aryavardhan, leaving him pained. Later, a distressed Gopal faints after losing his shop, and Anu and Pushpa rush to his aid.

videos.title: Aryavardhan’S Lonely Journey
videos.overview: Mrs Vardhan advises Aryavardhan to help him overcome his loneliness. Gopal reluctantly talks to Raghupati about Anu and Bipin’s alliance, while Anu approaches Meera for help.

videos.title: Anu Accepts Meera's Condition
videos.overview: Meera offers Anu financial help on a condition, which Anu accepts. As Aryavardhan longs for Anu, he unexpectedly shows up at the family gathering where her wedding date is being set.

videos.title: Aryavardhan Arrives To Help With Anu’S Wedding
videos.overview: Aryavardhan visits Raghupati’s house as Anu and Bipin’s wedding date is set. He later asks Anu’s family to let him assist with the preparations and opens up about his past.

videos.title: Anu Allows Aryavardhan To Stay At Her Home
videos.overview: Aryavardhan requests to stay at Anu’s home until her wedding, but she agrees with a condition. When the moment is right, Anu questions him, and Aryavardhan discovers Raghupati’s ploy.

videos.title: Aryavardhan Decides To Stop Anu's Wedding
videos.overview: Pushpa avenges Gopal's insult by confronting Subhash. Aryavardhan discovers Raghupati's real motive and decides to stop Anu and Bipin's wedding. The next morning, he takes everyone jogging.

videos.title: Harshvardhan Refuses To Grant Leave To Anu
videos.overview: Mansi complains to Aryavardhan's mother about his absence from the office for the past three days. At Meera's behest, Anu arrives at the office to apply for leave but Harshvardhan refuses to grant it.

videos.title: Aryavardhan Helps Anu Choose A Mangalsutra
videos.overview: Aryavardhan comes along with Pushpa and Gopal to the jewellery store, while Anu convinces Harshvardhan to grant her leave. She arrives at the store, where Aryavardhan helps her choose a mangalsutra.

videos.title: The Neighbours Speak Ill About Anu
videos.overview: While Aryavardhan returns from shopping with Anu's family, a beggar recognises him, and he assigns a task to Jhende. Seeing Aryavardhan with Anu, the neighbours start gossiping about them.

videos.title: Aryavardhan Defends Gopal
videos.overview: The neighbours falsely accuse Gopal. Aryavardhan teaches them a lesson, and everyone celebrates Independence Day. Preparations begin for Janmashtami at Aryavardhan’s home, and he tells a lie to Meera.

videos.title: Meera Visits Anu’S House
videos.overview: Anu decides to care for her parents even after her marriage, while Aryavardhan overhears Raghupati sharing a plan with Rajni. When Meera visits Anu’s home to learn about Aryavardhan, Anu grows uneasy.

videos.title: Raghupati's Truth Is Exposed To Anu's Family
videos.overview: Aryavardhan alters one of his company's policies, leading Raghupati to break Anu and Bipin’s alliance. Pushpa pleads with him, but after discovering his true motive, she lashes out.

videos.title: Thoughts About Anu Trouble Aryavardhan
videos.overview: Pushpa breaks Anu and Bipin’s alliance, earning Gopal’s praise, and everybody then celebrates Janmashtami. Later, Anu writes her feelings in a diary, while thoughts about her trouble Aryavardhan.

videos.title: Subhash Gives Gopal His Job Back
videos.overview: Anu’s family decides to throw a party to thank Aryavardhan. Out of fear of Aryavardhan, Subhash gives Gopal his job back. Later, Anu tries to give Aryavardhan a love letter.

videos.title: Aryavardhan Fails To Meet Anu’S Family
videos.overview: Anu, Gopal and Pushpa wait for Aryavardhan at the restaurant, but Jhende keeps him from going there. Soon after, the manager insults them and throws them out.

videos.title: Anu’S Wait Ends In Heartbreak
videos.overview: Anu gets sad as Aryavardhan doesn't show up at the restaurant. Meanwhile, he locks himself in a room, and Manasi vows to uncover the secret of that room. Meera stirs up trouble for Anu at the office.

videos.title: Anu's Proposal For The Investors
videos.overview: Pushpa and Rajni get into an argument. Meanwhile, Anu seeks Gopal's help for a presentation at office and puts forth a proposal for increasing sales for Rajnandini Sarees before the investors.

videos.title: Siddhi Mata Predicts Aryavardhan’S Future
videos.overview: Siddhi Mata tells Mrs. Vardhan about Aryavardhan’s future. Hearing Aryavardhan praise Anu, Mrs. Vardhan expresses a desire to meet her. Later, Aryavardhan finds a way to pacify Anu’s anger.

videos.title: Aryavardhan Is Saddened To See Anu With Bipin
videos.overview: At office, Aryavardhan praises Anu and then asks her to type an apology letter to the Sharma family on his behalf. Later, he sees Anu with Bipin and feels disheartened.

videos.title: Aryavardhan Fumes At Anu
videos.overview: Aryavardhan yells at Anu at the office. When she asks him to take his medicine, he gets furious. But after Anu gets hurt, he gently bandages her wound. Later, he regrets his behaviour.

videos.title: Anu Arrives At Gopal's Shop For A Survey
videos.overview: Anu visits Gopal’s shop with the investors for a survey. Gopal surprises Pushpa with a thoughtful gift. Aryavardhan tracks Anu’s location and meets her there, while Raghupati sees them together.

videos.title: Pushpa's Suspicion About Anu And Aryavardhan
videos.overview: Pushpa and Gopal see Anu with Aryavardhan, and Pushpa gets suspicious. The investors praise Anu, leaving Meera annoyed. While returning home, an FM program reminds Aryavardhan of Anu.

videos.title: Ravi Complains To Meera About Anu
videos.overview: Raghupati shows Rajni a video of Aryavardhan and Anu, revealing his plan. Meanwhile, Anu firmly responds to investor Ravi for speaking against Meera. Upset, Ravi calls Meera to complain about Anu.

videos.title: Meera Scolds Ravi After Learning The Truth
videos.overview: Meera complains to Aryavardhan about Anu, and he authorises her to fire her. But after learning the truth, Meera scolds Ravi instead. Meanwhile, Mansi lashes out at Harshvardhan and insults him.

videos.title: Siddhi Mata Gives Pushpa A Solution
videos.overview: Jhende urges Aryavardhan to stay away from Anu and make a decision. Meanwhile, Siddhi Mata offers Pushpa a remedy for Anu’s marriage worries.

videos.title: Aryavardhan Tells Anu To Join Another Branch
videos.overview: Aryavardhan promotes Anu and asks her to join another branch, but she gets upset and leaves the matter to Goddess Durga. Siddhi Mata then urges both Anu and Mrs Vardhan to visit a temple.

videos.title: Anu’S Family Decides To Visit The Temple
videos.overview: Worried about Harshvardhan, Mrs Vardhan urges Aryavardhan to accompany her to the ancestral temple. Anu’s family decides to go there too. Bipin tells Simran a plan to reunite Anu and Aryavardhan.

videos.title: Anu’S Family Sets Out For The Jivdani Temple
videos.overview: Simran and Bipin’s plan to unite Anu and Aryavardhan gets foiled. Anu’s family leaves for the Jivdani temple, while Aryavardhan’s hope of meeting her begins to fade.

videos.title: Bheem Kaka Advises Aryavardhan
videos.overview: Mansi stops Aryavardhan from going to the temple with Mrs Vardhan. Meanwhile, Anu’s family arrives there. Hoping for a miracle in a bid to meet Anu, Aryavardhan receives advice from Bheem Kaka.

videos.title: Will Anu's Wish Be Fulfilled?
videos.overview: Anu’s family performs a puja at the temple, where Mansi clashes with Pushpa. Mrs Vardhan feels a sense of connection with Anu. Just as Anu makes a heartfelt wish to the Goddess, Aryavardhan arrives.

videos.title: The Goddess Unites Anu And Aryavardhan
videos.overview: Aryavardhan hides his face upon seeing Anu at the temple, but Anu senses his presence. Later, he seeks answers to his dilemma from Mrs Vardhan, while Anu prepares to leave for Jaipur.

videos.title: Aryavardhan’S Betrayal Hurts Anu
videos.overview: Pushpa and Gopal plan to stop Anu’s transfer. Hurt by Aryavardhan’s betrayal, Anu arrives at the office, where Meera surprises her. Anu recalls her first meeting with Aryavardhan and his advice.

videos.title: Anu Leaves For Jaipur After A Promise To Gopal
videos.overview: Jhende advises Aryavardhan to forget Anu. Meanwhile, Anu reveals Aryavardhan's betrayal to Simran. She makes a promise to Gopal and leaves for Jaipur after bidding everyone adieu.

videos.title: Aryavardhan Tries To Stop Anu From Going To Jaipur
videos.overview: Aryavardhan chases Anu’s bus to stop her from going to Jaipur, but Anu stands firm and questions him. Meanwhile, Jhende uncovers something troubling and grows anxious.

videos.title: Aryavardhan Rescues Anu From Trouble
videos.overview: Upset with Aryavardhan, Anu gets off the bus midway and lands in trouble, but Aryavardhan rescues her. Later that night, they stay at a hotel, where Anu gives him a gift.

videos.title: Anu Learns About Aryavardhan's Feelings
videos.overview: Aryavardhan pours his heart out before a sleeping Anu, who is delighted to hear his words. Jhende finally tracks them down and sends Anu home. However, Gopal gets furious on seeing her.

videos.title: Aryavardhan Slaps Jhende
videos.overview: Meera pours her heart out to Jhende. Gopal suspects Aryavardhan’s intentions. Jhende and Aryavardhan argue over Anu. In a fit of anger, Aryavardhan slaps Jhende, and the latter makes a firm decision.

videos.title: Aryavardhan Tries To Placate An Upset Jhende
videos.overview: Aryavardhan tries to appease Jhende, stressing on Jhende's importance in his life. Meanwhile, Gopal asks Pushpa to stop Anu from working, but Anu convinces him to let her keep the job.

videos.title: Aryavardhan Announces A Casual Day At The Office
videos.overview: Mrs Vardhan mentions a girl, and Aryavardhan assumes it’s Anu. He announces a casual day at the office and waits for Anu. Later, Mansi’s relative Neel joins the office.

videos.title: A Conspiracy Against Anu
videos.overview: Aryavardhan welcomes Anu at the office. In her neighbourhood, gossip about their relationship angers Gopal. Later, Anu is shocked to find her presentation data missing.

videos.title: Meera Gives Anu A Deadline To Find The Data
videos.overview: Meera gives Anu 24 hours to recover the data, but with one condition. Anu tries to recover it with Neel’s help. Meanwhile, Jhende grows suspicious of Meera and confronts her.

videos.title: Neel Tries To Befriend Anu
videos.overview: Mrs Vardhan urges Aryavardhan to marry. Neel tries to befriend Anu, while Meera sees her plan working. Later, Anu and Aryavardhan fondly recall each other while having kadhi chawal.

videos.title: Anu’S Presentation Inspires Aryavardhan
videos.overview: Anu impresses investors with her presentation and earns Aryavardhan’s praise. Later, she delightedly thanks him for wearing the tie she gave him.

videos.title: Meera's Ploy To Separate Aryavardhan From Anu
videos.overview: Anu misses lunch with Aryavardhan, upsetting him. Jhende grows suspicious of Neel and warns him. Meanwhile, Meera plots to poison Aryavardhan's mind against Anu.

videos.title: Pushpa Invites Neel Over For Tea
videos.overview: Neel helps Pushpa tackle an insolent municipality officer, and she invites him over for tea. Jhende confronts Meera about her scheme to unite Neel and Anu. That night, Aryavardhan pays Anu a visit.

videos.title: Mrs Vardhan Becomes Suspicious Of Mansi
videos.overview: Gopal overhears women maligning Anu over Aryavardhan's visit. Mansi’s praise of Neel rouses Mrs Vardhan’s doubts over her intentions. Later, Mrs Vardhan insists on meeting Anu at Aryavardhan's office.

videos.title: Aryavardhan's Demand Shocks Meera
videos.overview: Meera lies to Mrs Vardhan to keep her from meeting Anu. Aryavardhan shocks Meera by insisting Anu join him in London for a conference. He then makes an announcement, and Anu reveals a secret to Neel.

videos.title: Gopal Forbids Aryavardhan From Taking Anu To London
videos.overview: Jhende visits Anu’s house to collect her passport documents. Learning of the London conference, Gopal confronts Aryavardhan and forbids him from taking her along. Anu then runs into Siddhi Mata.

videos.title: Neel Secretly Informs Mansi And Meera
videos.overview: Raghupati and Rajni push Pushpa into protesting and plot to stop the municipal workers from clearing the garbage. Meanwhile, Anu visits Aryavardhan, and Neel quietly tips off Mansi and Meera.

videos.title: Meera Sends Neel With Anu For Pushpa's Bail
videos.overview: Framed by Raghupati and Rajni, Pushpa is arrested for protesting against a municipal officer. Meera informs Anu and sends Neel to help Pushpa. Meanwhile, Mrs Vardhan offers advice to Aryavardhan.

videos.title: A Nightmare Grips Anu And Aryavardhan
videos.overview: Aryavardhan learns of Pushpa’s arrest and scrambles to the prison. Neel is put behind bars, while Mansi justifies her actions to Mrs Vardhan. Later that night, a nightmare grips Aryavardhan and Anu.

videos.title: An Old Foe Plans An Attack On Aryavardhan
videos.overview: Aryavardhan and Anu perform Kanjak Puja at their homes. An old foe vows to kill Aryavardhan. Later, Siddhi Mata gives Anu an amulet and asks her to tie it on Aryavardhan’s wrist.

videos.title: Jhende Confronts A Dark Realisation
videos.overview: Meera prevents Anu from visiting the office on Dussehra, leaving her crushed. Jhende is shaken by a dark realisation, and a bad omen ensues. Meanwhile, Aryavardhan’s foe walks free from prison.

videos.title: Jhende Sneakily Films Anu And Neel
