videos.overview: Nandlal shakes up the Special Task Force with strict discipline. Varun's name surfaces in his school's case, fuelling conflict. New alliances begin to form in the shadows.
videos.description: Nandlal shakes up the Special Task Force with strict discipline. Varun's name surfaces in his school's case, fuelling conflict. New alliances begin to form in the shadows.

videos.name: Lakshman Rekha
videos.overview: Avinash's work affects his home life when Poonam has a traumatic experience. Meanwhile, Avinash finds out about Gujjar, Devi, Sheikh, their new ally, and their big plan.
videos.description: Avinash's work affects his home life when Poonam has a traumatic experience. Meanwhile, Avinash finds out about Gujjar, Devi, Sheikh, their new ally, and their big plan.

videos.name: Asura Bhaag I
videos.overview: Avinash leads his team into Chambal's dangerous ravines chasing the elusive Abhay Gujjar. Meanwhile, Suman finds a clue at a medical college that may solve a long-standing mystery.
videos.description: Avinash leads his team into Chambal's dangerous ravines chasing the elusive Abhay Gujjar. Meanwhile, Suman finds a clue at a medical college that may solve a long-standing mystery.

videos.name: Asura Bhaag II
videos.overview: Kabir sets the stage for Avinash to invade Gujjar's lair in the Badlands. Realising that the deal with Sheikh won't be fulfilled, the Naxal troop tries to intimidate him.
videos.description: Kabir sets the stage for Avinash to invade Gujjar's lair in the Badlands. Realising that the deal with Sheikh won't be fulfilled, the Naxal troop tries to intimidate him.

videos.name: Vishwasghaat
videos.overview: Baljeet and Suman's divorce shocks all, and a courtroom clash sparks humiliation. Avinash cracks his son Varun's case. A wedding celebration turns tense with unexpected trouble.
videos.description: Baljeet and Suman's divorce shocks all, and a courtroom clash sparks humiliation. Avinash cracks his son Varun's case. A wedding celebration turns tense with unexpected trouble.

videos.name: Maharathi
videos.overview: Amidst allegations of corruption, Laxmikant takes an extreme step. Suman makes a shocking discovery about the lab assistant Sharda Awasthi, and she calls Baljeet for help.
videos.description: Amidst allegations of corruption, Laxmikant takes an extreme step. Suman makes a shocking discovery about the lab assistant Sharda Awasthi, and she calls Baljeet for help.

videos.name: Yudh Viram
videos.overview: Investigation on Sharda answers a lot of unsolved mysteries and sheds light on Sheikh's past. Meanwhile, Sheikh sends Imran to kill Avinash.
videos.description: Investigation on Sharda answers a lot of unsolved mysteries and sheds light on Sheikh's past. Meanwhile, Sheikh sends Imran to kill Avinash.

videos.name: Takhta Palat
videos.overview: The suspended STF team decides to fight back and go after Mahaveer. Ahalawat proves his worth and gives Gaya Prasad a fighting chance in court.
videos.description: The suspended STF team decides to fight back and go after Mahaveer. Ahalawat proves his worth and gives Gaya Prasad a fighting chance in court.

videos.name: Mahabharat
videos.overview: A crucial witness jeopardises the STF team's case, but a new friend welcomes Avinash. Devi cleans house to safeguard Sheikh, but another battle awaits the supercop.
videos.description: A crucial witness jeopardises the STF team's case, but a new friend welcomes Avinash. Devi cleans house to safeguard Sheikh, but another battle awaits the supercop.

tt44631165.name: Kidilam Paru
tt44631165.description: Chanthu sees marrying Paru as his chance to move abroad, while Sharath, an aspiring influencer, hopes to connect over shared interests. Things quickly spiral into a series of funny misadventures and unexpected bonds

tt39299630.name: Vadam
tt39299630.description: A action packed Village Family Drama. Hero’s Extraordinary Bond with his Bull. Story based on “Vada Manju Virattu”.  Family relationship highlighted emotionally

tt36451817.name: Raakaasa
tt36451817.description: Returning home after a decade, an NRI chasing romance inadvertently awakens an ancient darkness long feared by his village. As the threat intensifies, love turns deadly and life hangs in the balance.

tt36201830.name: System
tt36201830.description: Privileged prosecutor Neha Rajvansh and humble stenographer Sarika Rawat's lives collide in a system where power shapes truth, forcing them to question the meaning of justice.

tt40617563.name: Vimal Khanna
tt40617563.description: An accountant accused of killing his brother flees, assumes the identity Vimal Khanna, and faces blackmail while seeking his vanished wife. Survival and accidental heroism drive noir-style rescues and moral choices.

videos.title: Kismat Ka Khel
videos.overview: Vimal Khanna, a ragpicker, is hired by Amrita Das after he bravely saves the life of her husband. Vimal accepts the offer and enters the villa, using it as a refuge to escape and hide from his past.

videos.title: Kastaa Shikanjaa
videos.overview: Vimal is attacked by a burglar and realizes he is in danger. He had come to the villa seeking refuge, but now finds himself trapped within it. To make matters worse, Inspector Jyoti arrives in the city, in search of him.

videos.title: Kuch Raaz
videos.overview: Vimal decides to stay on in the villa, determined to dig into the hidden secrets of every member of the Dass family.

videos.title: Chakravyuh
videos.overview: Vimal begins involving himself in every matter of the house, trying to uncover the conspiracy surrounding Nishant Dass’s accident and the complex, unusual dynamic between Nishant and Amrita an odd couple.

videos.title: Aur Phir Achanak
videos.overview: As Vimal and Amrita grow closer, their connection crosses into an intimate space. But in the aftermath, Vimal is forced to confront the reality of their situation he is Nishant’s caretaker, and Amrita is his employer.

videos.title: Bhoot Aur Vartmaan
videos.overview: Amrita reveals she knows Vimal is a murder convict of his brother, Vimal is haunted by his past, Shalini, betrayed him a turning point that led to the unraveling of his life. He is now on a relentless search for her, desperate to understand why she did it.

videos.title: Makadjaal
videos.overview: Amrita delivers a final checkmate to Vimal, leaving him stunned. She reveals that she was never truly Amrita she was once Sheetal, an innocent woman, until society shaped and hardened her into the person she has become.

videos.title: Shikar Ya Shikari
videos.overview: Amrita sets her plan to kill Nishant, But the stakes rise when Nishant’s daughter, Arushi, becomes part of the plan. Just as the final move is about to be made, everything collapsed Inspector Jyoti storms in and arrests Vimal.

videos.title: Maut Ka Khel
videos.overview: In the end, Vimal emerges victorious, reversing every move Amrita had set in motion. He saves Nishant and Arushi, while Amrita is left to face the consequences of her sins. Yet, even as the dust settles, one question remains—will Vimal ever find Shalini?

tt31593809.name: Biker
tt31593809.description: A seasoned motocross rider returns to the grueling sport he once abandoned, confronting fierce competition and a father who might push him to the brink.

tt40859434.name: Lukkhe
tt40859434.description: A young sportsman infiltrates the wild and dangerous world of Punjab's rap music to investigate a drug syndicate, only to find himself torn between love, family, guilt and brotherhood.

videos.title: Choices
videos.overview: Lucky faces survivor's guilt with the help of a new friend. Rapper Badnaam grows in infamy at Chandigarh, while calling out his rival 'OG'. Undercover cop Gurbani searches for the maker of a new drug 'Demon'. Their paths cross, setting up a collision course between Lucky and Badnaam one driven by love, the other fueled by hate.

videos.title: Trust
videos.overview: Lucky wins over Sanober's family. Badnaam drags Lucky into a dangerous plan to test his loyalty while a nemesis announces his comeback.

videos.title: Trauma
videos.overview: Knowing the bitter truth behind Badnaam and OG's fued distresses Lucky. Sanober fears abandonment. Assassians take a bounty on Badnaam's head and Lucky becomes an eye witness to Badnaam's carnage and true nature.

videos.title: Eye For An Eye
videos.overview: Gurbani confronts her past. Sanober gives Lucky a glimpse of her and Nihal's childhood and enduring bond revealing reasons behind their distrust of cops. Lucky begins gathering intel on the drug lab for Gurbani. The thrill of shooting Badnaam's first music video with 'the fam' falls under the evil eye of unhinged vengeance.

videos.title: Heartbreak
videos.overview: The attack on his life makes Badnaam a legend. The world knows his name. Gurbani makes her move for the drug lab. Lucky faces immense inner turmoil as Badnaam strikes a deal with the devil from his past.

videos.title: Betrayal
videos.overview: Nimmo suspects a leak in Badnaam's troupe, leading Badnaam to paranoia and action. Distrust creates walls between brothers. Lucky is designated as the drug courier to the college music festival where Sanober is to perform. A joyful moment shatters, painting Lucky's fate in black.

videos.title: Retribution
videos.overview: The college music festival becomes a battle of wits between Gurbani and Badnaam. Lucky and Sanober find themselves at the crossroads, having to choose between family and justice but an ace hides up someone's sleeve.

videos.title: Relapse
videos.overview: A concert in memoriam laced with undertones of dark justice. The final showdown sets in motion, a war between a Demon and a Devil while love, goodness and purity are reclaimed amidst turmoil and self destruction. No matter who wins, everyone loses.

tt39283431.name: Prathichaya
tt39283431.description: A father's legacy collides with his son's ambitions in a gripping political thriller that questions the price of power and challenges conventional definitions of success beyond titles and wealth.

tt39664733.name: Kartavya
tt39664733.description: A police officer must hunt an exploited teenage assassin while his own family collapses under caste driven violence and moral absolutism, forcing him toward irreversible choices between institutional loyalty and blood ties.

tt16997004.name: Matka King
tt16997004.description: In this fictional tale set in 1960s Mumbai, an enterprising cotton trader who craves legitimacy and respect, starts a new gambling game dubbed ‘Matka’, that takes the city by storm and democratizes a terrain previously reserved for the rich and elite.

videos.title: Taqdeer, Tadbeer, Tarkeeb!
videos.overview: Brij Bhatti is a cotton exchange worker drowning in debt with a pregnant wife and a directionless brother. With ruthless loan sharks at his door and hope as the only currency, Brij faces a life-changing choice: accept his crushing fate or revolutionise the gambling system, a move with ripple effects unknown to Brij himself.

videos.title: Umeed Ka Karkhana
videos.overview: Integrity is tested when Matka brings Brij both fortune and a target on his back. With a newborn as his lucky charm, Brij reinvents the game, spreading Matka through Bombay's bustling textile mills. While a journalist begins to investigate the rise of Matka, the enigmatic Gulrukh is drawn to the game's allure. Laljibhai orchestrates a plan to dismantle the rising empire, nearly succeeding.

videos.title: Izzat Half, Sangam Full
videos.overview: Brij enters Mumbai's elite world through Gulrukh's circles but struggles to find his place among the city's old money. As Matka explodes nationwide, reporter T.P. rallies officials against the "Matka King," while Inspector Eknath begins clandestine surveillance. With Minister Bapat plotting a state-level intervention, greed and ambition begin to corrupt Brij's empire from within.

videos.title: Tera Pyaar Triple Paana, Mera Pyaar Kabootar Daana
videos.overview: Survival requires innovation as the government launches a rival scheme to dismantle Brij's influence. Forced to think outside the box, Brij expands his reach across India, but success demands a heavy sacrifice. Trust fractures within the inner circle, and an enemy strikes where it hurts most when unbridled greed determines to ruin everything.

videos.title: Safed Kapde, Kaale Dil
videos.overview: Brij adopts a stark new public persona, turning appearance into strategy. While new alliances form, old foundations reveal deep cracks. The game's toll on his home life forces Brij into taking a heartbreaking decision. As Minister Bapat attempts to corner him, Brij proves he is at his most dangerous when his back is against the wall.

videos.title: Lights, Camera, Jodi
videos.overview: As media attention reaches a fever pitch, Barkha feels the heavy weight of her husband's notoriety. Amidst grand celebrations, Dagdu suffers a profound personal loss, and Gulrukh seeks independence for her own business. Inspector Eknath begins to question his faith in the system as Matka spills into the homes, careers, and consciences of every citizen in Bombay.

videos.title: Do Ikke, Ek Gulaam
videos.overview: A wedding celebration leaves Brij's world more fractured than ever. Lacchu pursues dangerous new alliances with outside forces, attempting to pull Brij into a darker game. As the pillars of the Matka world begin to crumble and the inner circle splinters, Brij stands his ground even as the true cost of ambition surfaces in unexpected, violent ways.

videos.title: Open aur Close
videos.overview: As mill workers go on an indefinite strike, Brij is faced with a decision that will affect the city and the country. Lacchu joins Darab's war for power, while Dagdu's fight for Sulabha fractures the circle. Barkha reclaims her identity, and TP weighs the effect of Matka's involvement in the whole system. As everything that was built stands unprotected, the Matka King must play one last hand.

tt37537155.name: Ashakal Aayiram
tt37537155.description: A social media enthusiast chases fame until a major film production arrives in his neighborhood, suddenly bringing his dreams of stardom within reach in ways he never imagined.

tt39398861.name: Sweety Naughty Crazy
tt39398861.description: Shiva, a charming college student juggling three different relationships. As he tries to keep them secret, love, lust, and chaos collide in a playful mix of adult humor, romance, and comedy.

tt38355298.name: Band Melam
tt38355298.description: Giri and Raaji grew up together in a small village; their love and bonding also grew, but changing fortunes and misunderstandings drove them and their families apart. While Raaji moves ahead with her studies, Giri searches for his path through music with his village band. Life takes them in completely different directions until circumstances bring them face to face again. What really unfolds between them forms the rest of the story.

tt31409599.name: Demon Hunters
tt31409599.description: Tommy, a YouTuber known for scamming people with his fake exorcism skills, faces a real challenge when he must save his partner, Alumi, from a zombie demon. Teaming up with Sanjay, an Indian exorcist and computer geek determined to avenge his exorcist guru grandfather, Babaji, Tommy must step up. Will they succeed in their mission, and can Sanjay put aside his quest for revenge to work with Tommy?

tt35668375.name: Glory
tt35668375.description: In a small-town boxing hub, two brothers investigate a shocking murder while navigating a troubled reunion with their father, a renowned coach.

videos.title: K.O.
videos.overview: Brothers Dev and Ravi return to Shaktigarh to hunt for the perpetrator of a brutal attack, while facing their callous father after years apart.

videos.title: Counterpunch
videos.overview: The brothers join forces in their search for vengeance. After returning to the scene of the crime, they stumble upon key evidence.

videos.title: Sparring Partner
videos.overview: A suspect's death leads to questions as Dev confronts Joyna. Raka seeks support elsewhere, while the rival boxing clubs prepare for an emergency trial.

videos.title: Rope-a-Dope
videos.overview: Ravi begins his training — and uses a surprise inspection to coerce a confession. Kookie toys with life and death, unleashing his wrath on Dev.

videos.title: Low Blow
videos.overview: Dev and Ravi's infiltration into a dangerous hideout turns explosive. A violent interrogation leads to an unexpected run from the law.

videos.title: Underdog
videos.overview: After breaking the rules, Ravi pleads his case ahead of the Olympic trials. Dev and Joyna search for clues and Arvind spirals after a shocking find.

videos.title: Suckerpunch
videos.overview: As the truth emerges, Dev must escape danger at every turn. Ravi claws his way to the final to face an old nemesis, but an attack may threaten his rise.

tt35745479.name: Fourth Floor
tt35745479.description: Drawn Back to Chennai by an Unexpected Call From His Former Lover, Dheeren Travels From Mumbai and Checks Into a Secluded Office Guest House. Soon After His Arrival, Disturbing and Inexplicable Events Begin to Unfold Within Its Walls. Night After Night, Dheeren is Plagued by Vivid Dreams—fragments of Memories That Eerily Mirror His Own Past and Unresolved Relationship.  As the Line Between Dreams and Reality Begins to Blur, Dheeren Realizes These Visions Are Not Random. Each Dream is a Clue, Slowly Pulling Him Toward a Buried Truth Connected to His Ex-lover’s Fate. Trapped Between Guilt, Fear, and the Supernatural, Dheeren Must Confront His Past to Uncover What Truly Happened to Her—before the Guest House Claims Him as Its Next Secret.

tt35182033.name: Gedelaraju Kakinada Taluka
tt35182033.description: A feared rowdy-turned-politician, Gedela Raju, is murdered on the night of his political rise in Kakinada. As the investigation unfolds, seven interconnected lives-driven by secrets, ambition, and betrayal-lead back to one shocking truth behind his death.

tt25505032.name: Aapp Kaise Ho
tt25505032.description: Christy invites his old friends to his bachelor party, where Binoy and Sajeer plan a surprise to make the night unforgettable. But when things spiral out of control, the trio must work together to fix the chaos. As tensions rise, their friendship faces the ultimate test. Can they turn the night around before its too late?

tt38109700.name: Pookie
tt38109700.description: He struggles to tell her he wants to separate. When he finally does, she shares the same thoughts. Suddenly realizing he doesn't want to lose her, they reconcile though both still privately consider breaking up.

tt30263074.name: Sapne Vs Everyone
tt30263074.description: Two obsessive dreamers collide with the resistance of expectations, morality and each other.

videos.name: Sapne Vs Zimmedari
videos.overview: Prashant, an honest soul torn between theater and sales, faces a test of character, while Jimmy, an immoral hustler, takes on a high-stake real estate job. With their destinies bound to collide, expect a tale of ambition, morality, and the relentless pursuit of dreams.
videos.description: Prashant, an honest soul torn between theater and sales, faces a test of character, while Jimmy, an immoral hustler, takes on a high-stake real estate job. With their destinies bound to collide, expect a tale of ambition, morality, and the relentless pursuit of dreams.

videos.name: Sapne Vs Darr
videos.overview: Prashant is in a riveting pursuit of the lead role, balancing dreams and his mother's battle with cancer. Jimmy's genius impresses, sparking conflict with Shishir. Their stories collide at Property Lords, promising a gripping drama on dreams, ambitions, and tough choices.

videos.name: Sapne Vs Imaandaari
videos.overview: Amid the chaos, Prashant ends up losing one of the most important things in his life - something that brings him immense happiness. On the other hand, Jimmy strikes a deal with Shishir to seek revenge on his Mamaji. Will Prashant and Jimmy emerge victorious against the odds, or will their dreams shatter?

videos.name: Sapne Vs Kismat
videos.overview: A lifeline at work brings hope to Prashant, but his life takes a dark turn with a family crisis. Jimmy plays with fire by manipulating the pieces in his vendetta against Mamaji. The question looms large: What consequences will Jimmy face, when Mamaj uncovers the truth behind Jimmy's scheming deals?

videos.name: Sapne Vs Zamana
videos.overview: The stakes are higher than ever as Prashant battles against time and destiny to fulfill his dream of becoming the lead actor, all before the clock runs out on his ill mother. Meanwhile, Jimmy goes all out to settle the score against Mamaji with a risky plan that could potentially be his downfall.

videos.name: Sapna Tootne Ki Aawaaz
videos.overview: A broken dream brings Prashant to Mumbai, while Jimmy makes a bold move against Mama and positions himself as a threat.
videos.description: A broken dream brings Prashant to Mumbai, while Jimmy makes a bold move against Mama and positions himself as a threat.

videos.name: Hero Kaun?
videos.overview: Prashant faces rejections and a tough workplace choice. Jimmy provocatively escalates his feud with Mama as Toni tries to keep the peace.
videos.description: Prashant faces rejections and a tough workplace choice. Jimmy provocatively escalates his feud with Mama as Toni tries to keep the peace.

videos.name: Chah Teri Mein Raza Meri
videos.overview: A tense family "truce" meeting spirals for Jimmy, while Prashant's long-awaited success is shadowed by a personal blow.
videos.description: A tense family "truce" meeting spirals for Jimmy, while Prashant's long-awaited success is shadowed by a personal blow.

videos.name: The Sales God
videos.overview: Prashant nears a breakthrough, shadowed by his past, while Jimmy sets a calculated plan for power as Toni advances his own agenda.
videos.description: Prashant nears a breakthrough, shadowed by his past, while Jimmy sets a calculated plan for power as Toni advances his own agenda.

tt39373587.name: Kanimangalam Kovilakam
tt39373587.description: A haunted cemetery draws attention away from the real supernatural force lurking in a nearby hostel, where three students become entangled with an unexplained energy.

tt37028716.name: Yogida
tt37028716.description: It is story about a Honest and straightforward lady police Inspector Yogi works in Coimbatore, where she proves a textile mill owner’s “suicide” is actually a murder by his own son, leading to her transfer to the punishment area Vyasarpadi in North Chennai. There she confronts ruthless don Shekar Babu, who controls the area and its police through fear, power, and political influence, but Yogi refuses to bow down and begins taking action against his network.

tt40744793.name: Suyodhana
tt40744793.description: A young Foley artist has grown up hearing a mysterious voice called Suyodhana and often visualises a figure resembling Duryodhana. Raised by his mother and supported by his childhood friend and partner, his life takes a turn when he is accused of his father’s murder, leading to an investigation that uncovers deeper layers of his past.

tt32104889.name: Haal
tt32104889.description: Two young lovers from opposing social classes navigate prejudice and family expectations in modern-day society, as their forbidden romance challenges deep-rooted traditions.

tt38674977.name: Made in Korea
tt38674977.description: After her boyfriend's betrayal leaves her alone in Seoul, Shenba faces isolation and cultural differences. Through personal growth and new friendships, she finds strength and lasting connections.

tt14338246.name: Ustaad Bhagat Singh
tt14338246.description: A tribal boy is shaped by the values of his teacher, who gives him the name 'Bhagat Singh'. He grows up deeply rooted in strong morals, which guide his actions throughout his life.He stands firm against injustice and takes on powerful evil forces, even when facing overwhelming odds.

tt28769460.name: Nukkad Naatak
tt28769460.description: After being caught robbing the college canteen, best friends Molshri and Shivang are expelled. To be reinstated, they must enroll five children from an impoverished slum into a local school.

tt11296184.name: Velleppam
tt11296184.description: Josemon shirked responsibility while his sister Sarah gave up her dreams for the family. Artist Kaleena comes to paint the church and challenges him.

tt38123566.name: With Love
tt38123566.description: Sathya reluctantly agrees to a blind date arranged by his sister and meets Monisha. They discover they attended the same school years ago. Bonding over shared memories and old crushes, they reconnect with their past and grow closer.

tt39392533.name: Assi
tt39392533.description: When Parima, a school teacher in Delhi, is gang-raped on her way home late at night after an office party, Raavi, a prosecution lawyer, fights tooth and nail to help her get justice. But when eighty sexual assault cases are reported in India every single day, regardless of age group, ethnicity, time, or place,  and only four go to trial, what does justice really mean?

tt36394918.name: Battleground
tt36394918.description:
Battleground brings a unique concept on your screens in the form of fitness reality show. We bring together the nation's most dedicated fitness enthusiasts for the fitness battle. This show blends action, fitness, determination and drama. Get ready to watch the contestants push themselves to their physical and mental limits as they battle it out in the show. The contestants fight to become India's next Fitness & Action Star,

16 contestants compete for India's fitness superstar title in a 28-day challenge. Teams face physical trials and get mentorship from fitness icons. One male and female winner emerge through tests of strength and endurance.

videos.title: Fukra Ne Kiya Proposal Accept?
videos.overview: The battleground is all set to go with Shikhar Dhawan, Rajat Dalal, Abhishek Malhan, Asim Riaz, and Rubina Dilaik hunting for India’s next fitness star! Who'll win the highest bid? Shiva vs Nikhil? Pushpendra vs Parth? But the real twist—will Fukra accept the proposal?

videos.title: Abhijeet Aur Rubina Ka Jhagda?
videos.overview: In Episode 2, tensions rise as Abhishek clashes with Rubina—will it hurt his chances or fuel his strength? The battle heats up with Devkaran vs Bhawish—who’s stronger? Simran and Charu fight for mentor approval, while Rekha and Vashu face off in an epic showdown!

videos.title: Bihari Tarzan Kar Paya Impress?
videos.overview: Bihari Tarzan is here to steal the show, but can he overpower Adnan? Next, Chandani and Nisha face off—both equally strong, who’ll win? Jeet vs Harsh, the entertainer vs the fighter—who will impress the mentors? Rounak vs Ashika, who’ll fight their way to the team?

videos.title: Battle Begins: Asim vs Fukra
videos.overview: On day one of Battleground, a fiery clash erupts between mentors Asim and Fukra! The battle is heated, brutal, and full of surprises, leaving both contestants and mentors in total disbelief. Who will win this battle? Tune in now to witness this epic showdown unfold! Don't miss it!

videos.title: Kyu Hui Mehak Insecure?
videos.overview: Mehak’s insecurity likely stems from feeling neglected or overlooked, especially since Dev Karan didn’t wish her luck before her task. It’s possible she craves validation and attention from him, which she didn't receive. When expectations aren’t met, doubt creeps in, and it’s comforting that Shiva is there to reassure her.

videos.title: Battleground Ki Sherni Kaun?
videos.overview: In the Battleground House, Shernis from every corner of India clash with unmatched strength. Each fiercer than the other, some will rise with grit, while others face hard luck. Only the boldest will lead their teams to victory, proving themselves. Who will conquer all? Who will stand tall as the ultimate Sherni?

videos.title: "Gareeb Hoon, Galeech Nahi!"
videos.overview: Ankul, Bhawish, Shiva, and Raja—four powerhouse finalists, each bringing unmatched strength and grit! It’s neck-to-neck, with every move pushing their limits. Ankul’s relentless drive, Bhawish’s blend of power and style, Shiva’s fearless spirit, and Raja’s raw, explosive strength all make them fierce competitors. Who will emerge victorious?

videos.title: Bihari Tarzan Ka Jalwa
videos.overview: The Bihari Tarzan is back, and he’s stronger, sharper, and more transformed than ever before! With a new look and sharper wit, he’s a whole new package. But has he lost the energetic charm that once defined him? Will this new version of him keep the same strength and dominate every team? Watch now to find out!

videos.title: Haathapai!
videos.overview: The Battleground House has truly turned into a war zone! Contestants are clashing in fierce, no-holds-barred physical fights, with emotions running high and rivalries exploding. As tensions boil over, the line between game and chaos is blurring. What consequences will follow this storm? Tune in to find out!

videos.title: Mentors Ka Decision Kya Hoga?
videos.overview: In today’s Fight Club, all mentors come together to uplift their teams and fuel them for the week ahead. But things take a turn when they're shown intense footage of Rounak and Ashika’s physical fight. As both sides share their truth, tensions rise. What will the mentors decide after hearing it all? Don’t miss it!

videos.title: "Aasteen Ka Saanp?"
videos.overview: Fight Club heats up as Rounak and Ashika finally face off. Rathi starts the fire by calling Devkaran the “saanp” of the battleground, and many agree. Their mentor, Fukra, is disappointed to see his own team turning on each other. Dev proves his strength by beating Bhavesh. Tensions rise across matches before the first elimination looms.

videos.title: Lootere Aagaye Hai!
videos.overview: The group faces tension as no one wants to go to the kill zone. Attempts to reason with Ankul fail as he’s unyielding. Chaos erupts when masked wildcards break in, sparking panic. Dev brawls, shocked to find a girl under a mask. The wildcards then challenge contestants one-on-one to steal credits and earn a place in the house.

videos.title: Battleground Ka Sher Kaun?
videos.overview: Tensions rise as Parth disrupts the trio of Mehak, Dev, and Shiva, leaving the group unsettled. With captaincy playoffs looming, Dev and Shiva are already shaken. A clash with Nikhil—seen as a strong threat—intensifies the drama. Can they pull it together and perform, or will Nikhil seize the moment and win?

videos.title: Pain Ka Powerplay!
videos.overview: Tensions flare as Rathi and Shiva clash, while Rounak faces off with Nisha over a stolen chip containing her credits. In a brutal team power play featuring wildcard picks, chaos ensues—Namrata and Rekha get injured, Raja slams Parth, and Rounak redeems herself with a win over Ashika. But drama follows, as Ashika and Mehak confront her.

videos.title: Nobody Wants Mehak?
videos.overview: In today’s episode, the powerplay is acroyoga, with contestants pairing up—but Mehak is left out as neither Shiva nor Parth picks her. The Campus Beats team arrives to stir the pot with a flirty game of Knife, Kiss, and Dil. Mehak gives her dil to Shiva, but he chooses Rounak, leaving Mehak disappointed. As acroyoga begins, trust is tested—who will rise?

videos.title: Malkham Pe Dangal
videos.overview: The boys plan to target Bhavesh and knock him off the leaderboard. In today’s powerplay, Ankul and Nisha shine, while Dev gives up early. Ashika pushes through extreme distress caused by Rounak, leading to a tiff between Mehak and Rounak. Mehak defends Ashika, Rounak pushes back. Later, Mehak and Shiva clear the air about him giving a rose to Rounak.

videos.title: War
videos.overview: In another explosive Fight Club episode, Mehak confronts Dev, then faces off with Rounak in a high-stakes jackpot fight. A trio match between Adnan, Dev, and Parth ends with Parth injured. Among the girls, Anjali feels sidelined as Asim only supports Chandni, leading to a major showdown with Fukra. The fight escalates—Fukra walks out, and Asim & Rubina follow. Total war!

videos.title: Real Ya Fake?
videos.overview: The Looteras get a golden chance to speak their truth—calling out the fakest and praising the realest in the house. But in a game where words cut deeper than actions, will their honesty spark unexpected alliances... or ignite fresh rivalries? One thing’s certain—nothing will be the same after this reveal.

videos.title: Proposal?
videos.overview: Love brews on the battlefield! As Ankul Thakur drops to one knee, hearts race — will Anjali Rawat say yes or serve a killer rejection? If love triumphs, Mumbai Strikers and UP Dabangs might just form a power couple alliance. But if she friendzones him, rivals may smell blood. One proposal could change the game forever.

videos.title: Shiva vs Rathi!
videos.overview: Shiva and Rathi ignite the battlefield in a fiery clash—each representing rival teams, neither backing down. The tension rises with every move, threatening to ripple through both sides. Will this explosive face-off fracture team unity? When pride's at stake, anything can happen. Stay tuned—this war is far from over!

videos.title: Bhadaasground!
videos.overview: In this fiery episode of Battleground, alliances are cracking, trust is crumbling, and the Bhasaad Zone is lit. With raw emotions and unfiltered drama hitting max level, expect chaos—but where there’s fire, new bonds can spark. Will the meltdown birth fresh alliances or just more explosive bhasaad? Stay tuned, it’s about to get wild.

videos.title: Yaar Ya Pyaar?
videos.overview: In this sizzling Battleground episode, couples face a steamy endurance task—with a twist. They can pick their own partners. Shockingly, Shiva ditches Mehak and pairs up with Nisha Mishra, claiming it's just friendship. But is it really? Stay tuned to uncover what’s brewing beneath the surface.

videos.title: The Game Is Getting Dirty
videos.overview: As finale week hits, chaos reigns. Frenemies toast under fake smiles, secrets swap hands in whispers, and a kiss might just spark war. The game’s chessboard is flipping—alliances crumble, love tangles with betrayal, and someone’s about to make a move so bold, it’ll leave jaws on the floor. Buckle up—it’s endgame time.

videos.title: Rathi Rona!
videos.overview: Rathi’s world turns upside down as even his own team, the Delhi Dominators, stands against him. With emotions running high and betrayal in the air, only his mentor Fukra stands by his side, urging him not to give up. Alone but not broken, Rathi prepares for the ultimate showdown. The real fight begins now—watch to see if he rises or falls.

videos.title: Knockout Ya Walkout?
videos.overview: With the finale looming, there’s no room for doubt—every contestant must give it their all, mind and body. The intensity is off the charts. From here on, it’s knockout or walkout. Alliances will break, emotions will explode, and only the fiercest will survive. The real game begins now.

videos.title: Asli Raja Kaun?
videos.overview: In the battleground house, tensions run high as contestants are asked the ultimate question: Who is the real king of the battleground? Whispers swirl, alliances crack, and bold names are dropped. Some back the loudest warrior, others the silent strategist. But one answer stuns everyone—an underdog whose quiet moves have shaken the game. Who is the real king? The truth might just leave you speechless.

videos.title: Chandani Bhadki!
videos.overview: It’s been a long ride, and the pressure is boiling over! Contestants are no longer holding back—frustration is at its peak. The Bhadaas Zone is on fire, especially with Chandani unleashing her kadak bhadaas like never before! Emotions are raw, tempers are flaring, and sparks are flying. Want to know what’s really been happening with her and the battleground? Stay tuned—it’s getting wild!

videos.title: Power Couple!
videos.overview: It’s time to turn up the heat—our iconic Couple Tasks are BACK. Who’s the real power couple of the house? Who’s got the chemistry, the connection, the unbreakable bond? This is the ultimate test of love, trust, and teamwork. Only one duo will rise above the rest and claim the crown. So buckle up—because this battle is about to reveal who’s truly unshakable.

videos.title: Shock Laga!
videos.overview: Today’s task is unlike any other! Contestants will perform in unexpected pairs—and trust us, these combos will shock you. Speaking of shocks, some might literally feel one! With surprise twists and electrifying moments, stay tuned to see which pair rises, stumbles, or sparks the most chaos!

videos.title: "Just Friends"
videos.overview: Shiva and Nisha Mishra claim they’re just friends—but the house isn’t buying it. While they deny any romantic angle, everyone else sees the spark that says otherwise. The stolen glances, the subtle smiles... it’s all adding fuel to the fire. Are they fooling the house—or fooling themselves? Because for everyone watching, “just friends” feels like the biggest myth of all.

videos.title: Panga!
videos.overview: Tension crackles in the air near the fight club, emotions running high. Rajat and Neeraj, our fierce mentors, lock eyes—words escalate into shouts, past grudges surfacing like sparks on dry wood. Suddenly, the storm breaks—Rajat throws the first punch, Neeraj counters. Chaos erupts. The crowd roars as fists fly and fury reigns. It’s raw, unfiltered, primal—a true fight for dominance.

videos.title: Kisme Hain Kamiyaan?
videos.overview: With the finale in sight, the tension is razor-sharp. The contestants know each other inside out now—strengths, weaknesses, secrets. It's the perfect storm. We asked them: who lacks what? No filters, no diplomacy—just brutal honesty. Accusations flew, egos took hits, and truths stung harder than punches. This wasn’t just strategy—it was psychological warfare. The real battle has only just begun.

videos.title: Chhota Packet, Bada Dhamaaka!
videos.overview: Anjali and Ankul are the perfect definition of chhota packet bada dhamaaka! Don’t let their size fool you—they're packed with power, precision, and pure fire. Time and again, they’ve shattered expectations, and this time was no different. With fierce determination and jaw-dropping skills, they’ve once again left everyone stunned. Tiny frames, massive impact—these two are unstoppable!

videos.title: Sher Hue Dher!
videos.overview: Shiva and Ankul—undisputed powerhouses of the battleground—have conquered every task, dominated every fight, and never backed down. But what could break even the strongest? This episode takes an unexpected emotional turn. Tough choices, bonds tested, and emotions running high—it's a rollercoaster where strength isn’t enough. For once, even warriors like them are brought to tears.

videos.title: Kaun Jeetega Ticket to Finale!
videos.overview: The finale is just a heartbeat away, and the battleground is set for the ultimate showdown—the last individual powerplay! This isn’t just another task; it’s the golden gateway to the finale. Every second, every move counts. With adrenaline surging and eyes locked on the prize, only one will rise above the rest. Who will dig deepest, fight hardest, and claim the coveted ticket to the finale? The heat is on!

videos.title: Ashika Betrayed?
videos.overview: With the finale just around the corner, the real game begins. Alliances that once felt unbreakable are now on shaky ground. It's every player for themselves—and the trophy is calling. In a shocking twist, Ashika feels betrayed, questioning everything. Did Nikhil just make the boldest move of the season or cross a line? Loyalties are crumbling, emotions are flaring. Will bonds survive, or will ambition win? The battleground has never been this intense.

videos.title: Grand Finale Begins!
videos.overview: The grand finale of the battleground kicks off with fire and fury! As the stakes hit the roof, best friends turn rivals and sworn enemies collide in epic showdowns. Every fight is intense, every move could be the last. Loyalty is tested, grudges explode, and the path to the finale is soaked in sweat and strategy. Who will rise, who will fall—and who will fight their way into glory? The war has truly begun!

videos.title: Aakhri Dahaad!
videos.overview: The moment we've all been waiting for is finally here—the grand finale! The battleground is set, the energy is electric, and the players are ready to pour in every ounce of strength, strategy, and spirit. Friendships, rivalries, and weeks of drama all come down to this one showdown. Who will rise, who will fall, and who will walk away with the crown? It's now or never—let the ultimate battle begin!

videos.title: Cheating Ki Ya Strategy Thi?
videos.overview: Battleground returns bigger and tougher with new mentors and fierce rivalries. Masti meets mind games as Khesarilal, Abhishek, Rahul & Priyanka battle for the best contestant. Rohit accuses Divyanshu of cheating, while Gunjan vs Pearl pits experience against speed. Who gets selected and who wins the highest bid?

videos.title: Haath Daal Ke Faad Dunga!
videos.overview: Rekha is back! The toughest contender of season 1, shaking up the competition once again! Meanwhile, Max and Rishabh lock horns in a power-packed showdown, akhada power vs gym strength, who will prove unstoppable? Tension rises as season's first rivalry between mentors Abhishek and Rahul unfolds.

videos.title: Khesari Hue Fukra Se Pareshan!
videos.overview: Fights heat up in auditions as contestants go head-to-head, old friends become competitors, and accusations of cheating spark chaos. While the mentors, Khesari and Fukra add a dose of fun with their playful banter.

videos.title: Fukra Bana Target!
videos.overview: The final auditions decide the contestant’s fate. With only a few spots left, the stakes are high. Mentors play smart to select the best for their teams. Who makes it in and who gets left behind? Drama unfolds with unpredictable turns as the contestants fight. Tune in now. The game is on!

videos.title: Ghar Pravesh Pe Hua Kalesh!
videos.overview: The game kicks off with pure chaos. Divyanshu and Rohit revive their audition rivalry. Twinkle’s refusal over washroom access sparks a heated clash and she becomes the talk of the house. Khesari & Priyanka bring playful flirty banter. Drama, love, fights & nonstop entertainment, this is just the beginning. Don’t miss it!

videos.title: Priyanka Pe Laga Cheating Ka Ilzaam!
videos.overview: Allegations of cheating against Priyanka, sparked by Fukra, ignite an intense mentor face-off. Twinkle is branded the “Chugli Queen,” while Geetika faces sharp criticism for her task performance. As strategies begin to unfold, the first high-stakes captaincy task kicks off—bringing bigger risks and even bigger rewards.

videos.title: Isne Mera Gala Pakda !!!
videos.overview: First captaincy sets the house on fire. Planning and plotting begin, shifting the game’s credit dynamics. The ‘Paani mein panga’ task sparks intense clashes, reigniting old grudges and fueling a new showdown between Divyanshu and Rohit.

videos.title: Love Triangle?
videos.overview: Who wins the first individual task? Credit stealing twist hits, the leaderboard dynamics flip. Bhojpuri Bhaukaals struggle with low morale after losing, while Kajal feels hurt as Divyanshu doesn’t wish her luck, questioning their equation, while a new bond with Rohit begins, is it a hint at a brewing love triangle?

videos.title: Ab Naa Chalegi Teri!
videos.overview: Jhanda Lehrao, Team Jeetao’ turns ruthless. Telugu Tigers get targeted, Kajal calls Rohit ‘dhogla.’ Mind games peak. This season’s first Kill Zone unfolds, where who gets sent to the Kill Zone will be decided by the teams themselves.

videos.title: Who the F*^# Are You?
videos.overview: Players are unhappy heading into the Kill Zone. New space unlocks, the 'Toxic Room'. Curiosity builds over, with credits at stake. The first-ever Couple Powerplay unfolds with perfect distractions, who cracks under pressure and loses their cool?

videos.title: Nikki Ne Kiya Fukra Ko Trigger!
videos.overview: Season’s first ‘Fight Club’ brings unexpected twists and turns. Players face thrilling tasks that are a treat to watch, highlighted by Priyanka’s power-packed performance. Nikki’s explosive entry hijacks the spotlight, sparking Khesari’s playful flirting and a massive clash with Fukra, bringing unlimited entertainment and drama all the way.

videos.title: Sympathy Mat Lo!
videos.overview: Nikki drops a game-changing twist, leaving mentors and players speechless. Divyanshu vs Rohit face off yet again. ‘Most unfit’ debate turns ugly. Khesari left disappointed with his team. Nikki’s ‘Cyber Truck’ dig sparks a massive clash with Fukra. What led to Nikki’s breakdown & Fukra’s exit? Get ready to witness unfiltered reality chaos.

videos.title: You Kissed Me!
videos.overview: "Lootere” make their grand entry, but with a power move no one saw coming! “Lootere” will take over one existing team, who will it be? Preeti exposes Rohit! Gossip takes over the house. The game takes a turn as players are asked to form a brand-new team. With pressure mounting and house politics intensifying, team dynamics are about to get messy! Brace yourself for a lot more surprises ahead.

videos.title: Main Rishabh Ko Pel Dunga!
videos.overview: "The game kicks off with a twist, one entire team won't even get to perform the task. Kajal’s mid-game fall sparks controversy… strategy or real? The match builds to a breathless finish. Rohit slams Preeti over “fake allegations.” Twinkle is labeled as the 'Double Dholki' of the house. And once again, Rohit vs Divyanshu showdown.

videos.title: Isne Mujhe Tamacha Mara!
videos.overview: Parda Hatao, Chehra Dikhao sparks nonstop drama as Divyanshu calls Rohit a “Girgit.” Verbal clashes turn physical, leading to major consequences for Twinkle and Smriti. Kajal breaks down, fearing she’s ruining Divyanshu’s game. Amid the chaos, new captains rise to power but tension in the house refuse to settle.

videos.title: She's a Bad B*#ch!
videos.overview: Bhadaas Room' explodes as contestants vent their bottled-up rage. Sneha brutally calls out Twinkle, while Rekha and Geetika’s argument spirals over taking a stand. ‘Tier ki takkar’ task keeps the game thrilling and unpredictable till the last moment, while a few don’t get to perform.

videos.title: Mujhe Daba Ke Rakh Rahi Hain!
videos.overview: Kill Zone fear returns! Twinkle and Muskan gain advantage. Twinkle’s move turn out to be selfish. One comment sparks a massive war between Rekha and Sujan, with Kajal refusing to stay silent anymore. Nikki’s call fuels the fire and the Lootere team explodes.

videos.title: Kya Gire Hue Log Hain Yaar!
videos.overview: Our competitive mentors set the Fight Club on fire. Intense tasks spark an unexpected alliance, blurring the lines between Fukra and Nikki. Khesari loses his cool, calling out both sides. Rohit vs. Rishabh delivers a fierce showdown. Mentors step in to address the team’s internal cracks. Expect the unexpected… because in this game, the tables always turn.

videos.title: Mentors Pe Aggression Mat Dikhao!
videos.overview: Preeti vs Sneha, who takes the win? Mumbai Strikers face internal disputes, mentors step in. A tug of war unfolds between Nikki & Khesari vs Rahul & Priyanka, packed with competition, banter and entertainment. Strategy meets chaos as Divyanshu, Tanishk & Hartaaj stir the game. Hartaaj’s alliance pitch to Priyanka, backfires.

videos.title: Shocking Elimination!
videos.overview: Smriti vs Muskan deliver a power-packed face-off. Shocking eliminations hit hard, leaving mentors and contestants speechless. Sneha’s decision sparks betrayal, breaking Rekha’s trust, while Hartaaj becomes the main reason. With intense competition and twists, who makes it through?

videos.title: Shiva Machli, Main Magarmach!
videos.overview: Shiva is back with a bang, sparing no one as he calls out Max, Divyanshu, Twinkle, and Rishabh. Kajal loses her cool at Divyanshu for not taking a stand. New captains rise through a gripping task. Amid the chaos, who will emerge as new captains?

videos.title: Max Ne Shiva Ko Patka!
videos.overview: Mitti mein Dangal task brings bigger drama as Max shocks everyone by overpowering Shiva. Hartaaj and Divyanshu’s conflict spirals, with Kajal triggering a fiery showdown.. Can Fatima beat the undefeated Rekha?

videos.title: Lafda!
videos.overview: Bhojpuri Bhaukaals holding the ultimate power to bench any one team. Their bold decision leaves the Delhi Dominators frustrated creating chaos before the task even begins. Shiva and Max get into a physical fight. Unlimited chaos, intense conflict, and explosive tension unfolding in a single episode.

videos.title: Max Show Se Bahar???
videos.overview: Shiva and Max lose complete control, their future in the game remains uncertain. Meanwhile, the fun-filled “Jenga” task brings bizarre challenges and nonstop laughter. Even Divyanshu receives unexpected love from his rival Rohit.. This is Battleground.. expect the unexpected.

videos.title: Fukra Show Ke Liye Unfit Hai!
videos.overview: Fight Club turns upside down. One entire team along with their mentor will face elimination. Will Divyanshu overpower Shiva?  Fukra is disappointed with Sneha’s performance. Nikki accuses Fukra of being unfit for the show and unworthy of being a mentor. Unlimited fire, drama, and shocking allegations.

videos.title: Kis Mentor Ka Hua the End?
videos.overview: Rekha and Fatima clash in an intense MMA showdown as brutal new tasks push everyone to their limits! Amid the chaos, funny mentor moments and Max’s hilarious acting bring some laughter — until a shocking elimination sends an entire team and their mentor home. Who survives the fight club?

videos.title: Mentors Kis Player Ko Karenge Swap?
videos.overview: Mentors swap their players and shake the teams dynamics, while Nikki steps in as the mentor of Telugu Tigers. Semi-finals week gets tougher with Max already in the Kill Zone. Shiva becomes the target for Max and Rohit. “Ball Baby Ball” task brings intense competition and pressure within the team.

videos.title: Tod Dunga Shiva Ko!
videos.overview: The fight for team credits gets wild as teams go all out for victory. Which team will secure the win? Will the credit distribution destroy team unity? Betrayals take over the house after shocking Kill Zone decisions, while Semi Finale Week begins with unlimited pressure, high-stakes battles, and absolutely no room for mistakes.

videos.title: Shiva Ki Rohit Se Phat Gayi!
videos.overview: New rivals Shiva & Rohit face off, who will dominate the game? The Bhadaas Zone turns intense as Rohit, Muskan, and Twinkle brutally call out Shiva. Muskan accuses Hartaaj of being a manipulator. Will Shiva and Hartaaj survive the pressure or will their own mind games backfire them ?

videos.title: Laga Di Aag Humne!
videos.overview: Rohit and Twinkle grab the ultimate power, but their decision turns against Twinkle. Meanwhile, Shiva and Hartaaj come forward as masterminds, manipulating the entire game. Kajal faces major backlash because of Divyanshu. In the next couple powerplay, Who will pair up with whom? With the finale around the corner, every move becomes a fight for survival."

videos.title: Divyanshu Se Baat Mat Kar!
videos.overview: Will credit stealing turn against Max? Kajal and Divyanshu’s bond begins to fall apart, Shiva interferes between them. Rekha and Fatima get into a heated argument. Meanwhile, Fatima becomes the house’s biggest target, will she be the next contestant to enter the Kill Zone? With survival on the line, the fear of the Kill Zone brings out everyone’s fiercest side.

videos.title: Foul Play!
videos.overview: Gear up for the biggest week of Battleground, contestants fight for ticket to finale. Jiski Laathi Uski Jeet task turns against Rohit. Max and Rishabh’s face off turns chaotic and mentors get into a heated argument over foul play. A fiery clash breaks out between Priyanka and Nikki. Explosive battles, and high-voltage drama set the Battleground Semi Finals on fire.

videos.title: Ticket to Finale Ke Liye Mentors Ki Jung!
videos.overview: Divyanshu and Hartaaj go head-to-head in a battle filled with power, and intensity. Things said behind contestants’ back are exposed. Rivals Fatima and Muskan clash in a high-stakes fight to prove who’s truly stronger, while contestants debate who the most undeserving players are. The biggest showdown of the season, mentors step into the battleground to fight for the Ticket to Finale.

videos.title: Maza Bana Saza!
videos.overview: Battleground gets its first finalists! Semi-final elimination shakes the house. Activity sparks hilarious banter and sizzling chemistry between Kajal and Divyanshu, but the celebration takes a dramatic turn with brutal nominations. Kajal breaks down while Shiva leaves Rekha stunned despite their friendship. The road to the finale gets more brutal than ever.

videos.title: Toxic Love!
videos.overview: Finale Week gets intense with shocking nominations, who enters the Kill Zone? Rohit and Kajal’s growing closeness triggers Divyanshu, turning emotions inside the house into complete chaos. Will The Toofani Challenge change the strong friendship equation between Gunjan and Muskan? Meanwhile, Powerplay pairings spark manipulation accusations and a heated argument between Shiva and Divyanshu.

videos.title: Power Aur Dimaag Mein Fark Hota Hai!
videos.overview: Battle of Balance task creates unexpected pairs. Rohit and Divyanshu become the new duo in town! But which pair takes the win? As the game intensifies, cracks begin to show between Gunjan and Rohit’s friendship. Rekha feels betrayed. Amid all the chaos, Divyanshu’s emotional family video call and Max’s comeback lighten the mood. With the finale inching closer, harder battles and bigger twists await ahead.

videos.title: Kaise Ch#*!ya Bola?
videos.overview: Max’s comeback lifted everyone’s mood, while Twinkle’s fun-filled family video call filled the house with laughter as Max continued pulling her leg throughout. Contestants reveal their strongest competitors. Kajal calls out Shiva for constantly pulling contestants aside to manipulate them. During the Road to Finale task, a massive fight breaks out between Divyanshu, Shiva and Hartaaj.

videos.title: Kaun Banenge Finalists?
videos.overview: A fiery clash between the boys drags Rekha and Kajal into the chaos. Who wins The Road to Finale Task? Meanwhile emotional video call from Gunjan & Rekha's families melt hearts. Sunny Hinduja, lead actor of Vimal Khanna, enters the house and adds more fire to the atmosphere. “Naqab, Khanjar & Hero” activity creates major rifts between teammates Rekha and Kajal. The last night before the finalists are revealed, the housemates relive their journey.

videos.title: Aakhri Pariksha!
videos.overview: Shiva and Rohit’s explosive fight takes over the Knockout War. A fun-filled Awards Night brings laughter, banter and memorable moments. Divyanshu and Hartaaj’s battle erupts into a heated argument between Khesarilal and Nikki. Lukkhe Cast makes a Dhamakedaar entry. Rekha and Muskan face off, Who secures a spot in the Top 2?

videos.title: Kaun Jeetenge Trophy?
videos.overview: Gear up for a power-packed Grand Finale! Priyanka lashes out at everyone, while Palak and King bring unmatched enthusiasm to the task. Muskan vs Rekha whose journey comes to an end? Khesarilal gets everyone dancing one last time. Gunjan and Twinkle battle for the final spot. The finalists go head-to-head in high-voltage Powerplay “Jeet Ki Chadayi” task. Who will lift the Ultimate Fitness Superstar trophy?

tt34498610.name: Toaster
tt34498610.description: Murder and chaos erupt when a miser becomes obsessed with a toaster he gave as a wedding gift.

tt31863147.name: Maa Ka Sum
tt31863147.description: Agastya, a math prodigy, believes every problem has a formula - even love. When he sets out to find the perfect match for his mother, his algorithm-fueled adventure spirals into a hilarious tangle of bad dates, big feelings, and one unexpected discovery: sometimes love can't be calculated, only felt.

videos.title: The Blueprint
videos.overview: Agastya, a math prodigy, prevents a fellow student from jumping off a building using maths. He shares a bittersweet dinner with his mother, Vinita, marking his father's abandonment. As Vinita explores dating, Agastya navigates his own breakup. A bookstore encounter with a woman, where his math skills fail him, leaves him baffled. The next day, a new math professor inspires an idea to help Vinita.

videos.title: Work-In-Progress
videos.overview: Agastya hacks a dating app for Vinita, but his algorithm picks terrible dates. To get into his professor's class, he must find her a home, but his data-driven approach fails. His professor teaches him to temper genius with real-world observation, inspiring him to create a new and improved dating algorithm. Meanwhile, Annie hides a secret.

videos.title: Progress
videos.overview: Agastya refines Vinita's dating profile with verified data, finally leading to successful dates for her. Ira allows him to attend her class. Vinita's real estate deal collapses due to Abhimanyu. Annie ends up in hospital due to the pills, leading to a fight with Agastya. Agastya shares his algorithm with Ira. Vinita encounters Abhimanyu again, who apologizes to her.

videos.title: Off Track
videos.overview: Vinita and Abhimanyu connect, but Agastya forbids her to date him, fearing it will disrupt his algorithm. At Ira's party, Agastya meets Heartset's founder and discovers that Ira worked on that algorithm. Ira suggests that she and Agastya create a new algorithm. Annie confesses her feelings for Agastya. Agastya discovers that Vinita is still seeing Abhimanyu.

videos.title: The Tipping Point
videos.overview: Agastya confronts Vinita. As he remembers his father's abandonment, he suffers a panic attack at college and is helped by Annie. Ira challenges his bias against Abhimanyu. Agastya asks Spidey to hack Abhimanyu's social media. At a concert, Agastya and Ira both feel unwell from a spiked drink.

videos.title: The Unravelling
videos.overview: Agastya schemes to end Vinita's relationship. Ira suspects Agastya spiked her drink. Annie reveals her past trauma to Agastya, resolving their past and inspiring a memorial for her brother. Vinita receives incriminating photos of Abhimanyu. Agastya is late for the memorial, causing a rift with his friends. Agastya and Ira share a tender moment. Agastya faces a stark realization.

videos.title: The Final Piece
videos.overview: Agastya confesses his feelings to Ira. Abhimanyu reveals some jolting news about Agastya, shocking Vinita. Agastya has a meltdown when confronted. As his graffiti wall is destroyed, he has a breakthrough in his algorithm. Ira is pushed to make a tough decision. Overwhelmed with everything, Agastya gets into trouble.

When Agastya goes missing and lands in jail after a fight, his friends bail him out. As he navigates his mother's hurt because of his actions and receives an enlightening letter from Ira, he is forced to confront the limits of logic and maths in matters of the heart and human connection. He learns that some things-like love-can't be calculated.

tt27170332.name: Written & Directed by God

tt14181714.name: The Bluff

tt31969779.name: O' Romeo
tt31969779.description: In post-independence Mumbai, the underworld rises amidst a changing city. This gritty tale explores the criminal landscape of a bygone era, weaving through the streets and shadows of India's bustling metropolis.

tt40617561.name: Kaptaan
tt40617561.description: SSP Samardeep, a feared encounter specialist, hides a broken past behind his ruthless image. Years ago, in his pursuit of revenge, he abandoned his informant DK’s brothers. Now In Jwalabad, as Munna, Tinnu, and Shaheen battle for a ₹180-crore tender, Samar joins forces with the ruthless Kabir—only to discover he is one of those lost children, forcing him to face his past.

videos.title: Welcome To Jwalabad
videos.overview: Samar, a tough SSP, stages Bhaiyya Ji's escape to expose a child trafficking ring and kills him after rescuing kidnapped children. As Munna and Shaheen clash over a high-stakes tender, Kabir rises as a fierce force, taking on gangs and cops. Amid rising corruption in Jwalabad, Samar takes charge, vowing to eliminate crime within four months.

videos.title: The Past In The Present
videos.overview: SSP Samar cracks down on corruption while probing a violent tender scam linking Munna, MLA Sangwan, Shaheen, and Kabir. As land grabs, fake liquor, and political conspiracies unfold, Kabir wages war on Munna and uncovers hidden truths. Their paths collide, revealing a dark past that binds Kabir and Samar together.

videos.title: The Handshake
videos.overview: SSP Samar digs deeper into a brutal tender scam, exposing Munna's violent land grab and political nexus. As villagers suffer and Kabir seeks revenge for his past, Samar uncovers links between crime and power. Forced by circumstances, Samar joins hands with Kabir, forming an uneasy alliance to bring Munna down.

videos.title: The Big Bang
videos.overview: Samar teams up with Kabir to expose Munna's expanding liquor empire and land scam. Using strategy and informers, Samar uncovers a hidden distillery and strikes hard. As Kabir destroys Munna's network, Samar publicly humiliates Damru, igniting a direct war with Munna, who now vows deadly revenge.

videos.title: The Threat Reaches Home
videos.overview: Samar and Kabir's friendship deepens as they target Munna's empire, but betrayal and hidden agendas surface. A deadly bomb plot at a public event exposes Preet's treachery and Munna's reach. Though the attack is foiled, Raghav, Samar's informants, death shatters Samar, turning the battle into a personal war. Samar is threatened and challenged at the same time.

videos.title: The Circle Of Life
videos.overview: Samar hunts Munna after Raghav's murder, but a brutal clash ends with Munna's death during a final showdown. As Samar saves the wounded Gudiya, Kabir reveals he is Bunny, linking Samar to a tragic past. Their friendship shatters, turning justice into guilt, while new power alliances begin to rise as the shattered Tinnu seeks asylum with Shaheen.

videos.title: The Pain And The Promise
videos.overview: Haunted by guilt, Samar faces Kabir as past wounds resurface. While Kabir seeks redemption and a new life, betrayal strikes as Sakshi and his unborn child are lost in a brutal attack. With Shaheen and Tinnu rising, grief turns to rage, pushing Samar and Kabir into a final team-up for revenge.

videos.title: The Unholy Justice
videos.overview: Samar and Kabir unite to hunt Shaheen and Tinnu, but shocking truths emerge as Kabir is revealed to have killed Raghav. A brutal final battle wipes out enemies, yet Kabir disappears, aligning with Sangwan. In a tense face-off, past sins collide, ending the series with a sniper rifle pointed at Samar's family as their fate remains uncertain as the shot is taken.

tt39971916.name: Psycho Saiyaan
tt39971916.description: Kartik Pandey, a poetic student in Ujjain, becomes obsessed with Charu, convinced she is his destiny. When she disappears, he learns she’s trapped by ruthless gangster-politician Huntry Chauhan. Infiltrating Huntry’s haveli, Kartik enters a violent world of manipulation where love turns toxic, obsession deepens, and sanity blurs into madness.

videos.title: Siberian Seagull
videos.overview: In the ancient city of Ujjain, Kartik falls obsessively in love with the mysterious Charu, who arrives seeking mukti for her dying grandmother. But when she vanishes without warning, his devotion turns into a relentless search, where love may be far more complicated than it seems.

videos.title: German Shepherd
videos.overview: In Katni, Kartik discovers Charu trapped under the control of Huntry Chauhan, a ruthless politician hiding brutality behind charm. Posing as a caretaker for Huntry’s prized German Shepherd, Kartik steps into a world where loyalty is staged, and love demands terrifying choices.

videos.title: Persian Cat
videos.overview: Kartik decides to flee Katni with Charu before Huntry Chauhan tightens his grip. But on the night of Huntry’s grand “Mrs. Katni” spectacle, glamour turns to menace, loyalties shift, and escape becomes a deadly game of power and secrets.

videos.title: Raging Bull
videos.overview: Kartik is lured into Huntry Chauhan’s isolated farmhouse, where Charu pushes him toward an unthinkable choice. But in the wilderness, loyalties shatter, violence erupts, and Kartik finds himself trapped in a nightmare where love becomes accusation and survival comes at a devastating cost.

videos.title: Rowdy Rodent
videos.overview: Kartik is released from prison and pushed toward a “safe” new life with Ritu. But just as normalcy returns, an impossible sight reignites the mystery of Charu—and sends Kartik chasing her shadow once more.

videos.title: Wild Wolf
videos.overview: Kartik tracks Charu’s shadow to Georgia, desperate for answers. Instead, he finds a truth built on deception and reinvention. As old dangers return, love collapses into a final, ruthless reckoning.

tt39195804.name: Vishnu Vinyasam
tt39195804.description: A superstitious man confronts his deepest convictions when he discovers that the woman he has fallen for has a dark secret.

tt31598703.name: Tanvi: The Great
tt31598703.description: Tanvi Raina, a woman with autism learns of her deceased Indian Army father's dream to salute the flag at Siachen Glacier. Despite barriers facing those with autism in military service, she resolves to complete her mission.

tt39330422.name: Sumathi Sathakam
tt39330422.description: A village shopkeeper pursues the woman he loves, but faces obstacles from local beliefs and strict customs in his wild attempt to overcome community opposition and claim her heart.

tt39631179.name: Accused
tt39631179.description: When a celebrated queer doctor in London is accused of sexual misconduct, her life unravels.

tt33143854.name: Couple Friendly
tt33143854.description: Couple Friendly follows the journey of a Telugu boy and girl who both reside in Chennai. Their paths cross under unique circumstances, and the story deals with the challenges they face in their careers and relationship. Set in a city where they don't speak their mother tongue, the film explores the emotional highs and lows of navigating life and love in an unfamiliar environment.

tt36017918.name: Bhartha Mahasayulaku Wignyapthi
tt36017918.description: What begins as a casual fling between a married man, Ram a.k.a Satya and Manasa in the middle of an international business trip, balloons into an out-of-the-blue mess when the latter lands in Hyderabad, disrupting Ram’s otherwise stable marriage with Balamani.

tt15464188.name: Ikkis
tt15464188.description: Set against the backdrop of the 1971 war, follows the life of second Lieutenant Arun Khetrapal.

tt33083471.name: Funky
tt33083471.description: A debut director who falls in love with his producer's daughter

tt32278140.name: Lockdown
tt32278140.description: During a national emergency, Anita finds herself isolated at home while facing personal challenges. As she adapts to the new reality, an unexpected situation tests her resilience and changes her perspective on life.

tt34446638.name: Om Shanti Shanti Shantihi
tt34446638.description: Prashanthi gives up her dreams for love, only to fall into abusive relationships first with her lecturer and later with her husband, Omkar, who pretends to support her but turns violent and manipulative. After enduring trauma, betrayal, and a heartbreaking miscarriage, she secretly strengthens herself, escapes his control, and rebuilds her life by starting a successful business. When Omkar's abuse becomes public and reaches court, she refuses divorce, not out of love, but to ensure no other woman suffers the same fate
