tt1281973.name: Bigg Boss
tt1281973.description: Your ‘Host and Dost’ Salman Khan is back! Brace for another high-octane season of the greatest reality show, serving entertainment and drama—all unfiltered!

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Five challengers returned, as veterans for the title, from previous seasons. While two housemates were chosen from Season 2 and one from Season 5, 6 and 7 each. No inclusions were made from Season 1, 3 and 4.

videos.title: Bigg Boss 9 Grand Finale
videos.overview: Salman Khan calls the contestants onto the stage for the grand finale. After a comedy session with Krishna and Bharti, Prince was declared as the winner of season 9.

videos.title: Season Premiere: Bigg Boss S11
videos.overview: Salman Khan kicks off the excitement with the cast of Judwaa 2, as Bigg Boss returns for its eleventh season. With 14 housemates more diverse than ever, this season raises the bar to epic proportions by introducing 4 Padosis, who will have total power over the housemates. Wait. there is more. Salman himself will be one of the Padosis. He will watch over their every move. So get ready for this journey of high-octane drama, surprises and fierce rivalry.

videos.title: Bigg Outbursts Gives Fiery Start
videos.overview: Day 1: Puneesh and Zubair are already at each other's throats and a small altercation almost gets physical between them. The Padosis are tasked with an outrageous challenge by Bigg Boss. How will the housemates react to such a fiery start to the season?

videos.title: The Nomination Begins!
videos.overview: Day 2: The members are given the opportunity to nominate two housemates for elimination. Some go for the obvious, based on previous spats and some try to eliminate a strong contender. Bigg Boss empowers the Padosis to make the final judgement allowing them to save one nominated person. Whose fortunes will be turned by the Padosis?

videos.title: The Drama King Of Bigg Boss
videos.overview: Day 3: Who's the drama king of Bigg Boss? Zubair Khan has made the cut for the title as he's leaving no stone unturned to get into fights with everybody in the house. What has he told Bandgi and Arshi now?

videos.title: Did Zubair Call Arshi A 2 Rupees Aurat?
videos.overview: Day 4: The tension inside the house reaches its peak when Shilpa and Arshi find themselves on the receiving end of some severe criticism. The duos' reluctance to cooperate with anyone initiates a very ugly spat, with Zubair coming down hard on Arshi. With all the melodrama being monitored by the padosis, will the four neighbours take advantage of this growing unrest?

videos.title: Who Will Be Put Behind Bars?
videos.overview: Day 5: With old rivalries reigniting and new ones erupting with every passing day, the housemates get ready to face the horror of the Kaal Kothri. Tempers flare as the Bigg Boss asks the housemates to nominate three people whom they wish to send to the Kaal Kothri. Who will be the first inmates of the Bigg Boss prison?

videos.title: Salman Kicks Priyank Out!
videos.overview: The first week, riddled with ugly spats and much foul-mouthed language has got on Salman's nerves. Zubair Khan is the first victim of Salman's fury. But what makes him throw Priyank Sharma out of the house? How will the other housemates react to this drastic step? Get ready to see Salman at his best and worst, when he is really angry.

videos.title: Bigg Fun With Golmaal Again!
videos.overview: Priyank Sharma's shocking eviction has the house divided, some are feeling guilty and a few celebrate Salman's decision. One more housemate is headed for a similar fate, as the angry host's justice is swift and decisive. Who will it be? But before the departures, watch the cast of Golmaal Again as they join Salman onstage to spread some cheer on Bigg Boss.

videos.title: The Padosis Make Their Entry
videos.overview: Day 7: The much anticipated moment is here. With their fake identities in place, the Padosis finally get the Bigg order to join the housemates. But with the unending conflicts and chaos in the house, they are surely going to have a tough time keeping their fake back story intact. Join the Padosis as they gear up for this wild ride.

videos.title: Choose Your Queen!
videos.overview: Day 8: What happens when two drama queens get to be real queens? Look no further than the new luxury budget task where Shilpa Shinde and Arshi Khan get to play the good and the evil queen respectively. But the king, Hiten Tejwani is put to the task of recognising the good queen out of the two. With newfound powers in place and the season's first captaincy on the line, watch out because things are starting to heat up.

videos.title: Padosis Almost Exposed!
videos.overview: Day 10: The new luxury budget advances to an exciting conclusion because King Hiten Tejwani believes he has recognised the good queen. Will he be able to turn his monarchy into a captaincy? But it seems Vikas Gupta is the real winner because he has cracked open the Padosis' fake backstory. Will he use this knowledge to his advantage?

videos.title: No Longer Besties?
videos.overview: Day 11: In this game of ever changing friendships, it's Shilpa Shinde and Arshi Khan's turn. With Shilpa Shinde dissing her in front of the whole house, Arshi Khan would not take it lightly. Watch the two divas battle it out, while their friendship crumbles.

videos.title: Sapna Sprays Insecticide On Arshi!
videos.overview: Day 12: The drama in the Bigg Boss house reaches next level when Sapna Choudhary sprays insecticide on Arshi Khan in the kaal kothri. Not one to take it sitting down, Arshi Khan too fires her shots. What does she do?

videos.title: Hina Faces The Heat
videos.overview: After a roller coaster of a second week, it is time for the witness box and some confessions. From Vikas Gupta's captaincy to Arshi Khan's foul language being put into question, the housemates have a lot of explaining to do. But no one has a worse time in the witness box than Hina Khan. Watch as she wades through a barrage of accusations and of course, Salman Khan's eagle eye scrutiny.

videos.title: Diwali Dhamaka With Bigg Boss
videos.overview: After two weeks of emotional fireworks, it is time for a grand Diwali sale in the house. What happens when the housemates play the roles of both the shopkeepers and the shopping items? Well, the guests, Rithvik Dhanjani and Ravi Dubey are here to put this hilarious sale into action. With another elimination around the corner, some fun seems like a good idea.

videos.title: Lucinda Pays A Heavy Price
videos.overview: Day 15: The Padosis pay a heavy price for not being able to perform their secret task. As a punishment, Lucinda Nicholas is evicted in a most shocking manner. The whole house is shaken. How do the others react?

videos.title: Vikas Faces A Bigg Punishment
videos.overview: Captain Vikas Gupta is about to pay the price for resorting to violence during the luxury budget task. Bigg Boss takes a swift decision to punish the captain. Team Vikas and Team Puneesh indulge in a chaotic display of frustration and fury in one hell of a task. Get ready for a double dose of chaos.

videos.title: Vikas Hatches A New Game Plan
videos.overview: The eve of Diwali turns special as some subtle fireworks light up inside the house. The mastermind behind all this is none other than Vikas Gupta. From inciting Luv Tyagi to turning Bandgi Kalra against Puneesh Sharma, the fallen captain plays the biggest game of all.

videos.title: Arshi Does The Unthinkable!
videos.overview: Day 17: The ugly spat between Arshi Khan and Hina Khan reaches the ultimate level with Arshi Khan doing the unthinkable. This incident created the biggest controversy ever in the history of Bigg Boss. Curious to know what happened?

videos.title: Maintain An Arms Distance, Roars Hina
videos.overview: The captaincy war is on and someone has just got on Hina Khan's nerves. Who do you think has crossed her this time?

videos.title: Hina And Arshi In Sultani Akhada!
videos.overview: The conflict between Arshi Khan and Hina Khan is at an all-time high. Salman Khan gives them a chance to bury the hatchet at the Sultani Akhada, but is forced to call it off when things get out of hand.

videos.title: Dhinchak Pooja's Bigg Entry
videos.overview: The Bigg Boss weekend just got bigger. Following an exciting visit by stars of the Colors family, the season's first Wild Card entry is announced and she is none other than internet singing sensation, Dhinchak Pooja. She joins the house but not before Salman Khan takes some hilarious jabs at her music. Watch out because the house is about to get a lot louder.

videos.title: Akash Nominated For Spitting?
videos.overview: Day 21: Get ready for the most bizarre nomination process ever. Bigg Boss directly nominates six housemates who can become safe at the expense of others. Hina Khan gets her sweet revenge by nominating Akash Dadlani for spitting on food. Did he really or is that a lame excuse?

videos.title: Survival Of The Fiercest
videos.overview: Day 22: Put into a primitive natural setting in the Khulja Sim Sim task, the housemates bare their own untamed wild side. From literal mudslinging to throwing cow dung, no one is as ferocious and unmerciful as Hina Khan.

videos.title: Dhinchak Pooja, The Pawn?
videos.overview: Day 24: As the Red team and Blue team fight it out in the luxury budget task, Dhinchak Pooja feels the pressure of politics from both sides. Being the newest housemate, taking a decision is never easy but with the task nearing its conclusion, she needs to take one. Will she stand up for herself or will she fall victim to the manipulative housemates?

videos.title: Hina In Sapna Ki Adaalat
videos.overview: Day 25: Bigg Boss puts Sapna Choudhary's impartial and outspoken nature to the test with a new task called Sapna Ki Adaalat. In the task, she is given the power to decide if Hina Khan deserves another term of captaincy. Watch the judge's eagle eye scrutinise the captain while accusations are slapped, in this one of a kind courtroom drama.

videos.title: Priyank: Kebab Mein Haddi?
videos.overview: Day 26: Dhinchak Pooja's music video is not the only thing setting fire in the house because Priyank Sharma is back and he is already making his mark. He starts off by jeopardising Puneesh and Bandgi's relationship with a shocking titbit. Priyank surely is back with a mission. So gear up for another wild ride.

videos.title: Golmaal Is Back Again!
videos.overview: The cast of Golmaal Again joins Salman Khan to celebrate the epic run of their movie. With the fourth installment of the Golmaal franchise turning into a blockbuster flick, it's time for Salman Khan to find the blockbuster contestant of the Bigg Boss house.

videos.title: Manu And Lopa Back At Bigg Boss!
videos.overview: Salman Khan has a couple of very special guests for the contestants to meet. Catch Manu Punjabi and Lopamudra Raut as they meet and greet the contestants at the house while giving them valuable insight and tips from their time in the Bigg Boss house.

videos.title: Priyank, The Serial Rule Breaker
videos.overview: Get ready for a heavy dose of diplomacy, disagreements and reconciliation as the housemates try to survive the emotionally draining nomination process. But it's not going to be a smooth ride because Priyank Sharma's constant tattletaling is getting on everyone's nerves. Despite stern warnings, it seems he can't keep his mouth shut. Catch up on the saga of Priyank, the rule breaker.

videos.title: Cushions And Captaincy For Sale
videos.overview: Day 30: The new luxury budget task has taken the house by a storm. Vikas Gupta and Shilpa Shinde are pitted against each other as rival business persons. Vikas Gupta has a secret advantage and he is only too keen to use it to the fullest, given his rival is none other than Shilpa Shinde.

videos.title: Vikas Bounces Back In The Game
videos.overview: Day 31: The Bigg Boss Cushion Factory task is poised for an exciting conclusion. With Shilpa Shinde's team hit by internal conflicts, Vikas Gupta can almost taste victory. With his eyes set on the captaincy, Vikas bounces back in the game with some new alliances. But will he have the last laugh in this game of negotiations?

videos.title: Emotional Vikas Decides To Quit
videos.overview: Vikas Gupta is the worst performer? The housemates think so despite his big victory in the luxury budget task and he faces the Kaal Kothri again. Shilpa Shinde is surely savouring the last laugh but she is not done yet. Watch as her relentless hazing and insults result in Vikas' emotional breakdown and he decides to quit.

videos.title: Vikas's Bigg Escape!
videos.overview: Vikas Gupta has lost it this time and is not being able to handle Shilpa Shinde's behaviour anymore. He tries to escape from the Bigg Boss house. What happens next?

videos.title: Salman Decodes The Shilpa-Vikas Saga
videos.overview: The Vikas Gupta and Shilpa Shinde conflict is the talk of the town. Even the housemates are afraid to choose sides on this one. But Salman Khan is here to decode this fiery situation and lay bare the truths and lies. Gear up for some awkwardness as well because Salman suspects some romantic tension behind this conflict.

videos.title: Confession Time At Bigg Boss!
videos.overview: Salman Khan is joined by some guests who listen to the contestants as they confess their biggest and most shocking secrets. They have to choose the contestant with the most sensational secret, who will receive special powers in the coming week's nominations.

videos.title: Priyank And Arshi's Nasty Fight
videos.overview: Day 36: If you wanted a fiery start to the week, this is it. From Arshi Khan's emotional breakdown after being incited by Priyank Sharma to Akash Dadlani getting on Benafsha Soonawalla's last nerve, the housemates are off to another chaotic start to a new week. Bandgi Kalra and Puneesh Sharma's hair-raising intimacy is on a show as well. With the crucial nominations ahead, it seems things are about to get much more personal this time.

videos.title: Big Accusation, Bigger Chaos
videos.overview: Day 37: Following the accusation that Akash Dadlani made dirty comments about the ladies in the house, there is a new spark in the Bigg Boss story. Brace yourself because this fire is showing no sign of decline. With Bandgi Kalra and Puneesh Sharma's relationship already igniting controversy, a new fire of accusations and lies is spreading. But this time, no housemate will be spared.

videos.title: Bigg Boss Prize Money Is Now Zero!
videos.overview: Day 38: The new luxury budget task titled Mission BB11 has the housemates play astronauts and spend time in a model rocket. But here is the kicker. If someone aborts the task, they get a chance to be the next captain but at the cost of a reduced prize money. But all thanks to the cheating housemates, Bigg Boss reduces the prize money to zero.

videos.title: The Blame Game Begins
videos.overview: Day 39: The luxury budget task was one big debacle. With the prize money reduced to zero, the housemates are feeling the pressure. The blame game has started as it is time for the worst performers to face the Kaal Kothri. Things escalate when Hina Khan blames Vikas Gupta for the blunder.

videos.title: Friend Turned Foe?
videos.overview: Day 40: Priyank Sharma and Vikas Gupta used to be thick as thieves. But, Vikas Gupta has done something which has left Priyank Sharma questioning his character. With Sabyasachi Satpathy becoming the new captain, cracks have started to appear in other friendships as well. What has driven Priyank Sharma to the edge of his patience?

videos.title: Bigg Laughs With Kapil Sharma
videos.overview: The comedy king and star of the upcoming film Firangi, Kapil Sharma is here to cheer everyone up. The housemates do need some cheering up after their gruelling session with Salman Khan. Gear up for some revelations, some laughter, Kapil's hilarious twist to the English language and lots of drama.

videos.title: Bindass Bol With Sulu
videos.overview: Salman Khan is joined by Vidya Balan, who promotes her latest film, Tumhari Sulu. She hosts a radio show with Vikas Gupta and Shilpa Shinde, who ask the housemates questions about their stay in the house so far and their relationship with others. Catch the housemates as they tackle sensational questions from Vidya Balan and her co-hosts.

videos.title: Priyank Sharma Goes Bald On National TV!
videos.overview: The nomination process for the week starts with an unexpected test of friendship. Some housemates have to make a sacrifice to save their nominated friends. Priyank goes bald on National TV. Who does he go bald for?

videos.title: Bigg Boss Nominates Hina Khan
videos.overview: Day 44: Despite Luv's bigg sacrifice, Hina Khan is nominated for this week's elimination. Vikas Gupta tops it off by not just destroying his favourite jacket to save Shilpa Shinde, but also offering her an apology and a chance to be a part of his professional career. Are they really ready to bury the hatchet?

videos.title: Love In The Bigg Boss House?
videos.overview: News about Priyank Sharma and Benafsha Soonawalla spending the night in the same bed has spread like wildfire. The whole house is now gossipping about it. Did they really get intimate? Have they found love in the Bigg Boss house? How will they react to this gossip?

videos.title: Vikas's Bigg Dhoka To Hiten!
videos.overview: Day 46: Vikas Gupta's closest ally, Hiten Tejwani is one of the powerful contenders for the captaincy. Now Vikas Gupta is regretting the promise he made to Puneesh Sharma regarding Bandgi Kalra's safety in the captaincy process. Did he just betray Hiten and kick him out of the captaincy race to save Bandgi Kalra?

videos.title: A Hot Pool Party!
videos.overview: Day 47: There's a hot pool party in the house. Temperature rises as the hot bikini babes take a dip in the pool. Puneesh Sharma can hardly take his eyes off Bandgi Kalra. But look out for Arshi Khan getting wet in a hot pink saree.

videos.title: Sizzling Saturday With Sunny Leone
videos.overview: Sunny Leone and Arbaaz Khan, stars of the upcoming film Tera Intezaar are here to spice up the weekend. Sunny brings with her a sizzling task for the unsuspecting housemates and you cannot miss this one. Akash Dadlani facing the music from Salman Khan is just the prefect bonus to this exciting weekend.

videos.title: Will Sultan Choose Maharani Padmavati?
videos.overview: Salman Khan and the housemates are visited by Queen Padmavati, Deepika Padukone from the upcoming film, Padmavati. She is on a mission to find the Padmavati, Ratan Singh and Alauddin Khilji of the house. That's not all. She wants to know who Salman would kill, marry and date- Katrina, Deepika or Jacqueline?

videos.title: When Titans Clash!
videos.overview: Day 50: It is common knowledge that Vikas Gupta and Hina Khan cannot stand each other. In the latest nomination process it is Team Vikas Gupta vs Team Hina Khan with both the masterminds trying to save their respective favourites. What follows is mind games and politics at its best. Who wins this game of minds?

videos.title: Arshi Is A Flirt! Alleges Priyank
videos.overview: Day 51: The Arshi Khan and Priyank Sharma rift just widened in BB Ki Adalat, as Arshi Khan is targeted for her flirty ways and accused of dore daalna and kapde phaadna. But Arshi is not someone to stay quiet.

videos.title: Arshi Rains Fury On Hina
videos.overview: Day 52: The Bigg Boss court is back in session in all its chaotic glory. Only this time, Hina Khan is under fire. Burdened by a mountain of accusations, Arshi Khan strikes back at Hina and accuses her of not standing up for the women in the house.

videos.title: Priyank Defaces Arshi's Poster
videos.overview: Day 53: With the wounds from the luxury budget task still fresh, the captaincy task is already announced. Among the five contenders is Arshi Khan. This time Priyank Sharma doesn't let anything come between him and his revenge. Watch a raging Priyank Sharma savoring every moment while he defaces Arshi Khan's poster, bit by bit. Curious to know his reason?

videos.title: Akash Explodes After Losing!
videos.overview: Day 54: Akash Dadlani goes through a complete meltdown after losing to Hiten Tejwani in the captaincy race. To make matters worse, he blames this loss on none other than his closest ally, Puneesh Sharma. Now with one of the strongest friendships of the season in disarray, what turn will the house take?

videos.title: Salman Khan Walks Off!
videos.overview: Sultani Akhada, where rivals get to vent out their anger and frustration, turns host to a shocking event. Akash Dadlani's insufferable attitude forces Salman Khan to leave the arena after the rapper simply refuses to compete against his newest enemy, Puneesh Sharma.

videos.title: Blockbuster Sunday With Race 3 Cast
videos.overview: Day 56: Blockbuster Sunday begins as Salman Khan welcomes the dazzling cast of the upcoming movie Race 3 and shakes a leg with Jacqueline and Daisy to a chartbuster 90s track.

videos.title: Pushed Over The Edge!
videos.overview: Day 57: The ongoing feud between the friends turned foes crosses all limits when Puneesh Sharma loses his temper and flings away Akash Dadlani's food. With eggs, slippers, and abuses being flung around, will Bigg Boss house witness the ugliest brawl of the season?

videos.title: The Red Chilli Attack!
videos.overview: Day 58: From putting chilli powder in eyes to waxing body hair, Hina Khan and friends go to extreme level of torture in the luxury budget task. Things go out of hand when Vikas Gupta decides to step in to help Bandgi Kalra. Is Hina Khan spear heading this attack only to win the luxury budget or is she using the task as an excuse of taking out her personal vendetta?

videos.title: Akash Faces Extreme Torture!
videos.overview: Day 59: In a frenzy to take revenge, did Team Shilpa just cross all boundaries? Watch as Akash Dadlani falls victim to Team Shilpa's vicious attacks and is left with a swollen face.

videos.title: Swami Om Hai Tu!
videos.overview: Day 60: The Bigg saga of rivalry and revenge continues as the housemates unanimously banish lovebirds Puneesh Sharma and Bandgi Kalra to the Kaal Kothri. Akash Dadlani adds fuel to the fire by unleashing Puneesh Sharma's wrath, comparing him to Swami Om.

videos.title: The Captaincy Battle: Priyank V/S Vikas
videos.overview: Contenders Priyank Sharma and Vikas Gupta turn DJs for the next captaincy task and the housemates have to literally dance to their tunes to make them win. Who will support whom?

videos.title: Tigress Meets The Tiger
videos.overview: Day 62: Usually, Salman Khan is the one putting the housemates on the hot seat every weekend. But this time, Salman is the one on the hot seat as he faces none other than his Tiger Zinda Hai co-star Katrina Kaif, in a hilarious lie detection test.

videos.title: Boys Turn Belly Dancers For Kat!
videos.overview: Day 63: Want to impress Katrina Kaif? The boys of the Bigg Boss house turn belly dancers to impress the diva. The fun doesn't end here. What Salman Khan made the guys do is beyond imagination.

videos.title: A Royal Role Play
videos.overview: Day 64: Doesn't matter who the reigning performer is, it is time for the ladies of the house to rule. In an outrageous role playing task, the ladies are now queens and the men become their subjects. From cooking, cleaning, massaging and cross dressing, the queens surely are making their commands heard.

videos.title: Not A Baby's Day Out This!
videos.overview: Day 65: Becoming a captain is not a child's play. The housemates have to take care of their respective babies in the captaincy task. With Akash Dadlani deciding to back down and the growing tension between some of the other contestants, the fun task quickly takes an interesting turn from the average baby's day out.

videos.title: Did Hiten Betray Hina?
videos.overview: Day 66: Hina Khan feels that Hiten Tejwani deliberately did not keep his promise of making her captain of the house. With the fight to become the next captain getting fierce, she accuses him of dancing to Vikas Gupta's tune. How will Mr. Cool of the house respond to this accusation?

videos.title: End Of The Priyank - Divya Story?
videos.overview: Day 67: The housemates are in for the sweetest luxury budget task of all, where they get to personally meet their loved ones. But for Priyank Sharma this sweet task turns sour when his ex-girlfriend, Divya Agarwal makes a surprise visit.

videos.title: Hina And Rocky's Romantic Reunion
videos.overview: Day 68: The emotional reunions continue in the luxury budget task. Hina Khan goes on a crying spree when her boyfriend, Rocky Jaiswal makes a visit.

videos.title: Salman Slams Arshi's Behaviour
videos.overview: Day 69: Captain Arshi Khan's foul behaviour hasn't gone unnoticed. But when Salman Khan comes to the defence of Arshi Khan's biggest victim, Shilpa Shinde, Arshi Khan fires back at him, accusing him of being too partial towards Shilpa Shinde.

videos.title: Fun With Fukrey Returns Cast
videos.overview: Day 70: Join Salman Khan on this blockbuster Sunday as he invites the talented cast of Fukrey Returns to the house. But the real fun begins when the guests fire quirky questions at the unsuspecting housemates.

videos.title: Captain Arshi, The Decider
videos.overview: Day 71: Captain Arshi Khan is at the helm of the new nomination process. With the housemates divided into two teams, the entire task comes down to the captain's decision. But this time the housemates will either survive or get nominated not as individuals, but as teams.

videos.title: Vikas Viciously Attacks Priyank
videos.overview: Day 72: The new luxury budget task is all about hiding your emotions. With one group acting as robots, the other group has to make them cry, laugh or angry. But in a house where emotional outbursts are everyday highlights, how will the robots fare? What does Vikas Gupta say to robot Priyank Sharma that makes him cry? Is this merely a task or a way to express personal vendetta?

videos.title: Priyank Strikes Back At Vikas!
videos.overview: Day 73: The tables have turned and it is Vikas Gupta now at the receiving end. Watch Priyank Sharma go head on hurling insults at Vikas Gupta without mincing a word.

videos.title: Secrets Are Exposed!
videos.overview: Day 74: Arshi Khan chooses Hina Khan and Vikas Gupta as the two other housemates who get to see the secret clips of the others talking about them. What Hina Khan sees shocks and hurts her.

videos.title: Negotiations Reach A Stalemate
videos.overview: Day 75: The nomination for the next captaincy candidates reaches a stalemate after the winners of the BB Lab task fail to reach an agreement over the candidacy. With all eyes set on the captain's powers and no one willing to compromise, will the house witness another fierce clash?

videos.title: Mouni Roy Sizzles With Salman
videos.overview: Day 76: The weekend is off to a sizzling start with Mouni Roy joining Salman Khan to rock the stage. Don't miss this entertaining episode as Salman faces a barrage of questions from his guest.

videos.title: Did Hiten Tejwani Get Evicted?
videos.overview: Day 77: For the first time in Bigg Boss history, the power of elimination is with the housemates. The result? Hiten Tejwani gets eliminated. Watch the drama unfold as we witness the most shocking elimination ever.

videos.title: Housemates's Blunder, Hina's Gain
videos.overview: Day 78: Could there be a more explosive start to the week? The housemates are in deep water with Bigg Boss for openly discussing the nominations. Even using secret codes did not help them. A furious Bigg Boss nominates everyone except Hina Khan. The reaction of the housemates? Epic.

videos.title: Arshi Lashes Out At Priyank
videos.overview: Day 79: The emergence of new alliances turn the tables in the captaincy task. Chaos takes over when Arshi Khan is thrown out of the captaincy race following a shrewd move by her rivals. Watch as she spews fiery accusations of betrayal at Luv Tyagi and Priyank Sharma.

videos.title: Sweet Revenge For Hina And Shilpa
videos.overview: Day 80: The race for the captaincy reaches an exciting peak when Akash Dadlani adds a new twist by throwing Vikas Gupta out of the race. This is a much awaited sweet revenge for none other than Hina Khan and Shilpa Shinde.

videos.title: You Have Lost A Friend, Says Priyank
videos.overview: Hina Khan's continuous mockery of Vikas Gupta's dressing sense and the argument that followed has left Priyank Sharma fuming. While Hina Khan denies being at fault, Priyank Sharma sides with Vikas Gupta and accuses her of crossing the line. Is this the end of Hina-Priyank-Luv friendship?

videos.title: Captaincy With A Luvly Twist
videos.overview: Day 83: In what can only be described as an abrupt finish, Arshi Khan's remarkable Bigg Boss journey comes to an end. But her friends, Priyank Sharma and Vikas Gupta's fate now rest on the public who have the power to propel one of them into the semi finals through live voting.

videos.title: Arshi's Bigg Journey Ends!
videos.overview: Day 83: In what can only be described as an abrupt finish, Arshi Khan's remarkable Bigg Boss journey comes to an end. But her friends, Priyank Sharma and Vikas Gupta's fate now rest on the public who have the power to propel one of them into the semi finals through live voting.

videos.title: Christmas Masti With Mika Singh
videos.overview: Day 84: There is nothing like a good Christmas spirit and the presence of Bollywood singing sensation Mika Singh, to bring together the housemates and spread some holiday cheer.

videos.title: Did Priyank Cross The Line?
videos.overview: Day 85: Did Priyank Sharma cross the line? An angry Luv Tyagi feels he did during the new nomination task. With the challenge of being trapped inside a dome and trying to spend precisely 42 minutes in there while enduring the constant distractions, this is one task not to be missed.

videos.title: Emotional Floodgates Open
videos.overview: Day 86: The housemates are left reeling with emotions when their loved ones take the role of the new Padosis. But this happy visit comes with a twist in the form of multiple competitions judged by none other than these new Padosis.

videos.title: Akash's Mother In Tears
videos.overview: Day 87: The contest for impressing the new Padosis heats up. As part of a deal, Akash Dadlani agrees to help the other housemates in the new task. But when his housemates refuse to keep up their end of the bargain, Akash's mother is left in tears.

videos.title: When Priyank Met His Mother
videos.overview: Day 88: The housemates are given the chance to bid farewell to the Padosis. This starts the emotional outpourings as the contestants get to actually see their loved ones. When Priyank Sharma's mother comes inside the house, both mother and son break down seeing each other.

videos.title: Vikas's Mission Impossible!
videos.overview: Day 89: Vikas Gupta is given a chance to win a New Year party for the housemates. But he has to complete some tasks given to him by Bigg Boss without letting the housemates know. With the housemates mocking him and misunderstanding his intentions, will the mastermind find a way to get the job done?

videos.title: Luv's Luck Strikes Again!
videos.overview: Day 90: It seems luck is sticking to Luv Tyagi like a shadow. In yet another surprising turn of events, Luv Tyagi survives the elimination, thus marking the end of Priyank Sharma's remarkable Bigg Boss journey.

videos.title: Balraj Syal's Bigg New Year Roast!
videos.overview: Day 91: It is time to welcome the new year and Bigg Boss has planned quite an exciting night. From Balraj Syal roasting the housemates to Salman Khan offering hilariously apt awards to them, the new year celebration is off to an epic start.

videos.title: Semi Finale Week Starts With A Shock!
videos.overview: Day 92: The first week of the new year starts with a shock. The unsuspecting housemates find themselves in a mire when Bigg Boss disguises this week's nomination process as a performance ranking contest. Which housemate strikes gold by surviving the nomination at the start of this crucial Semi Finale week?

videos.title: For A Ticket To The Finale!
videos.overview: Day 93: With every housemate eyeing a spot in the finals, a direct entry to the finale is up for grabs. The task titled Mount BB, assigns the housemates the burden of climbing up a mountain, but with their fates in each others hands. Watch as trust and friendships are thrown out of the window in this epic contest.

videos.title: Commoners V/S Celebrities
videos.overview: Day 94: The fight for the ticket to finale has become a commoner vs celebrity deal. This battle for survival between these two conflicting sides has created the fiery rivalry between Hina Khan and Luv Tyagi.

videos.title: Luv V/S Puneesh For Ticket To Finale!
videos.overview: Day 95: It has come down to two contestants as contenders for the ticket to Finale. Puneesh Sharma and Luv Tyagi go head on in the BB Museum task. Who do you think will get a spot in the finale

videos.title: When Housemates Met The Fans!
videos.overview: Day 96: The nominated Bigg Bogg housemates are taken to a mall, where the fans vote live. What ensued after the housemates reach the mall is nothing short of a mass frenzy. The people went crazy after meeting their favourite Bigg Boss contestants.

videos.title: Rani Mukherjee Schools Salman
videos.overview: Day 97: Salman Khan is joined by Rani Mukherjee who meets the housemates and promotes her upcoming film, Hichki. She turns the Bigg Boss set into a classroom and asks Salman Khan a very interesting question. It's not about his marriage. Curious to know what Rani asked?

videos.title: Salman Meets Chulbul Pandey!
videos.overview: Day 98: With the last Weekend Ka Vaar of the season underway, stars of the upcoming movie Aiyaary pay a visit to make it even more special. But what happens when Dabangg Salman Khan meets another Chulbul Pandey?

videos.title: Shilpa Grilled Before The Press
videos.overview: Day 99: The housemates face possibly the biggest challenge of all as they fall prey to severe and relentless questions of the press. But it is Shilpa Shinde who feels most of the attack. Witness her emotional breakdown as the housemates and journalists gang up against her with a bundle of accusations.

videos.title: Arshi, The Queen Of Mean
videos.overview: Day 100: Arshi Khan makes a surprise visit to spice up the finale week. She is here on a mission to judge the meanest housemate of all. Get ready because the finalists are all fired up to give each other hell, all to impress Arshi, the Queen of Mean.

videos.title: A Surprise Midnight Eviction
videos.overview: Day 101: With the final nomination process under way, Bigg Boss picks the four finalists of the season. This means bad news for one housemate and it turns out to be Akash Dadlani whose journey unfortunately comes to an end.

videos.title: The Reign Of The Mastermind
videos.overview: Day 102: The Bigg Boss house turns into Vikas city and everyone has to fulfil dictator Vikas' demands. What happens when Puneesh Sharma and Hina Khan disobey the dictator?

videos.title: Did Vikas Cross The Line?
videos.overview: Day 103: The Vikas city task ends on a sour note when Vikas Gupta orders Hina Khan to do the unthinkable - destroy his mother's photograph. This leaves Hina Khan in tears and even Puneesh Sharma thinks that Vikas Gupta has crossed the line this time.

videos.title: Emotional Recap Of The Bigg Journey
videos.overview: Day 104: As the contest nears its conclusion, the finalists get a beautiful reminder of the spectacular journey that they had this season. Watch them turn into emotional wrecks as Bigg Boss offers them a visual recap of their roller coaster journey.

videos.title: Bigg Boss 11 - Grand Finale
videos.overview: After surviving more than a 105 long and dramatic days in the Bigg Boss House, its time now for one of your favourite finalists to be declared the winner of BB11. Who is it?

videos.title: Season Premiere
videos.overview: Salman Khan kick starts the season 12 with introduction of 18 housemates.

videos.title: Hotness Alert: Malkin in the house!
videos.overview: Day 01: The housemates are in for a pleasant surprise when the Ghar ki Malkin, Ameesha Patel welcomes them with scintillating performance and a fun warm-up task! While the housemates are still hungover by their entry into the house, Asim Riaz and Paras Chhabra seem to have already found a reason for the first argument of the season. What went wrong? Look out for the highly-anticipated, first episode of Bigg Boss,

videos.title: Time to break some hearts!
videos.overview: Day 02: Little did the beauties of the house know that they were in for heartbreak when Bigg Boss asked them to reveal their preferred 'connection' in the house. As a show of admiration and affection quickly turns into their worst nightmare and, one revelation escalates into multiple altercations, accusations and tears. Watch all the drama.

videos.title: Terror for Sidharth Shukla and Arti Singh
videos.overview: Day 03: Terror strikes the housemates as the first task of the season, BB Hospital gets underway! And nothing is off-limits, from cringe-inducing use of Gobar and garbage to a harrowing personal attack that leaves Arti Singh in tears and broken. Catch all the emotional Atyachar on Sidharth Shukla and Arti in this entertainment-packed episode.

videos.title: Kaun banegi Queen?
videos.overview: Day 05: Devoleena Bhattacharjee and team might have managed to pull off an easy victory, but the real trouble is yet to come! Tasked with naming the first-ever Queen of the house, the team runs into a roadblock as they are unable to come to an agreement, all thanks to one person. Kaun banegi Queen? Watch the exciting episode.

videos.title: Kaun banegi Queen?
videos.overview: Easy win? Not so fast! A Queen selection causes chaos. Will Devoleena's team succeed?

videos.title: In the spotlight: Paras!
videos.overview: Love triangle explodes! Shehnaz calls out Mahira. JioHotstar.

videos.title: Salman's 'eye-opening' Vaar!
videos.overview: Salman Khan intervenes as Shefali and Mahira cause drama. His perspective shifts the dynamic.

videos.title: Hina layi anokha BB Bazaar!
videos.overview: Hina Khan's task creates dilemmas for Bigg Boss contestants on JioHotstar.

videos.title: Nominations ne jagaya Sherni ko!
videos.overview: Nomination task ignites drama as Siddhartha's comment about Dalljiet's son triggers her fierce reaction.

videos.title: 'Roti' riots take over the house!
videos.overview: Big fight! Rashami defends Devoleena, angering Sidharth. He questions her position. Will she fight back?

videos.title: Arti vs Koena: The Bigg Fight!
videos.overview: Nomination triggers Arti and Koena's clash. "Begging" accusations escalate tensions. Arti's game begins?

videos.title: Sanskaari Playboy vs the BB House!
videos.overview: Four black rings! Paras faces Sidharth & Asim's wrath, Shehnaz drifts. Can he survive elimination?

videos.title: BB House goes fishing!
videos.overview: Bahus use fish to nominate men. Rashami's actions toward Sidharth fuel reconciliation hopes.

videos.title: Sunil and Haarsh steal the show!
videos.overview: Hilarious magic & Sultani Dangal! Sunil & Haarsh steal the show with Salman in stitches.

videos.title: Nawazuddin lights up Bigg Boss!
videos.overview: Motichoor Chaknachoor promo! Elimination looms for Rashami & Koena. Salman's dance surprise!

videos.title: Rashami- 'Tere Abba ki naukar nahin main'!
videos.overview: BB Toy Factory task creates chaos. Devoleena dictates Paras's relationships amid Rashami and Asim's roti row.

videos.title: Qaidi No 1: Sidharth Shukla!
videos.overview: Nomination chaos in BB house! Jail's opening leads to fights, Rashami, Shehnaz, & Sidharth face consequences. He protests.

videos.title: Bahu bani Bhayanak!

With his favourite, expensive yellow shoes at stake, what will Paras do?

videos.title: Madhurima ke nakhre, captain hui behaal!

Further, when a rebellious Madhurima Tuli flatly refuses from complying with the captain's rules and not performing her share of kitchen duties, a furious Shehnaz gives her three punishments, one involving her make-up. Watch this episode to see if this volatile altercation between the two ladies leads to a heated catfight.

videos.title: Rohit Shetty tames the alphas!

videos.title: Naye saal ki shaandar shuruaat!

Also, don't miss out on Rashami Desai's emotional outburst as Arhaan Khan gets a special New Year surprise by Bigg Boss in this joyous episode.

videos.title: Mahira-Shehnaz ki dosti ka the end?

However, Mahira is left upset when Shehnaz Kaur does not stand up for her and expresses her displeasure about the same. But with a special power to affect the nominations given to Shehnaz by Bigg Boss, how will their tiff affect Shehnaz's final decision? Don't miss out on this and much more in this fun episode.

videos.title: Madhurima makes the rules!

However, trouble brews when Siddharth Shukla accuses her of making her own rules in the task, resulting in a frenzy of discord between the two teams. Will Madhurima be able to handle the pressures of running a task? Catch the drama unfold in today's episode.

videos.title: Rishtein mein aayi kadwahat?

Will they be able to overcome the issues plaguing their relationship? Also, catch world-renowned astrologer Prem Jyotish, as he reveals what the future holds for the housemates.

videos.title: Vishal-Madhurima ka mahayudh!

Things take a shocking turn when a furious Vishal demands action against Madhurima for when she flung her slipper at him in anger. However, a shocker awaits the two as Bigg Boss announces that either one of them will have to leave the house! Will the two set their ego aside and reconcile or will a decision by Bigg Boss end their game?

videos.title: Mahira ka naseeb, Shehnaz ka khel!
videos.overview: Day 101: Post their bitter altercation, Vishal Aditya Singh and Madhurima Tuli have an emotional and heart-warming reunion, leaving the housemates relieved. Further, the nominations activity puts Mahira Sharma in a tight spot as a turn of events regarding her nomination depends on Shehnaz Kaur's decision. Following the cold war between the two ladies post Sidharth Shukla's taunts the previous day, will Shehnaz save Mahira? Watch the excitement-filled episode to find out.

videos.title: Trio gets a Bigg punishment!
videos.overview: Day 102: Things get better as the housemates who indulged in tiffs, Vishal Aditya Singh-Madhurima Tuli, Shehnaz Kaur-Sidharth Shukla and Paras Chhabra-Mahira Sharma, begin to reconcile. Meanwhile, the captaincy task by Bigg Boss leaves the contestants perplexed as they are forced to choose between themselves and their rivals. Also, don't miss out on a shocking punishment for Asim Riaz, Paras and Mahira at the end of the captaincy task.

videos.title: Vikas Khanna's healthy food challenge!

Will they be able to impress him? But it's not all hunky-dory as a bitter fight erupts between Mahira Sharma and Shehnaz Kaur as the latter tries to enforce Bigg Boss' punishment to Mahira, Asim Riaz and Paras Chhabra! Will the trio succumb to her demands?

videos.title: Comedy neh pakada, Paritosh neh jakada!

Ace comedian and stand-up artist Paritosh Tripathi spreads glee as he hosts and heads the stand-up comedy session. Watch the housemates as they royally roast each other to earn the coveted title of winner of this fun-filled activity.

videos.title: Hina comes with a special surprise!

After many unsuccessful attempts, Sidharth Shukla consoles a sulking Shehnaz, who finally makes a startling revelation about her feelings for him! Meanwhile, Hina Khan aka Sher Khan visits the housemates with a surprise, the BB Elite Club! What is this BB Elite Club? Find out in today's entertainment-packed episode.

videos.title: Shuklaji ne kiya sanchalakon par vaar!

Meanwhile, a fun luxury budget task goes awry when Sidharth Shukla has an explosive altercation with the moderators of the task, Shefali Jariwala and Arti Singh! Faced with two of his closest friends from outside the house, can Shuklaji control his temperament this time? Watch this entertainment-packed episode to find out.

videos.title: Vishal-Madhurima wreaks controversy!

A furious Bigg Boss chides the two for their unprofessional behaviour and gets them jailed. While Madhurima accepts the punishment, a rebellious Vishal refuses to abide by Bigg Boss' rules and demands to quit the show. Will he stick to his decision after learning of the repercussions?

videos.title: Parag ki dhamki, Asim ki chuppi!

But the gala turns gloomy when Parag Tyagi, Shefali Jariwala's husband threatens Asim Riaz for his rude remarks and for misbehaving with his wife. Don't miss out on the thrilling episode.

videos.title: Maa ko dekh, bacche bane Shuklaji!

Will this adorable request from the tiny tots compel Rashami and Sidharth to re-ignite their dwindling friendship? Watch the entertainment-packed episode to find out.

videos.title: Sidharth-Asim lock horns, once again!

While Bigg Boss sternly announces that the two stay away from each other, all attempts to maintain peace go haywire when they completely disregard his orders. What will the outcome of such disrespect be? Find out.

With the female housemates acing Hina's task, will their heroic efforts be overshadowed by the alpha's roars? Watch the entertainment-packed episode to find out.

What will be the outcome of this startling revelation? Watch the episode to find out.

With Paras going berserk over the development and launching a direct attack on Shehnaz and Arti Singh, has Shehnaz's strategy backfired?

Tune in to find out in today's electrifying episode.

videos.title: #Sidnaz ki sachayi!

Also, find out what spooky and shocking surprise Bigg Boss has planned for the housemates with Paras Chhabra's help!

videos.title: A stroll down the memory lane!

Watch their spectacular performance that Salman himself deems 'the best tribute of all seasons' in this fun episode.

Who will it be? Find out in today's episode.

Also, the gorgeous Deepika Padukone and Vikrant Massey treat some of the housemates to a never before surprise in the history of Bigg Boss in this inspirational episode.

Also, a task between Shehnaz Kaur and Mahira Sharma goes awry, resulting in the former having a shocking outburst in front of Bhai. Meanwhile, Madhurima Tuli faces the wrath for her unprofessional behaviour towards Vishal Aditya Singh, Shehnaz Kaur is on cloud nine as she gets the golden opportunity to interact with her idol, Gautam Gulati! videos.title: Bigg Boss ke ghar, Love Aaj Kal!
videos.overview: Day 113: The contestants in the Bigg Boss house are ecstatic as they see Kartik Aaryan and Sara Ali Khan enter the house. Amidst games and playful banter, the duo manages to see some Love Aaj Kal-type bonds. Tune in to this epic episode as the housemates get into yet another verbal spat.

videos.title: Bhai ne dikyhaya Sid-Asim ko dwar!
videos.overview: Day 119: The housemates wake up to Himesh Reshammiya, who visits them with a fun activity to promote his film, Happy Hardy and Heer. Later, unable to tolerate Sidharth Shukla and Asim Riaz's constant threats to each other, Salman Khan opens the doors, asking them to fight each other outside. Will the two alphas of the house do the dreaded deed? Also, don't miss out on Saif Ali Khan and Alaia Furniturewalla who visit Salman Khan to promote their upcoming flick, Jawaani Jaaneman.

videos.title: BB house turns dance floor!
videos.overview: Day 120: Salman Khan greets Remo D'Souza, Varun Dhawan and Shraddha Kapoor and the rest of the cast of Street Dancer 3D on stage. While the trio spends some time playing some hilarious games with the housemates, they also perform an iconic dance step with Bhai! However, while the rest of the house dance and have fun, Paras Chhabra is a constant state of worry as the threat of elimination looms over his head. Will this be the end of his run in the house, or does someone else face the exit door?

videos.title: Rashami ko laga Himanshi ka jhatka!
videos.overview: Day 127: Salman Khan leaves Rashami Desai dumbstruck when he plays a clip of Himanshi Khurana making some shocking revelations about her and Arhaan Khan's relationship. Following the revelation, Rashami flares up at Asim Riaz's insensitivity, as he blindly supports Himanshi despite being unaware of the situation! Also catch a fun interaction between Hina Khan and Salman Khan as the former promotes her upcoming flick, Hacked.

videos.title: Somvaar ka vaar with team Malang!
videos.overview: Day 128: Anil Kapoor, Disha Patani, Kunal Khemu and Aditya Roy Kapur from Team Malang visit the BB house and conduct a fun task for the housemates. Also, with just two weeks remaining, which housemate will face the heat of the dreaded eliminations - Shehnaz Kaur or Vishal Aditya Singh? Watch this intriguing episode to find out.

videos.title: Shilpa-Salman ne ki yaadein taaza!
videos.overview: Day 134: Shilpa Shetty Kundra announces her return to films after a sabbatical of thirteen years with Nikamma starring Shirley Setia and Abhimanyu Dassani and visits Salman Khan to promote the same. While Shilpa and Salman reminisce their friendship, they indulge in a healthy yet hilarious game with Shirley and Abhimanyu. Also, watch the Weekend ka Vaar episode to see Arti Singh lose her mind and flare at Sidharth Shukla for not prioritising his friendship with her.

videos.title: Saavdhan! Ghar aaye Ayushmann!
videos.overview: Day 135: While Ayushmann Khurrana visits Salman Khan to promote his upcoming film Shubh Mangal Zyada Saavdhan with his co-stars Neena Gupta and Jitendra Kumar, Salman welcomes Adnan Sami and partakes in his joy of being awarded the reputed Padma Shri. Also, don't miss out the iconic moment when Salman gets hilariously grilled by reputed television journalist Rajat Sharma in this fun-filled episode.

videos.title: Grand Premiere
videos.overview: From actors, singers, models and even real-life couples, a variety of TV stars are all set to star in the show. However, before earning an entry into the house, each contestant has to go through an assessment taken by Bigg Boss seniors.

videos.title: Sunday Special With Bigg Boss 14
videos.overview: Bigg Boss' challenge for the Bigg Boss 14 contestants? Impress the seniors and get what you want. Watch out for this fun-filled Sunday Special episode as Gauahar Khan, Sidharth Shukla and Hina Khan torture the housemates for anything and everything.

videos.title: Jaan Aces The Mohawk Challenge!
videos.overview: Day 02: Bigg Boss introduces the first task - Entry Pass, a golden opportunity for the four Rejects to enter the BB house. However, Bigg Boss unleashes a twist by asking the Seniors to grill them with gruelling tasks. When Jaan Kumar Sanu is asked to undergo a mohawk haircut, he steps up to the challenge and aces it. Watch this entertaining episode of Bigg Boss 14 as the Seniors take the Rejects on a wild ride.

videos.title: Siddharth, Gauhar At Loggerheads!
videos.overview: Day 03: The housemates embrace the immunity task with gusto. While Hina Khan and Gauahar Khan are pampered as Queens, the thief chief Sidharth Shukla makes plans with his team. But things go south when Gauahar and Sidharth have a heated argument regarding the task rules. Will this bitter spat spell the end of the game?

videos.title: Abhinav's Big Dilemma - Wife Or Immunity?
videos.overview: Day 04: Abhinav Shukla is delighted when Bigg Boss gives him the option to save his wife Rubina Dilaik from the dreaded nominations. However, there is a catch. To save Rubina from the nominations, Abhinav must relinquish his immunity. Will Abhinav choose his love over his game?

videos.title: Siddharth, Shehzad's War Of Words!
videos.overview: Day 05: After Sidharth Shukla eliminates Rubina Dilaik from the oomph-filled dance task, Pavitra Punia, Nikki Tamboli, and Jasmin Bhasin fight it out in the remaining task that involves balancing glasses on a tray. A bitter fight ensues between the girls when Shehzad Deol knocks the glasses off Nikki's plate to help Jasmin win. However, Shehzad's actions don't sit well with Sidharth, who engages in a bitter war of words with him.

videos.title: Rubina, Abhinav: Together, But Still Apart!
videos.overview: Day 06: While Abhinav Shukla is delighted by his wife Rubina Dilaik's entry back into the house, he tries his best to convince the housemates to make adjustments in a way that he can share the bed with his wife. Shockingly, when Abhinav requests Senior Sidharth Shukla for help, Shuklaji flatly refuses, citing that it is his decision. While Abhinav and Rubina take the decision sportingly, will it be a reason for bitterness between them?

videos.title: A Fun Filled Weekend Ka Vaar!
videos.overview: Gear up for the much-awaited first-ever Weekend ka Vaar of the season. Amidst the building tensions, Salman Khan is ready to school the housemates for their actions over the past week. From the gruelling immunity tasks to Bhai's subtle jibe at the poor show of a few of the housemates to the revelation of a controversy which Eijaz Khan believes, left him marred and to a special advantage for the winner of the immunity task.

videos.title: Salman's Not So Subtle Warning!
videos.overview: Day 7: Salman Khan welcomes the star cast of the popular show Choti Sarrdaarni and has a virtual conversation with a few of popular Mumbai Indians players. Bhai's Vaar continues as the contestants indulge in some interesting tasks. While the housemates seem to have taken the game lightly, Bhai begs to differ. Criticising their performance as below par, the housemates and Seniors are left shocked when Bhai makes the announcement about evictions.

videos.title: Seniors Get A Super Power!
videos.overview: Day 09: After the revelations at the Weekend Ka Vaar, the atmosphere in the Bigg Boss house turns intense as the freshers reveal their true nature. However, the housemates get the shock of their lives when the seniors get the power to immediately send a fresher home. Who will be the victim of this surprise elimination?

videos.title: Nikki Not Playing Fair?
videos.overview: Day 11: After the surprise eliminations, the freshers get a second chance at being safe with the upcoming Mere Angane Me Tumhara Kya Kaam Hai task. With Nikki Tamboli being the supervisor of the task, the game quickly turns into a warzone, and she is blamed for her biased decisions. Will Nikki's decisions result in Big Boss having to intervene?

videos.title: Rubina In A Frenzy Of Fury!
videos.overview: Day 12: A sense of secretiveness prevails in the house as the housemates are busy creating strategies to ace the task. But things turn sour when Shehzad Deol calls Nishant Singh Malkani a 'Hijra' in the heat of the moment which leaves Rubina Dilaik fuming with rage, and she demands an apology from him for using the term as a derogatory word. Will Shehzad realise his mistake and apologise?

videos.title: Privilege Queen Nikki On Leave!
videos.overview: Day 12: A gloomy and tensed atmosphere prevails in the kitchen when a volatile argument erupts between Nikki Tamboli and Rubina Dilaik as the former uses her Privilege card and refuses to do her chores. Later the freshers' war to win their personal belongings in the new task turn ugly as things get a little more personal.

videos.title: Volcanic Dangal Between Seniors!
videos.overview: Day 14: Hell-bent to win the task, Nikki Tamboli and Jasmin Bhasin put every ounce of their blood in the task. But all hell broke loose as the task gets over and a volcanic war erupts between the Sidharth Shukla and Hina Khan as the former accuse her of being bias towards Jasmin Bhasin.

videos.title: Rubina Takes On The Seniors
videos.overview: Day 15: Trouble starts at the dawn of a new day as Rubina Dilaik and Abhinav Shukla fight for the improper kitchen duties. However, when the seniors intervene, Rubina goes ballistic to put forth her point. Will the seniors bow down to Rubina's solidarity? Stay tuned as Nikki Tamboli gets a reality check with regards to her confirmed status, in today's exciting episode of Bigg Boss 14.

videos.title: Salman Gives Rubina An Earful!
videos.overview: Day 16: Rubina Dilaik rebels against Bigg Boss and refuses to take part in the new task considering it as a grave slander, which leaves Salman Khan in a bitter mood and, he gives her an earful that her decision is erroneous. Disgruntled, he states that first time in the history of Bigg Boss he has witnessed such pointless and rebellious attitude in any contestant. Also, watch the high-voltage Bigg Boss 14 Weekend ka Vaar as Salman reveals that the fresher has the right to vote in the elimination.

videos.title: Siddharth, The Game Changer!
videos.overview: Day 17: As Salman Khan continues his 'Vaar' on the housemates, he chides them for their faults on the show and praises them for standing out during the week. While Jaan Kumar Sanu, Shehzad Deol, and Abhinav Shukla are put in the spotlight as the bottom three, they are tied at four votes each by the housemates, leaving Sidharth Shukla's decision as a game-changer. Who will Sidharth vote for, and how will his decision affect the game for the freshers?

videos.title: It's Shuklaji Against The Khan Duo!
videos.overview: Day 18: A task for the seniors and their teams is announced with the catch that the losing senior and their team will be eliminated from the game. When the housemates struggle to come to a resolution, Bigg Boss asks Gauahar Khan, Sidharth Shukla, and Hina Khan to take this tough decision. Watch this thrilling episode to find out why the Khan duo stands against Shuklaji and refer to his choice and justification as cheating.

videos.title: Game Over For Siddharth Shukla!
videos.overview: Day 19: While Sidharth Shukla and his teammates Pavitra Punia and Eijaz Khan face defeat in the task, the trio is evicted from the house. Shockingly, while the housemates express their grief over the eliminations, Pavitra and Eijaz make a surprise entry revealing a new area of the house: the red zone. With new alliances already being formed between the housemates, how will Pavitra and Eijaz's re-entry change the dynamics of the game?

videos.title: Nikki Senses Betrayal!
videos.overview: Day 19: The captaincy task stumbles in the very first round when the coordinators, Eijaz Khan and Pavitra Punia fail to make a unanimous decision, forcing Bigg Boss to intervene. This results in both Abhinav Shukla and Jasmin Bhasin's elimination. But the real drama unfolds during the second round when Nikki Tamboli points fingers at her own friends for turning their backs on her. With captaincy on the line, will friendship go for a toss?

videos.title: Rahul-Pavitra's volatile feud!
videos.overview: Day 20: Bigg Boss drops a bombshell on the house and mercilessly dismisses Nishant Singh Malkani from the throne of captaincy for violating a major rule of the house. Later, Pavitra Punia loses her temper and gets into a verbal conflict with Rahul Vaidya for besmirching her reputation by spreading a false rumour about her having a crush on Abhinav Shukla. Watch the volcanic feud unfold in this high-intensity episode

videos.title: Salman's high-intensity Vaar on Jaan!
videos.overview: Day 21: Jaan Kumar Sanu is put into the spotlight when Salman Khan confronts him for conspiring against and turning his back on his friend Nikki Tamboli! While Salman's revelations about Jaan's betrayal leave Nikki fuming with rage, she leaves no stone unturned and lashes out at him for his deceit! With Nikki finding a new ally in Rahul Vaidya, how will this alliance change the equations of the housemates? Watch this Weekend ka Vaar episode to find out

videos.title: Salman's triple googly!
videos.overview: Day 22: While Nora Fatehi and Guru Randhawa spread their magic with a spectacular performance amidst the Dussehra celebrations, Salman Khan introduces the new entrants, Kavitha Kaushik, Naina Singh and Shardul Pandit. As the contestants end up getting into a fierce argument over a task based on their participation in the game, Salman throws a Dussehra googly which leaves both, the housemates and the wild cards shocked! Watch this entertainment-packed episode for all the fun

videos.title: Rahul's debate on nepotism!
videos.overview: Day 23: While the captain of the house Kavita Kaushik establishes her authority by assigning duties to the housemates, a vicious feud erupts when Rahul Vaidya accuses Jaan Kumar Sanu of being a product of nepotism! While Rahul justifies his choice of words, he earns the ire of the housemates who openly express their displeasure towards him during the nominations task! Will Rahul's choice of words put his position in the game in jeopardy? Watch this episode to find out

videos.title: Jasmin goes berserk!
videos.overview: Day 24: Rahul Vaidya's choice of words puts him in the spotlight again for creating a rift between Nikki Tamboli and Jaan Kumar Sanu. While Rahul's hurtful comment about women earns him the housemates' wrath, he leaves the normally cheerful Jasmin Bhasin furious when he uses his strength in the captaincy task, which Jasmin thought was unwarranted for. Visibly upset, Jasmin lashes out at Rahul violently! Watch this entertainment-packed episode for the events that follow

videos.title: Rubina-Kavita lock horns!
videos.overview: Day 25: Amidst the already-prevailing tensions in the house, Rubina Dilaik grows agitated when Captain Kavita Kaushik requests her to cut fruits for her. Rubina rubs Kavita the wrong way when she reminds her of the rights and duties of a captain. All hell breaks loose as Kavita tells Rubina not to display her Faltugiri by arguing with her, and Rubina hits back by calling Kavita a dictator. Watch their pulsating confrontation in this episode

videos.title: Kavita: Leave me alone, Eijaz!
videos.overview: Day 26: The housemates sense a turn in the tide as Eijaz Khan becomes the captain of the Bigg Boss house. However, the atmosphere gets heated when the former captain Kavita Kaushik loses her cool and gives Eijaz a piece of her mind for nagging her about the rules of the house. Will Eijaz back off? Catch the drama unfold in this episode

videos.title: The game-changer swap or stay!
videos.overview: Day 27: After the heated clash with Kavita Kaushik, Eijaz Khan gets heartbroken and bursts into tears! Later during the game of Swap and Stay, captain Eijaz gets the special right to change the fate of all the contestants. Who will Eijaz save and who will get dumped in the Red Zone? Watch the game-changer episode packed with shocking surprises

videos.title: Rubina-Abhinav face Salman's wrath!
videos.overview: Day 28: While the housemates gear up for yet another Weekend ka Vaar, Salman Khan roasts Rahul Vaidya for his comments about nepotism against Jaan Kumar Sanu. Meanwhile, Abhinav Shukla and Rubina Dilaik face Salman's wrath when they justify Jasmin's outburst and criticise Rahul! Watch this seat-gripping episode to see Bhai address some of the sensitive issues like violence, instigation and nepotism, that have plagued the house and the housemates over the week

videos.title: Eijaz-Kavita's volatile brawl!
videos.overview: Day 29: Salman Khan welcomes Sunidhi Chauhan as he continues his Vaar on the housemates, amidst the heat of the weekly eviction! While Eijaz Khan and Kavita Kaushik's friendship is left marred by harsh allegations and shocking revelations during a task, the ever-chirpy Shehnaz Gill arrives with a 'Pyar Bhara' surprise for Eijaz and Pavitra Punia! Stay tuned to this entertaining episode as Eijaz swoops Pavitra off her feet as the two leave for their oh-so-romantic date

videos.title: Double eviction dhamaka!
videos.overview: Day 30: An unexpected fiasco unfolds when Naina Singh refuses to do her cooking duty over an altercation with Eijaz Khan and the housemates question Eijaz's captaincy. Later, Bigg Boss announces a shocking double eviction and gives the Green Zone contestants the right to evict one contestant and hands the second elimination to the audience vote! Which two contestants will face the sword of deadly double elimination? Tune in to find out

videos.title: Pavitra is heartbroken!
videos.overview: Day 32: Pavitra Punia is aghast when Eijaz Khan chooses to save Jasmin Bhasin from the nominations over her! While Pavitra is not satisfied with the reason Eijaz cites for saving Jasmin, Jaan Kumar Sanu also accuses Eijaz of selective favouritism. With Eijaz's paranoia regarding the captaincy getting on the housemates' nerves, what will be the outcome of his altercation with his close friends? Watch this episode to find out

videos.title: Pavitra takes her revenge!
videos.overview: Day 33: Pavitra Punia and Eijaz Khan end up in a vicious war of words when Pavitra loses her cool and bumps him with her elbow in rage! While Eijaz chooses Shardul Pandit as his representative in the captaincy task due to his injury, Pavitra takes her revenge on Eijaz by tactically getting Shardul out of the contention to win the task. Tune in for all the drama

videos.title: Jasmin gets possessive!
videos.overview: Day 34: While Pavitra Punia is upset about her tiff with Shardul Pandit, she discusses the same with Aly Goni through the phone in his room. Jasmin Bhasin overhears the conversation and interrupts them. Taken aback by Jasmin's sudden intrusion, Pavitra gets into a war of words and accuses Jasmin of being possessive about Aly. Is Jasmin getting too possessive of her friend Aly? Watch this episode to find out

videos.title: Angels vs devils!
videos.overview: Day 35: Excitement flourishes in the house as Bigg Boss announces the luxury budget to the winner of the next team battle, The Devils and the Angels. Teamed up as devils, Eijaz Khan, Aly Goni, and Nikki Tamboli make Jaan Kumar Sanu do the dirty work in the restroom and humiliate him. Can the devils manage to break through the imposed calmness of the angels and bag the luxury budget? Tune in to find out

videos.title: Dance party with Team Remo!
videos.overview: Day 36: Get ready to enjoy the dance party as ace choreographer and director, Remo D'Souza and his proteges Salman Yusuff Khan, Punit J Pathak and Shakti Mohan grace the stage to promote their new music label company, BLive. The fun reaches its peak when BB couples put on their dancing shoes and strut their funky stuff on the dance floor. Watch the Weekend Ka Vaar episode jam-packed with entertaining performances

videos.title: Bhai grills the housemates!
videos.overview: Day 37: Salman Khan continues his Vaar on the housemates as he addresses some prevalent issues in the house. Salman schools Pavitra Punia for her allegations and aggression towards Eijaz Khan and also put the housemates in the spotlight for not intervening in their argument, reminding them of their moral responsibility. Tune in to the episode as Bhai not only grills the housemates but also shocks everyone with the eviction in this Weekend ka Vaar

videos.title: Farah's court is in session!
videos.overview: Day 38: Farah Khan, along with two journalists Charrul Malik and Amith Tyagi, enters the house to hold Farah Ki Adalat to judge the contestants based on their journey so far. And in the end, one of the housemates will be nominated for eviction by the trio. Without wasting any time, the judges summon Eijaz Khan and bring up his ongoing conflict with Kavita Kaushik, and she faces the music for her stance. Will Kavita hold her ground and prove her innocence?

videos.title: Jasmin's emotional dilemma!
videos.overview: Day 39: While the housemates are recuperating from the shock of Farah Khan's courtroom session, they are hit by yet another shocker, the dreaded nominations task! Jasmin Bhasin is put in a difficult situation when her favourite doll is destroyed by Aly Goni to save Abhinav Shukla. Jasmin then faces the heat when she is asked to nominate her best friend Aly to save Rubina Dilaik. Will Jasmin prioritise Aly over Rubina? Watch Jasmin face her demons in today's episode

videos.title: Partying all night goes wrong!
videos.overview: Day 40: Rahul Vaidya takes centre stage and goes down on one knee to romantically propose his girlfriend, Disha Parmar. Later, Bigg Boss throws a surprise all-night disco party with music industry biggies - DJ Chetas, Anu Malik and Neeti Mohan as the special guests. But, the catch here is that it's also a captaincy task! Watch the entertaining party turn into a volcanic verbal fight as Eijaz Khan and Abhinav Shukla lock horns

videos.title: The test of Captain Aly's patience!
videos.overview: Day 41: While the housemates dance their way into the race for captainship to the tunes of Shaan and Sachin Trivedi, Aly Goni shines as the new captain of the house. However, Nikki Tamboli is unhappy with Aly's captaincy and decides to go against his rules. She extends her sleep hours despite his constant requests. After several attempts, an annoyed Aly splashes water on her face! How will Nikki react to Aly's shocking act? Watch the episode to find out the events that transpire

videos.title: Rubina-Abhinav face Bigg Boss' googly!
videos.overview: Day 42: The housemates must mutually decide any two names for a set of cages placed in the house as a punishment for their unsatisfactory performance during the week. While Jaan Kumar Sanu is targeted by Rubina Dilaik and Abhinav Shukla citing time for retrospection, Bigg Boss turns the tables and puts the couple in the cages for modifying task rules. How will Abhinav and Rubina deal with this shocking twist of fate?

videos.title: Game of gifts with Vamps and Divas
videos.overview: Day 43: On the eve of Diwali, Salman Khan takes the housemates on an emotional roller-coaster ride with gifts from loved ones. To mark the victory of good over evil, Sudha Chandran and Monalisa arrive as Vamps, while Surbhi Jyoti and Mahima Makwana join in as the Divas, who come with a few challenges for the housemates. Will the Divas prevail over the Vamps, or will history change? Tune in to find out in today's episode

videos.title: High-octane Qawwali battle!
videos.overview: Day 44: During the Diwali celebration, the entertainment level goes through the roof as the playful banter and rhyming wisecracks of the Qawwali battle makes Salman Khan burst out with laughter. Later, he welcomes Haarsh Limbachiyaa, Garvit Pareek and Surbhi Chandna and the trio plays a fun game with the housemates. But the joyful atmosphere vanishes because of the forthcoming eviction. Watch the epic episode jampacked with entertainment and find out who is going home

videos.title: A one-of-a-kind nomination
videos.overview: Day 45: The housemates are taken aback when Bigg Boss announces a special nomination process. Being the captain, Aly Goni is allowed to nominate six housemates for eviction. While the housemates try to convince the nominated housemates to save them, the inner politics continue to change the equations between them. With alliances being made and broken, watch how the nominations change the dynamics of the game, in the episode

videos.title: Kavita-Eijaz's volcanic fight!
videos.overview: Day 46: Things don't look any better for Kavita Kaushik inside the BB house as she enters into a heated argument with Aly Goni followed by a volcanic feud with her arch-enemy, Eijaz Khan! But things really escalate to an ugly level when Kavita is forced to commit a physical act of misconduct. Later, the new captaincy task begins as the King of black hearts - Rahul Vaidya wages war against the Queen of red hearts - Rubina Dilaik. Watch the drama unfold in this entertaining episode

videos.title: Nikki goes breaking hearts
videos.overview: With captaincy at stake, the housemates, along with the King and Queen, form groups and strategies to gain the upper hand. With no alliances to join and no opportunity of winning the task at hand, Nikki Tamboli sends shockwaves through the Bigg Boss house as she starts smashing the hearts in the garden area before the task begins. Will Nikki's sudden act get her shunned by both teams? Or will Nikki's unusual strategy work for her? Catch the drama unfold in this episode

videos.title: Jaan faces betrayal!
videos.overview: Day 48: While Bigg Boss criticises the housemates for squandering the golden chance to become the captain in the previous task, a captaincy task for the four previous captains is announced. Jaan Kumar Sanu loses his cool when Eijaz Khan chooses to make Pavitra Punia his representative owing to his injury. Later, Jaan's temper hits the roof when the housemates put him into a guilt-trip for continuously torturing Kavita. Watch Jaan break down on being betrayed by Eijaz in this episode

videos.title: The clash of the spouses!
videos.overview: Day 49: While the captaincy task between Kavita Kaushik and Jasmin Bhasin exceeds twenty-four hours, Rubina Dilaik suggests reaching an agreement between the two and concluding the task. However, Abhinav Shukla is against the idea and refuses to support Rubina in her initiative and advises her against it! Visibly upset, Rubina lashes out at him and implies that he is not participating to his fullest in the task! Watch the couple as they battle it among themselves in this episode

videos.title: Jaan, a friend for convenience?
videos.overview: Day 50: Friendships and alliances are put to the test as the housemates are told to name two people who have friendships based on convenience. While Abhinav Shukla is advised to play his own game, Jaan Kumar Sanu is put in the spotlight for making friends with people in power. Will Jaan be able to justify his actions as well as not lose the already earned friends' support? Tune in to find out in today's dramatic Weekend Ka Vaar episode

videos.title: Ekta's dramatic twist: Immunity Stone!
videos.overview: Day 51: The Queen of Indian Television, Ekta Kapoor enters the BB house with revenge on her mind and the Immunity Stone in her hands. However, only one contestant can have the game-changing Immunity Stone and, they will have to impress Ekta to win it! Later, Divyendu Sharma And Sumeet Vyas join them in a hilarious roasting session followed by a shocking eviction. Watch the entertaining episode jampacked with drama, humour and a surprise revelation

videos.title: Rahul locks horns with Eijaz!
videos.overview: Day 52: During the nomination task, the dirty politics unfolds an aggressive argument between Eijaz Khan and Rahul Vaidya as the latter chooses to break his promise to save him and openly nominate him. Later, a wave of laughter spread across the BB house as Kavita Kaushik gives her justification and housemates laugh to scorn the house captain. Watch the drama unfold in this engrossing episode

videos.title: Aly wrecks complete havoc!
videos.overview: Day 53: The housemates are taken aback when Bigg Boss gives Kavita Kaushik the responsibility of confiscating the personal possessions of the housemates whom she feels have broken the rules. While Kavita confiscates Aly Goni's trimmer, things get heated up when she mentions his father's name, leaving him furious! Matters escalate to the point where Aly damages the property and Kavita is hurt in the scuffle. What will be the outcome of this volatile argument? Watch the masala-packed episode to find out!

videos.title: Rubina-Abhinav turn rebels!
videos.overview: Day 54: Rubina Dilaik and Abhinav Shukla rebel against Kavita Kaushik's captainship by refusing to do their duties and openly break the house rules. Soon, a task titled Batwara is announced where the house is divided into two, and each side has to claim the rights to the house. With Rubina and Abhinav in one team, will Kavita take her revenge against the two for their rebellious attitude or will she play fair? Watch this action-packed episode to find out,

videos.title: Eijaz in a tight spot
videos.overview: Day 55: With the housemates split into two teams, the ones who have access to the bedroom dominate the house. Meanwhile, Nikki Tamboli manages to convince Eijaz Khan to let her into the bedroom under the pretext that she is unwell. But Eijaz faces backlash from his teammates for letting her in as she starts collecting all her things before she is forced out of the room. Will Eijaz manage to get her out of the room? Tune in to find out,

videos.title: Rubina vs Jasmin: The Bigg fight!
videos.overview: Day 56: The Batwara task leaves the housemates divided and against each other, leaving aside their alliances and friendships. While Jasmin Bhasin and her team win the Batwara task with the right to maximum property, nothing seems right between Jasmin and her good friend Rubina Dilaik. What exactly happened during the task that leaves Jasmin seething in anger and threatening to reveal personal secrets about Rubina and Abhinav Shukla? Watch this episode to find out the details,

videos.title: Salman announces a Bigg purge!
videos.overview: Day 57: While Salman Khan opens the Weekend Ka Vaar episode with a bang, the housemates face his questions, criticism and appreciation. Soon, the housemates are left shocked with gaping mouths when Salman makes an unexpected announcement! He announces the grand finale of the season during the coming week with a new and major twist in the game! Watch this thrilling episode to find out for yourself as Bhai makes the revelation,

videos.title: Aly-Jasmin get roasted!
