videos.title: Day 01: Assembly Room Mayhem
videos.overview: Kalesh is on as BB asks the housemates to select the least impressive contestant! Doors to the assembly room are opened, and a 'Raajnitik' twist shakes up the Gharwaales.

videos.title: Day 02: Nominations On, Drama Full-on!
videos.overview: Nominations put the Gharwaales out of their comfort zone, and cracks become evident within the 'Sarkar'. In the secret room, Farhana continues to keep an eye on the house.

videos.title: Day 03: 'Daal' Mein Kuch Kaala Hai
videos.overview: Gaurav faces the heat as the chaos flares over food and rationing! Ahead of the captaincy showdown, Farhana has an upper hand to get back at her opposition - the Gharwaales.

videos.title: Day 04: All Eyes on Captaincy!
videos.overview: Alliances break and politics cook as contestants vie for captainship. While 'Sanchalak' Baseer plots with the house, the task seems to be bringing new rifts among the Gharwaales.

videos.title: Day 05: The Chosen One
videos.overview: After the high-octane captaincy task, BB Sarkar gets its first captain! While a rebellion seems to be rising, the brand new App-room seems to bring a new twist to the game.

videos.title: Day 06: Pehla Pehla 'Vaar' Hai!
videos.overview: It is the season's first Weekend ka Vaar, and Salman goes all out in confronting the Gharwaales about their clashes and confessions. Entertainment peaks as Tiger Shroff graces the BB stage.

videos.title: Day 07: Weekend Verdict with Salman
videos.overview: Tension heightens in the house with potential elimination looming! The 'Pole-Khol' round unveils the contestants' hidden emotions that will shape the chemistry of the Sarkaar!

videos.title: Day 08: Safai Pe Epic Ladayi
videos.overview: Cleaning duty becomes a point of contention in the house, leaving Tanya at odds with many. When the Gharwaales revolt against their captain Kunickaa, she has to take a bold decision!

videos.title: Day 09: Nominations Aur Nok-Jhok!
videos.overview: Farhana and Baseer cannot let go of their fight from the previous day. Room of Fate opens a pandora's box of angst and resentment as the Gharwaales nominate each other.

videos.title: Day 10: The 'BB Show' Is On
videos.overview: With their powerhouse talent, the Gharwaales bring the BB House down! Pranit's jibe at Zeishan sparks a debate at the assembly that will have a direct impact on captaincy.

videos.title: Day 11: Captaincy Race, Gharwaales' Fate
videos.overview: Gharwaales put it all on the line to win the Dream Machine captaincy task, but here, nothing ends without Kalesh. Bigg Boss reprimands the house for breaking a major rule.

videos.title: Day 12: Aloo Puri Ka Kissa
videos.overview: Farhana and Nehal join hands to rally the Gharwaales against Abhishek. Things get out of hand when Kunickaa stops Zeishan from eating more Puris.

videos.title: Day 13: A Crucial Reality Check
videos.overview: Salman Khan gives the Gharwaales a heavy dose of hard truths they won't forget anytime soon. He then introduces a surprise guest for Kunickaa. Who is it?

videos.title: Day 14: Wild Wild Surprises!
videos.overview: The BB stage gets crazier with a special Sunday roast featuring Munawar, Kullu and Sahiba. Salman announces a surprise entry in the house, but who's exiting the Sarkaar tonight?

videos.title: Day 15: Tick, Tick, Nomination Bomb!
videos.overview: The nomination task brings a new twist, and the Gharwaales are out to get each other. Things get out of control with Tanya and Kunickaa's clash over 'Sanskaar' and 'Parvarish'.

videos.title: Day 16: Mudde Pe Mudda
videos.overview: The nomination task nears its end, but the Gharwaales are not yet done. Tanya and Kunickaa's clash takes an ugly turn, dividing 'Ghar Ki Saarkaar'. Which side are you on?

videos.title: Day 17: Inside BB Coaching Centre
videos.overview: Fun banters begin in the BB house as the Gharwaales take class in a quirky Andaaz. While heated clashes continue, Kunickaa's monopoly over the kitchen becomes a boiling point.

videos.title: Day 18: Khel Khel Mein!
videos.overview: It is sports day in the BB house, but here, games become a war of words. Abhishek and Baseer's clash turns brutal, while debates heat up for captaincy support.

videos.title: Day 19: Captain by Democracy
videos.overview: After the chaotic sports day, the winning team stakes its claim on captaincy. But in Gharwaalon Ki Sarkaar, democracy will always have an upper hand. Who'll be the new BB Mantri?

videos.title: Day 20: Jolly Aur Jolly, Haazir Ho!
videos.overview: This Weekend Ka Vaar, it is Farah Khan's fiery class as she grills some Gharwaales. But the house is adjourned for laughter as Akshay Kumar and Arshad Warsi arrive in Jolly style.

videos.title: Day 21: First Conviction, Then Eviction?
videos.overview: Akshay Kumar is back, this time with BB's Adaalat-where Gharwaales have to defend themselves. Tension heightens as Farah opens the exit door for the season's first elimination.

videos.title: Day 22: What's Cooking? Kitchen Politics!
videos.overview: Tension and drama peak as Amaal navigates constant clashes in his captaincy. While Tanya's 'Raeesi Ke Kisse' keeps the house guessing, kitchen drama heats up yet again.

videos.title: Day 23: A Prank Goes Wrong
videos.overview: The house is thrown into chaos as Shehbaz and Amaal hide everyone's belongings and food. Once busted-the Gharwaales get into action mode against Shehbaz, demanding punishment.

videos.title: Day 24: 'Lootere' in Action!
videos.overview: BB actions a strict move against the Gharwaales for a major rule break, while a new twist exposes real friendships. In the captaincy task, the girls steal the spotlight.

videos.title: Day 25: All Eyes on Captaincy Seat
videos.overview: The Lootere task intensifies as the Gharwaales put it all on the line, eyeing the captaincy seat. Once again, food drama erupts in the house as Abhishek and Amaal lock horns

videos.title: Day 26: Say 'Cheese' for Captaincy
videos.overview: The captaincy fight reaches its deciding stage. Gaurav gets called out for lack of involvement in tasks, while a rebellion brews as the new captain takes charge of the Sarkaar.

videos.title: Day 27: Play Safe? Get Burnt by Salman!
videos.overview: Salman Khan returns on Weekend Ka Vaar, slamming housemates for playing safe. Soon, BB's task to expose non-players ignites fiery clashes in the house.

videos.title: Day 28: Drama, Style and a Shocking Exit
videos.overview: Salman exposes the gharwalas' fake sacrifices while Uorfi lights up the house with style, laughter, and chaos. Another elimination twists the game again.

videos.title: Day 29: Ghar Ka Mahaul Is Hot!
videos.overview: It is Captain Abhishek's reign, but the drama won't stop. Kunickaa locks horns with Zeishan, and the clash turns ugly. Chupke-chupke, Nehal is keeping an eye on the house.

videos.title: Grand Premiere: Vardaan ya Toofan?
videos.overview: Milega vardaan, ya machega toofan? Your 'host-dost' Salman Khan brings season 20 of the greatest reality show, serving entertainment and drama—unfiltered! Get ready for 'Two-much' fun as your beloved Host-Dost, Salman Khan, unveils the grand Season 20 in style! All eyes are on the 'Vardaan', which will power this epic game. Ek Vardaan, Extra Jeevandan!

videos.title: BBHin Day 01: Kanika’s Boon, Housemates’ Bane!
videos.overview: The Gharwaales begin to settle in, but with growing connections, new conflicts follow! Kanika uses her special 'Vardaan', while BB's 20th birthday bash begins with a twist.

videos.title: BBHin Day 02: Sanchalan Gone Wrong
videos.overview: BB’s birthday party heats up as ‘Sanchalak’ Qazi faces the Gharwaales’ wrath. Doors to the '2X Room' open, bringing a special power for the captaincy contenders.

videos.title: BBHin Day 03: All Eyes on 'Pehla Kaptaan'
videos.overview: Gossip intensifies with ‘rockstar’ Qazi becoming the talk of the house! As the BB movie premiere begins, Gharwaales rally behind their favourite for the coveted first captaincy.

videos.title: BBHin Day 04: Rewind! 20 Years of Bigg Boss
videos.overview: The captaincy task reaches its deciding stage, while new alliances hint at brewing politics. Further, the ‘Mahaul’ gets emotional as Bigg Boss’ 20-year legacy comes alive!

videos.title: BBHin Day 05: Rule Break? Discipline Check!
videos.overview: Captain Yung tries to keep Kanika in check over house rules, but their verbal spat drags the entire house. Further, a rule break by the boys triggers serious repercussions!

videos.title: BBHin Day 06: Pehla Vaar! Ft. OG Rockstar
videos.overview: Pehla, pehla ‘Vaar’ hain! Salman Khan brings his ‘rockstar’ energy to the stage as he praises Qazi’s performance. Alongside a few reality checks, follow a series of fun tasks.

videos.title: BBHin Day 07: Gajab Beizzati, Peak Masti
videos.overview: It’s time for ‘Gajab Beizzati’ as Aasif takes on a roasting challenge. The fun continues with Yung and Mahi playing matchmakers, while Salman readies to announce Janta’s faisla!

videos.title: BBHin Day 08: Secrets Out! Sparks Fly
videos.overview: Uditi and Aasif clash while nomination drama engulfs the Gharwaales. Bigg Boss exposes hidden strategies plotted by a few housemates, leading to a fiery post-nomination fight.

videos.title: BBHin Day 09: Rang Mein Bhang, Ghar Mein Jung
videos.overview: Amrapali and Mahi's food fight sparks a house-wide clash! Captaincy ki daawedari shuru as Gharwaales pick sides. Post the task, Arishfa and Scout's argument becomes chaotic.

videos.title: BBHin Day 10: Loyalties Put to the Test
videos.overview: Mahi's support for a rival strains her bond with Yung while Amrapali calls out Lovepreet's loyalty. Boys get their final captaincy pick. How will the girls decide theirs?

videos.title: BBHin Day 11: Captaincy Chaos Erupts
videos.overview: A shocking elimination from the captaincy task leads to betrayals, heated fights, and provocative remarks between the Gharwaales. Eventually, the house crowns its new Captain!

videos.title: BBHin Day 12: A Risky Ration Quiz
videos.overview: Lovepreet's remark upsets Amrapali, while Mahi and Uditi question Mary's contribution. During the Ration Quiz, can the Gharwaales match Gullu's answers?

videos.title: BBHin Day 13: Salman Laye Hain 'Sach Ki Topi'
videos.overview: Salman settles the clashes in the house with Sach Ki Topi. Scout gets schooled and Aasif's aggression is called out. A shocking move awaits the Gharwaales!

videos.title: BBHin Day 14: Entertainment, Elimination, Exposé
videos.overview: Salman gives Qazi a unique reality check. Munawar and Sonali roast the Gharwaales, while Sidharth and Tamannaah bring fun games. Who will bid farewell to the house tonight?

videos.title: BBHin Day 15: Nominations with a Twist
videos.overview: Equations between the Gharwaales are put to the test as the Nominations begin. With rations dwindling, Bigg Boss offers a luxury basket, but it comes at a very high cost.

videos.title: BBHin Day 16 - Kaun Top Kaun Flop
videos.overview: The rift between the groups deepens as Yung and Aman’s clash takes an ugly turn. But the chaos is just getting started as the Gharwaales must rank each other in the ration task!

videos.title: BBHin Day 17: Diss Battle - Pyaar Se Vaar!
videos.overview: The race for captaincy contendership is on, with the house turning into a diss battleground. As team Qazi and team Yung go head to head, fiery clashes ensue.

videos.title: BBHin Day 18: Ulta Prachar Race Se Bahar
videos.overview: The diss battle nears a banger climax, and the house gets its captaincy contenders! But the Gharwaales will take the final call. Who’ll face rejection, and who’ll ace this race?

videos.title: BBHin Day 19: And the New Captain Is...
videos.overview: The Gharwaales rally behind their favourite Daavedaar in the final captaincy match, where Yung and Qazi lock horns! But the big question - who'll bag the coveted captainship?

videos.title: BBHin Day 20: Salman Ka Reality Check!
videos.overview: Salman grills the Gharwalas over the diss battle as Rhiti faces his ire for crossing the line. Jealousy sparks revelations, while Yung ranks his group members.

videos.title: BBHin Day 21: Salman’s Star-Studded Evening
videos.overview: Ajay Devgn and Jaideep Ahlawat join Salman as the Gharwaalas face a courtroom twist. Amid the fun and masti, one Gharwaala’s journey comes to an end.

videos.title: BBHin Day 22: Room 2X - Double the Twists!
videos.overview: The doors to Room 2X open, granting captain Gullu the power of ‘Jeevandan’. While he leverages this game-changing power, BB drops another bomb with the new nomination twist!

videos.title: BBHin Day 23: Mission Ration, Phir Captain?
videos.overview: As old bonds take a hit, the house dynamics begin to change! Fierce face-offs follow in the captaincy contendership task, where captaincy and ration are up for grabs.

videos.title: BBHin Day 24: Rate the Captain! Yea or Nay?
videos.overview: It’s a ‘1 v all’ situation for Qazi as his comment sets Kanika off and turns the Gharwaales against him! Gullu gets another shot at captaincy contendership, but there’s a catch.

videos.title: BBHin Day 25: Darr Ka Mahaul Ft. Dolly
videos.overview: A new debate stirs over the kitchen clash between Mahhi and Mary! The house turns jolly as BB introduces Dolly, and the boys must follow her orders to bag captaincy contendership!

videos.title: BBHin Day 26: Mid-week Eviction!
videos.overview: Tension heightens in the house with an unexpected eviction! With new twists in the game every day, the captaincy race gets grittier. Who’ll emerge as the new leader?

videos.title: BBHin Day 27: Salman Demands Honest Answers
videos.overview: Salman asks the Gharwalas to name those they admire and those they see flaws in. Qazi faces scrutiny over Kanika, while Aasif gets praised for stepping up.

videos.title: BBHin Day 28: Surprise Ya Shock?
videos.overview: Ayushmann Khurrana, Sara Ali Khan, Mika Singh and more special guests join Salman on stage. Fun and games take over, but the danger of eviction looms large over the Gharwaales.

videos.title: BBHin Day 29: Pack a Nomination Punch!
videos.overview: The kitchen clash is on, where Mahhi and Uditi find themselves at loggerheads. Post WKV, the house dynamics change once again, and it all unravels in the nomination-special ring!

videos.title: BBHin Day 30: No More Pyaar Only Takraar
videos.overview: The nomination ring comes to a close, but captain Uditi’s ‘Vishesh Adhikaar’ adds a new twist. Further, the aftereffects of nominations kick in, where old bonds begin to crack!

videos.title: BBHin Day 31: It’s Debate Time
videos.overview: Aasif steps into the shoes of a news anchor, bringing the latest scoop of the house! Eyeing captaincy contendership, the Gharwaales aim to win the debate. Who’ll make a mark?

videos.title: BBHin Day 32: The Ration Heist!
videos.overview: Scout’s comment on Love and Yung’s equation doesn’t sit well, and a clash ensues! The real drama unfolds in BB’s ration godown as Love’s unexpected move triggers everyone.

videos.title: BBHin Day 33: Love Says, Checkmate!
videos.overview: New clashes continue to upend the house! But the real politics unfold when Love leverages her ‘Vishesh Adhikaar’, which becomes the deciding factor in the captaincy battle.

videos.title: BBHin Day 34: Whose Game Needs a Rebirth?
videos.overview: Salman puts the Gharwalas in the spotlight as Gullu names three who are yet to reveal themselves. With Roadies Rebirth fun and a wildcard twist, who will shake up the game?

videos.title: BBHin Day 35: Salman Turns Up the Heat
videos.overview: Salman confronts Scout, Yung and Aman over their actions and calls out the Gharwalas for lacking empathy towards Qazi. With eviction looming, a surprise entry awaits.

videos.title: BBHin Day 36: Kalesh Trending Hai!
videos.overview: The new wildcards become the buzz of the house as the Gharwaales decode their personalities. Qazi and Gullu plot a prank, while Arishfa and Kanika go berserk in a heated face-off!

videos.title: BBHin Day 37: Gazab Mudde, Gazab Bezzati
videos.overview: Nominations Ki Baithak in BB Gazab Bezzati Zone turns heated as Mary, Uditi and Arishfa clash. A minor spat between Nakul and Gullu explodes, sending the Gharwaales into chaos.

videos.title: BBHin Day 38: Action Ka Reaction, BB-style!
videos.overview: After the explosive clash, Gharwaales question Nakul’s actions. While BB delivers a strong judgement, Lovepreet's unexpected move triggers the housemates.

videos.title: BBHin Day 39: Select. Eliminate. Elect!
videos.overview: The captaincy race gets intense as the ultimate power lies in the hands of ex-captains, who’ll elect the next house captain! Emotions run high as Arishfa shares a moment with Qazi.

videos.title: BBHin Day 40: BB Says, Take a Life!
videos.overview: A rebellion brews in the house as Arishfa feels targeted. BB adds a new twist—with time and ration running out, the housemates must decide whose life to sacrifice.

videos.title: BBHin Day 41: Pehle Expose, Phir Explode
videos.overview: Salman holds nothing back, calling out some Gharwaales’ inaction and vile tactics! While the reality check is served, Kanika and Yung get praised for standing by the right.

videos.title: BBHin Day 42: Knock, Knock? It’s Time to Exit
videos.overview: Salman brings a series of confrontation tasks that let Gharwaales speak up against each other! While this unfurls bitter clashes, tension peaks as the exit door is about to open.

videos.title: BBHin Day 43: A Bitter Revenge!
videos.overview: The post-WKV vibe is all about clashes, as rifts continue among Scout, Yung, and Qazi. But Arishfa unleashes the big storm as she goes on a vengeance mode against the Gharwaales.

videos.title: BBHin Day 44: Nominations - Kitne Doshi?
videos.overview: It’s nomination time, and a war of words ensues as the Gharwaales must nominate based on the 'Dosh'! While captain Scout gets a special power, Aasif and Qazi lock horns mid-task.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: The residents attempt to mend their fractured friendships. But uncertainty looms over Chumbak Colony, leaving their future in doubt.

videos.name: Priti Panwar & Sushma Mishra
videos.overview:
The most dashing Man of India, Megastar Amitabh Bachchan begins the most awaited show 'Saptakoti Mahadhari' Kaun Banega Crorepati on a musical note with Playback Singer Sonu Nigam. Priti Panwar becomes the first contestant to play KBC. 

An introductory clip of Priti Panwar from Rohtak, Haryana depicts on the screen in which she expresses her views on Girls Education. Amitabh Bachchan welcomes Sanmeet Kaur Sahani. Priti Panwar becomes the first contestant to wins Rs. 25,00,000.

movie|tmdb:24049.name: Sivaji: The Boss
movie|tmdb:24049.description: A wealthy engineer arrives in India with the mission of serving the nation and investing in the country's welfare but is met with strong opposition from corrupt officials and politicians. After being faced with insurmountable hardships, he decides to take drastic measures.

movie|tmdb:927547.name: All We Imagine as Light
movie|tmdb:927547.description: In Mumbai, Nurse Prabha's routine is troubled when she receives an unexpected gift from her estranged husband. Her younger roommate, Anu, tries in vain to find a spot in the city to be intimate with her boyfriend. A trip to a beach town allows them to find a space for their desires to manifest.

movie|tmdb:7508.name: Like Stars on Earth
movie|tmdb:7508.description: Ishaan Awasthi is an eight-year-old whose world is filled with wonders that no one else seems to appreciate. Colours, fish, dogs, and kites don't seem important to the adults, who are much more interested in things like homework, marks, and neatness. Ishaan cannot seem to get anything right in class; he is then sent to boarding school, where his life changes forever.

movie|tmdb:21665.name: Khakee
movie|tmdb:21665.description: DCP Anant and his team get tasked with escorting an alleged terrorist to Mumbai. However, a rogue ex-police officer makes their task difficult as he tries to stop them from reaching their destination.

movie|tmdb:45533.name: Pyaar Kiya To Darna Kya
movie|tmdb:45533.description: A wealthy collegian falls in love with an heir apparent, but her domineering cousin orders her to end the affair.

movie|tmdb:41903.name: Mr. India
movie|tmdb:41903.description: A poor but big-hearted man takes orphans into his home. After discovering his scientist father's invisibility device, he rises to the occasion and fights to save his children and all of India from the clutches of a megalomaniac.

movie|tmdb:31525.name: The Legend of Bhagat Singh
movie|tmdb:31525.description: Born in British India, Bhagat Singh witnesses numerous atrocities during his childhood and grows up to become one of the most fearless freedom fighters in the country.

movie|tmdb:499110.name: Kyaa Dil Ne Kahaa
movie|tmdb:499110.description: U.S. settled Esha (Esha Deol) is attracted to fellow-student Rahul (Tushar Kapoor). Rahul too is attracted to Esha. Esha returns home to India and tells her parents (Raj Babbar, Nina Kulkarni) about her love for Rahul. The family is pleased, and proceeds to finalize the marriage. They accompany Esha to Rahul's house. Rahul's parents (Rajesh Khanna, Smita Jaykar) approve of Esha. But when they ask Rahul, to everyone's shock, he refuses to marry Esha under any circumstances.

movie|tmdb:49518.name: Aap Mujhe Achche Lagne Lage
movie|tmdb:49518.description: Sapna Dholakia desires nothing more than to be married to her love Rohit, but her conservative family and stubborn father will stop at nothing to make sure she marries the son of a friend of the family.

movie|tmdb:55212.name: Tumko Na Bhool Paayenge
movie|tmdb:55212.description: Veer, a villager, becomes restless after he is haunted by the visions of his past. When he is attacked on the day of his wedding, he forces his parents to reveal the truth about his identity.

movie|tmdb:85985.name: Ek Tha Tiger
movie|tmdb:85985.description: A top Indian agent is sent to observe the actions of a scientist but the mission complicates when he falls in love with the scientist's Pakistani caretaker.
